en: 'Tortoise Security Inc.'.
'Welcome to Juno Laboratory.'
*AHEM*

*Despite all of Ed's brilliant ideas for Resonance's beneficial applications, I've grown haunted by what has been left unsaid: the undeniable potential for destruction contained in these tiny particles.
zh: *埃德为如何用共振造福人类想出了许多妙用，可他没提到的另一面却越来越让我不安：这些微小粒子无疑也蕴藏着毁灭的力量。

en: *Eureka!  Three tests, three successful glimpses of my new particle.  They exist as the sub-structure of the electron!  Conjoined-twin particles, occupying the same space!  But how is that possible?  I do not yet know, but I do know that once separated, the particles are only visible for a fraction of a microsecond before they snap back together, pulverizing each other.
zh: *找到了！三次测试，三次都成功瞥见了我的新粒子。它们是构成电子的更小结构！一对连体双生粒子，占据着同一个空间！但这怎么可能？我还不知道。不过我已经知道，一旦分离，它们的可见时间还不到一微秒，随即便猛然撞回一起，互相粉碎。

en: *Every night for two weeks. A blue van with no markings. I'm keeping the curtains drawn at all times when working at home, now.  Why are they here?
zh: *连续两周，每晚都是。一辆没有标记的蓝色面包车。现在我在家工作时一直拉着窗帘。他们为什么在这里？

en: *I checked my lab, the simulator where I was experimenting on them, all along the route to my vault.  Nothing.  Maybe I only collected 19 sets.
zh: *我检查了实验室、我做实验的模拟器，以及通往保险库的整条路线。什么都没有。也许我只收集了19组。

en: *I get the collider again in two days.  I've almost prepared the devices.  I haven't told Ed what I'm going to attempt.  I installed the vault a week ago, so everything should be ready.
zh: *两天后我再次使用对撞机。设备几乎准备好了。我还没告诉埃德我打算尝试什么。一周前我安装了保险库，所以一切都应该就绪了。

en: *I haven't slept in a week.
*I saw the blue van parked near the lab.  I can't do this any more.
zh: *我看到蓝色面包车停在实验室附近。我再也受不了了。

en: *I thought someone was ransacking my lab, but it was just old Saul the janitor.  I shouldn't have yelled, but he shouldn't be in here.  I need sleep, but I can't leave the lab.  I've found a comfortable position in my simulator.
zh: *我以为有人在洗劫我的实验室，但只是老清洁工索尔。我不该吼他，但他不该在这里。我需要睡眠，但我不能离开实验室。我在模拟器里找到了一个舒服的姿势。

en: *I was walking down the lab's hall in the middle of the night to the bathroom and I heard someone else's footsteps behind me.  I took off running and they gave chase.  I locked myself in the bathroom until I heard nothing.
zh: *半夜我沿着实验室走廊去洗手间，听到身后有别人的脚步声。我拔腿就跑，他们追了上来。我把自己锁在洗手间里，直到什么也听不见。

en: *I will be more vigilant about counting each one as I place them back into the vault at the end of each day.
zh: *今后每天收工，把它们放回保险库时，我都要更仔细地逐个清点。

en: *I will contact you with instructions.
*I'm calling Ed in the morning...
*I'm going to try to repeat the experiment on the new, larger supercollider as soon as it comes on line next week.  I will be remembered for this!
zh: *等新的大型超级对撞机下周投入使用，我就打算重做这个实验。这一定会让我名留青史！

en: *I'm keeping Ed busy coming up with possible applications for Resonance technology.  He has a bright mind.  Many brilliant ideas.
zh: *我让埃德忙着为共振技术设想可能的应用。他头脑聪明。很多绝妙的想法。

en: *I'm sending you this journal for safe keeping, and to help you make the decision that I may need to ask of you -- A decision that I, myself, was unable to make. You must learn what Resonance is, and more importantly, what it could be.
zh: *我把这本日记寄给你保管，也是为了帮你做出一个我可能会请你做的抉择——一个我自己没能做出的抉择。你必须了解共振是什么，更要了解它将来可能变成什么。

en: *I've decided to send Anna my journal and some notes along with enough information to find my vault should something happen to me.  I'm glad I had her fingerprint encoded into the system.  I need to make a decision myself, though.  Before its too late.
zh: *我决定把日记和一些笔记寄给安娜，再附上找到保险库所需的信息，以防我遭遇不测。幸好我已经把她的指纹录入系统。不过，我自己也必须做出决定，趁一切还来得及。

en: *It'll be a month before I have access to the collider again, but there are so many simulations to run.  I'm operating on the theory that the Sub-Electron Conjoined Twins are occupying the same space, but not the same time.  They vibrate through space time in perfectly opposing, yet perfectly complementary patterns. Two particles, drawn together, inseparable, but never meeting.
zh: *还要一个月我才能再次使用对撞机，但有太多模拟要运行。我基于这样的理论：亚电子连体双生粒子占据同一空间，但不在同一时间。它们以完全相反却又完全互补的模式在时空中振动。两个粒子，相互吸引，不可分离，却永不相遇。

en: *Last night, I dreamed of Anna.
*Nineteen?  I just checked my notes, I thought I had made twenty devices.  I have nineteen.  Was I that tired?  Did I miscount?
zh: *十九个？我刚检查了笔记，我以为我做了二十个设备。我有十九个。我那么累吗？我数错了吗？

en: *No time for sleep now.

*Remarkable! This is truly groundbreaking!  I had Ed verify my equations three times.  The SECT particles, once separated, are not only strongly attracted to each other, but the attraction is inversely proportional to the particles' proximity!
zh: *了不起！这简直是突破性发现！我让埃德把方程核验了三遍。SECT 粒子一旦分离，就会强烈地相互吸引，而且它们离得越远，吸引力就越强！

en: *Resonance literally holds the fabric of existence together.
zh: *共振确确实实维系着整个物质世界。

en: *Resonance!  That is the name I have given to the special vibration of the particles. Each particle in a set vibrates at the exact same frequency, this binds them together.  But why do these twin particles bind to each other and not to any other?  My theory is that no two sets of particles in the entire universe have the same Resonance frequency.  Every set is unique!
zh: *共振！这是我给粒子特殊振动起的名字。一组中的每个粒子都以完全相同的频率振动，这使它们结合在一起。但为什么这些孪生粒子彼此结合，而不与其他任何粒子结合？我的理论是，整个宇宙中没有任何两组粒子拥有相同的共振频率。每一组都是独一无二的！

en: *Someone was in my apartment.  I set a piece of tape across the corner of the door after leaving and it was broken when I returned.  I'm staying in my lab.
zh: *有人进过我的公寓。出门时，我在门角贴了条胶带，回来发现它断了。我要住到实验室去。

en: *Success! Using the devices, I was able to trap twenty pairs of SECT particles.  The devices block the special property they have -- their vibration, allowing them to stay apart after the particle collision.  The devices then each attract one of the separated twins.  I have twenty sets to experiment on!
zh: *成功了！利用这些设备，我成功捕获了二十对SECT粒子。设备阻断了它们的特殊属性——它们的振动，使它们在粒子碰撞后能够保持分离。然后设备各自吸引分离的孪生粒子之一。我有二十组可以实验了！

en: *That was the third phone call this morning that has interrupted me.  No one on the other end, just clicking.
zh: *这是今天早上第三个打断我的电话了。另一端没人，只有咔嗒声。

en: *The attraction doesn't lessen with distance, like gravity, it increases!  The ramifications of this... the potential energy...
zh: *这种吸引力不会像引力一样随距离增加而减弱，反而会增强！这意味着什么……其中蕴藏的势能……

en: *The calculations and simulations are real.  My new assistant, Ed, has been checking them.  These particles were just a ghost of an image, a blip on a screen during one particle collision months ago.  They all called it a sensor bug, but these numbers don't lie.
zh: *计算和模拟都证实了这一点。我的新助手埃德一直在帮忙核对。几个月前的一次粒子碰撞中，这些粒子只在屏幕上留下过一道模糊的影像、一个转瞬即逝的光点。所有人都说是传感器故障，但这些数字不会说谎。

en: *This morning, I found the simulator unlocked.  Could I have been that sleep deprived, that I left my data accessible by the world? Perhaps, I should adopt a stronger encryption scheme for my notes.  Perhaps I should invest in a secure repository for my research and data.
zh: *今天早上，我发现模拟器没锁。难道我缺觉到这种地步，竟把数据敞开给任何人看？也许该给笔记换一种更严密的加密方式了，也该花钱建个安全的地方，存放研究资料。

en: *While Ed is occupied I slip away to the vault.  No one can know.
zh: *趁埃德忙碌时，我溜去保险库。不能让任何人知道。

en: *Who could have taken one? No one even knows what I have.  Not even Ed.
zh: *谁会拿走一个？甚至没人知道我有这些东西。连埃德都不知道。

<2 Next stop: Aventine Central Hospital.
zh: <2 下一站：阿文廷中央医院。

en: <2 Next stop: Imperiali Plaza.
zh: <2 下一站：因佩里亚利广场。

en: <2 Please stand clear of the doors.
<2 The doors will now close.
<2"The Eleven Foundation?"
<2<iHello?
<2<r Ed?
<2<r I'm sorry, but I really need those results.
zh: <2<r 抱歉，但我真的需要那些结果。

en: <2<r Please.
<2<r The kitchen?
<2<r<i Did you finish those equations I gave you on Friday?
zh: <2<r<i 我周五给你的那些方程，你算完了吗？

en: <2<r<i Direct and to the point as usual, I see.
zh: <2<r<i 还是一如既往地直截了当。

en: <2<r<i Do you have the results?
<2<r<i Do you have those results for me?
zh: <2<r<i 你把那些结果给我带来了吗？

en: <2<r<i Eddings?
<2<r<i First, I need you to confirm something.
zh: <2<r<i 首先，我需要你确认一件事。

en: <2<r<i Good.
<2<r<i Hello?
<2<r<i I didn't wake you up did I?
<2<r<i I guess I kind of lose track of the world when I'm working.
zh: <2<r<i 我猜我工作的时候有点与世隔绝了。

en: <2<r<i I'm sorry, I just-
<2<r<i Is it?
<2<r<i Listen, I need your help with something.
<2<r<i Oh, good.
<2<r<i Yeah.
<2<r<iAnd trust me, I much prefer my problems to be hypothesized, tested, and quantified.
zh: <2<r<i相信我，我更喜欢我的问题是假设、验证并量化的。

en: <2<r<iDanger?
<2<r<iHow close were our estimates?
<2<r<iI'm destroying it all.
<2<r<iI'm going to destroy them.
<2<r<iI'm here.
<2<r<iI've been here all weekend thinking about it.
zh: <2<r<i我整个周末都在这里思考这件事。

en: <2<r<iIt's an ethical one.
<2<r<iMy research. The data. The results.
<2<r<iSomeone's been following me, Eddings. I know it.
zh: <2<r<i有人在跟踪我，埃丁斯。我知道。

en: <2<r<iThis isn't a scientific or a mathematical dilemma.
zh: <2<r<i这不是科学或数学上的两难。

en: <2<r<iYou're a terrible liar, Ed.
<2And certainly not you.
<2And they betrayed me. They aren't going to use Resonance to help the world.
zh: <2可他们背叛了我。他们不会用共振来造福世界。

en: <2Are you... are you tracing me?
<2But I made a mistake, and now Resonance is the only tool I have to fix it.
zh: <2但我犯了个错误，现在共振是我唯一能用来弥补的工具。

en: <2But it's not too late! I can make it right!
<2But you've got to believe me. I didn't want it to be like this.
zh: <2但你必须相信我。我也不想变成这样。

en: <2Damn it, I don't have time for all your questions!
zh: <2该死，我没时间回答你所有问题！

en: <2Don't listen to a word they say.
<2Goodbye, Ray.
<2How'd you get this number?
<2I can't do that!
<2I didn't want it to happen this way...
<2I have to go.
<2I might have agreed with you once, but now?
zh: <2我以前也许会同意你，但现在？

en: <2I said forget it!
<2I trusted them. I... did these horrible things for them.
zh: <2我信任过他们。我……为他们做了那些可怕的事。

en: <2I wanted to protect Resonance, yes, but there's so much more at stake now...
zh: <2我确实想保护共振，没错，但现在有远比这更重要的东西……

en: <2I'm a free agent now, Ray.
<2I'm finally seeing clearly. I know what I have to do.
zh: <2我终于看清了。我知道自己该做什么。

en: <2I'm not going to tell you anything!
<2I'm not working for anybody ever again.
zh: <2我再也不会为任何人工作了。

en: <2I... I just can't. It's too late for that.
zh: <2我……我就是做不到。已经太迟了。

en: <2I... I just couldn't take the risk.
<2I... I'm sorry you feel that way.
<2I... did but...
<2In five... ten years, when we're living in a new age of peace and prosperity...
zh: <2五年……十年后，当我们生活在一个和平繁荣的新时代……

en: <2It... It would have been...
<2Like hell I will!
<2Look, I admit things got a little out of hand...
zh: <2听着，我承认事情有点失控了……

en: <2Look, whatever you may think of me, those two are far worse.
zh: <2听着，不管你怎么看我，那两个人比我坏得多。

en: <2No matter what happens tonight, Ray. Remember this - I stopped Antevorta.
zh: <2不管今晚发生什么，雷。记住这一点——我阻止了Antevorta。

en: <2No!
<2No! Wait. It wasn't... entirely like that.
<2No. NO. You're just trying to confuse me!
<2No. Not yet. There's no time...
<2No. Ray, you don't know the whole story.
<2Nobody can understand. Not you. Not Dr. Morales. And especially not Amul and Reno.
zh: <2没人能明白。你不行。莫拉莱斯博士不行。阿穆尔和雷诺尤其不行。

en: <2Nobody will ever tell me what to do with Resonance ever again.
zh: <2再也不会有人告诉我该怎么处置共振了。

en: <2Not Dr. Morales. Not Anna. Not Amul or Reno...
zh: <2莫拉莱斯博士不行。安娜不行。阿穆尔和雷诺也不行……

en: <2Oh, why the hell am I even talking to you! Goodbye!
zh: <2哦，我到底为什么要跟你说话！再见！

en: <2Ray, I'm sorry. There's isn't enough time to explain.
<2Ray, please believe me. I'm not a bad guy.
<2Ray, you're a smart enough guy. You should have made sense of this by now.
zh: <2雷，你是个聪明人。到现在你应该已经想明白了。

en: <2Ray?
<2Resonance is just too important. Do you understand?
<2Shut up!
<2Shut up! I'm not working for anybody.
<2Stay out of my way!
<2Stop them from gaining control. I can do that, at the very least.
zh: <2阻止他们获得控制权。至少这个我能做到。

en: <2They know I can stop them, so they convince you to get in my way.
zh: <2他们知道我能阻止他们，所以他们说动你来挡我的路。

en: <2They make you think they want the same thing you do, and "nudge" you in the right direction!
zh: <2他们让你以为他们和你目标一致，然后把你"推"向正确的方向！

en: <2They want to use it as a tool... A tool for their own selfish purposes!
zh: <2他们想把它当作工具……用来满足他们自私目的的工具！

en: <2They're trying to use you like they used me!
zh: <2他们想利用你，就像利用我一样！

en: <2This is all their fault!
<2This is bigger than me. Bigger than Anna or Morales or any of us.
zh: <2这件事比我更重要。比安娜、莫拉莱斯或我们任何人都更重要。

en: <2What?
<2Who is this?
<2Why? So you can stop me?
<2Yes.
<2Yes. It will be worth it.
<2You can be annoying. You know that?
<2You don't get to talk about Resonance!
<2You know NOTHING about Resonance!
<2You think I wanted this to happen?
zh: <2你以为我想让这一切发生吗？

en: <b Every hour!
<b HELLO!?
<b HEY!
<b No!
<b<i Doctor Morales!
<b<iAaaaghh!
<b<iBehold!
<b<iCry if you like.
<b<iDoctor Morales!
<b<iG-g-g-gyeeow!
<b<iHELLO?!
<b<iHELP!!!
<b<iI am shocked an appalled that you would even suggest such a thing!
zh: <b<i你竟然提出这种事，我既震惊又愤慨！

en: <b<iI bid you a good day, madam!
<b<iI bid you a good day, sir!
<b<iNo-one cares.
<b<iOw! Crap!
<b<iPLEASE HELP ME!
<b<iPLEASE! THERE'S SOMEONE IN MY APARTMENT!
<b<iSOMEBODY!
<b<iShocked and appalled!
<b<iStay with me!
<b<iThat is completely illegal and I would never ignore rules and regulations in such a manner.
zh: <b<i那是完全违法的，我绝不会以那种方式无视规章制度。

en: <b<iThe Great and Powerful Oz!
<b<iUncle Javi!
<b<iWell, bust my buttons!
<b<iYeeouch!
<bBut I've got to get in there!
<bDamn it!
<bDoctor Morales?!
<bDoctor!
<bHe's coming!
<bI'm not going in there!
<bNo exceptions.
<bTen thousand dollars!
<bTime for that ambulance, Detective!
<bWhere's that ambulance?!
<bYes, I sold my car for ten thousand dollars!
<bYou're sorry!?
<i ...find it... my vault...
<i ...unnn...
<i Blogger.
<i c...can't...
<i"All's well that ends well."
<i...the key.
<i<bStay with me!
<iAn... na...
<iDetective Bennet.
<iFind my vault!
<iGetting a copy of someone's financial transactions.
<iHey, shut up, lady!
<iI promise.
<iI will not let your discovery be misused.
<iMove them?
<iMy vault... my...
<iMy... angel...
<iNo matter what happens-
<iNo touchie.
<iReally?
<iShhhhh!
<iYour uncle holds the key!
<iYour uncle holds...
<l How does one lose a car?
<l"Anna angel!" I got it!
<l"Financial Transaction Tracking Number"
<l...not like an earthquake or nothing, more like when those young hoodlums-
zh: <l……不像地震什么的，更像是那些小混混——

en: <l<2<iAnd we're getting reports of a fire over at Juno.
zh: <l<2<i还有报告说朱诺那边着火了。

en: <l<2<iBe caref-
<l<2<iBennet, do you copy?
<l<2<iCalling in all available officers to help out.
zh: <l<2<i正在呼叫所有可调派的警员前去支援。

en: <l<2<iCould one of you check out Juno and the other help out on Humphrey Street?
zh: <l<2<i你们能一个去朱诺看看，另一个去汉弗莱街帮忙吗？

en: <l<2<iDetective Bennet!
<l<2<iRadio back if additional emergency services are required.
zh: <l<2<i如果需要更多紧急服务，用无线电回报。

en: <l<2<iSorry pal, I can't see it over the phone.
zh: <l<2<i抱歉伙计，隔着电话我看不到。

en: <l<2<iThanks.
<l<2<iThere's a subway car stuck near the Humphrey Street station.
zh: <l<2<i汉弗莱街站附近有一列地铁卡住了。

en: <l<2<iThey're deployed all over the city right now.
<l<2<iUh, no I got us those sandwiches a couple hours ago, remember?
zh: <l<2<i呃，不是吧，我几个小时前才给咱们买了三明治，记得吗？

en: <l<2<iWe're trying to direct them where it's needed most.
zh: <l<2<i我们正试着把他们调到最需要的地方。

en: <l<2<iWe've got little mini-emergencies all over Aventine.
zh: <l<2<i阿文廷到处都有小规模紧急情况。

en: <l<2<iWhat're you doing?
<l<2<iYeah, and so are the phones.
<l<2<iYou notice that city-wide blackout we just had?
zh: <l<2<i你注意到刚才全城停电了吗？

en: <l<2But...
<l<2Chief cut me off.
<l<2Hello?
<l<2I brought up his name at the briefing when you and  Bennet were named as suspects-
zh: <l<2当把你和贝内特列为嫌疑人时，我在简报会上提了他的名字——

en: <l<2I can clear the front desk for a while.
<l<2I can't.  Chief's got me tasked.
zh: <l<2我做不到。局长给我派了任务。

en: <l<2I'm going to pull the plug to Oink's favorite toy.
zh: <l<2我要拔掉奥因克最爱玩具的插头。

en: <l<2In a few hours, your faces will be all over the TV and net.
zh: <l<2几小时后，你们的脸就会出现在电视和网络上。

en: <l<2Is Detective Bennet alright?
<l<2It should give you enough time to trace some phone numbers.
zh: <l<2应该够你追踪几个电话号码了。

en: <l<2It should take him a while to figure out where the problem is.
zh: <l<2他得花一阵子才能查出问题在哪。

en: <l<2No one's looking.
<l<2She wants everyone focused on finding the two of you.
zh: <l<2她要所有人集中精力找你们两个。

en: <l<2Stay away from crowds, and don't go to the lab or your houses.
zh: <l<2远离人群，别去实验室或你们家。

en: <l<2The chief is keeping you at the top of everybody's list.
<l<2The tracing equipment's at Admin HQ.
<l<2There's going to be a press conference tonight.
<l<2They're being watched.
<l<2What do you need?
<l<b<iDonchu talk back to me!
<l<b<iI said clean up this room!
<l<b<iYou don't have a mama any more!
<l<iI don't have time to clean up after you, you little brat!
zh: <l<i我没时间跟在你屁股后面收拾，你这个小鬼！

en: <l<iWhad I tell you!?
<l<iYou know what I have to do to keep food on our table!?
zh: <l<i你知道为了让我们有饭吃我得做什么吗！？

en: <lAnd I'm thinking to myself, well, that's just great, Saul, you're gonna die in this godforsaken lab...
zh: <l我心里想，好啊，索尔，你要死在这该死的实验室里了……

en: <lAnd Miss Castellanos, I know you've had a rough day.
zh: <l还有卡斯特利亚诺斯小姐，我知道你今天过得很糟。

en: <lBesides Javi, I only had one other uncle.
zh: <l除了哈维，我就只有另一位叔叔了。

en: <lBut Resonance...
<lBut...
<lDo you have a car, or-?
<lDon't go away again.
<lEd, I'd like you to come with me.
<lFirst, I need his FTTN.
<lHe's buried near my parents in All Saints Cemetery.
zh: <l他葬在诸圣公墓，我父母旁边。

en: <lHow're you going to do that without them seeing you?
zh: <l你怎么做才能不被他们发现？

en: <lI can't believe I dropped it... if you hadn't picked it up, I...
zh: <l我不敢相信我把它弄丢了……要不是你捡到，我……

en: <lI guess it's kind of my lucky charm.
<lI have some questions for you too but they can wait for tomorrow.
zh: <l我也有几个问题要问你，不过可以等到明天。

en: <lI need two things to get at anyone's records.
zh: <l要查任何人的记录，我需要两样东西。

en: <lI saw the lights go out, and then it got hot, and I felt a vibration...
zh: <l我看见灯灭了，然后变热了，我感觉到一阵震动……

en: <lI thought you said you weren't a stalker.
zh: <l我记得你说过你不是跟踪狂。

en: <lI'm not going to get reprimanded for this, am I?
<lIt's kept me out of trouble for almost twenty years, so I guess that's something.
zh: <l它让我远离麻烦快二十年了，我想这也不简单。

en: <lMama!
<lMi sobrina...
<lMr. Eddings, if you don't mind, I'd like to ask you some follow-up questions back at the station.
zh: <l埃丁斯先生，如果你不介意，我想请你回警局再回答几个后续问题。

en: <lMuch to the dismay of my ankle.
<lMy guess is it's in one of the many underground tunnels.
zh: <l我猜是在众多地下隧道之一。

en: <lMy uncle's last words were "Your uncle holds the key."
zh: <l我叔叔的遗言是“你叔叔握着钥匙。”

en: <lNow I'm gonna write your name in code, uncle Javi!
zh: <l现在我要把你的名字写成密码，哈维叔叔！

en: <lOh yeah, and ten thousand dollars.
<lOh yeah. So, I come in to work, as usual.
zh: <l哦对。就是，我像往常一样来上班。

en: <lOne: The vault is most likely hidden somewhere inside Juno Laboratories.
zh: <l第一：保险库很可能藏在朱诺实验室里的某个地方。

en: <lOnly it's a bit of a fall, so now my ankle's all messed up.
zh: <l只不过摔得有点狠，所以现在我的脚踝全搞砸了。

en: <lOnly, since it doesn't open, I have to break it open.
zh: <l只不过，既然它打不开，我就只能把它砸开。

en: <lShe's gone, Anna.
<lShe's not...
<lShe's with the other angels.
<lSir!
<lSo, I take out my trusty wrench and smash it, then climb right on out.
zh: <l于是，我拿出我那把可靠的扳手，把它砸开，然后直接爬了出去。

en: <lSo, how did you get the chief to sign off on this stakeout?
zh: <l那你是怎么让局长批准这次蹲守的？

en: <lSo, the lights come back on, but a bunch of power cables got loose.
zh: <l后来灯又亮了，但一堆电缆松脱了。

en: <lSo, we'll need a blueprint of the lab.
zh: <l所以，我们需要一份实验室的蓝图。

en: <lThank you so much!
<lThat's right. And you said that's where the two of you met?
zh: <l对。你说你们俩就是在那儿认识的？

en: <lThat's when I start to feel this little tingly feeling in my head.
zh: <l就在那时，我开始感觉脑袋里有点刺刺的。

en: <lThe potential for good far outweighs the possibility of misuse!
zh: <l它带来好处的潜力远远超过被滥用的可能！

en: <lThe window!
<lThen, all the lights go out, and there's this stinging heat, and this vibration...
zh: <l然后，所有灯都灭了，接着是一阵灼热，还有这种震动……

en: <lThere may be a clue about this "key" there.
zh: <l那里也许有关于这把“钥匙”的线索。

en: <lThis is against regulations.
<lTwo: Even with the blueprints, we're going to need some kind of information on the vault to help us figure out exactly where in the lab it might be.
zh: <l第二：就算有了蓝图，我们还需要关于保险库的某种信息，帮我们弄清它到底可能在实验室的哪个位置。

en: <lUh, and the lights came back on, and there were loose cables and fires, so I broke the window with my trusty wrench and jumped.
zh: <l呃，然后灯又亮了，有松脱的电缆和火，所以我用我那把可靠的扳手砸开窗户跳了出去。

en: <lUncle Javi?
<lWhat's "stepmother" mean?
<lWhy?
<lWow! It's like a million dollars!
<lYes, I'm off at the next stop.
<lYou can't deprive the world of such-
<r<2<iI dunno.
<r<2<iI'll grow some eyes in the back of my head.
zh: <r<2<i我后脑勺上再长几只眼睛呗。

en: <r<2<iOh right, about that, if anyone asks, we were patrolling the neighborhood around the arson all night.
zh: <r<2<i哦对了，说到这个，要是有人问起，就说我们整晚都在纵火案附近巡逻。

en: <r<2<iRelax, Reg.
<rAnd other times, you gotta make your own orders.
zh: <r还有些时候，你得自己下命令。

en: <rAnd so, if you use the key we just made to decode the message...
zh: <r所以，如果你用我们刚做出来的密钥来解码这条信息……

en: <rAnd the clever children followed the crumbs straight back home.
zh: <r于是这两个聪明的孩子顺着面包屑一路回到了家。

en: <rAnd three: We need to figure out how to open the vault.
zh: <r还有第三：我们得弄清楚怎么打开保险库。

en: <rAnd two: that it was Reggie's turn to go get some donuts.
zh: <r第二：该轮到雷吉去买甜甜圈了。

en: <rBecause if she was their real mam{, she'd never want to lose them out in the woods.

en: According to the clock, it's just a couple minutes after 7:30 in the morning.
zh: 看时钟，现在才早上7点半刚过几分钟。

en: According to the plaque next to it, the Police archive retrieval system was built by Tortoise Security.
zh: 根据旁边的铭牌，警方档案检索系统由托托伊斯安保公司制造。

en: Achievements: %d of %d.
Achive master
Actually, I don't know much about the underlying technology of the archive.
zh: 其实，我对档案馆的底层技术不太了解。

en: Actually, it doesn't seem to be coming from this side of the room at all.
zh: 其实，似乎根本不是从房间这一侧传来的。

en: Actually, no.
Actually, something tells me, she's going to be delayed.
zh: 其实，我有种感觉，她会被耽搁。

en: Actually, this whole area looks really seedy.
zh: 其实，这整片区域看起来都很不安全。

en: Actually... why don't I go? You probably need some time alone.
zh: 其实……不如我去吧？你可能需要一个人待会儿。

en: Adding a skip button
Adding puzzles
Additional Art
Additional Fonts
Advance: OFF
Advance: ON
Adventure Game Studio
Adventure game luminaries
After a lot of work, I finally gained access to the lab's front doors.
zh: 费了好大功夫，我终于进入了实验室的前门。

en: After all the work I did for him, didn't I deserve more?
zh: 我为他做了那么多事，难道我不该得到更多吗？

en: After all these months, you must have a bead on me.
zh: 过了这么多个月，你应该摸透我了。

en: After all this effort, sadness, anger...
zh: 经历了这么多努力、悲伤、愤怒……

en: After getting the door open, it exposed the magnet mounted on that lock.
zh: 把门打开后，露出了安装在锁上的磁铁。

en: After that, everything was different.
After three late payments, I'd better be careful how I use this thing.
zh: 三次逾期付款之后，我最好小心点用这东西。

en: After you've stopped Ed, you'll see us again.
zh: 等你阻止了埃德，我们会再见面的。

en: After you, Detective. Age before beauty.
After you.
Agreed.
Ah! Main Hallway and Entrance. That must be it.
zh: 啊！主走廊和入口。一定是这个。

en: Ah, "Rosy-fingered dawn."
Ah, Emma. How many times can I fool thee?
zh: 啊，艾玛。我还能骗你多少次呢？

en: Ah, focus Ray - focus.
zh: 啊，集中精神，雷——集中精神。

en: Ah, nature!
Ah, still feels like yesterday, though.
zh: 啊，可感觉还像是昨天的事。

en: Ah, tell you what, sonny: why don't you just take my keys and unlock the darn closet yourself?
zh: 啊，这样吧，小家伙：你干脆拿我的钥匙自己去开那破柜子吧？

en: Ah, welcome back!
Ah. It's the shape of of a lock, you see.
zh: 啊。你看，那是一个锁的形状。

en: Ahem.
Alarm clock
Alexei Jones
Aliens.
Aliens?
All I need is someone to listen.
All achievements unlocked!
All gone.
All information is stored somewhere, these days. A will and testament is no different.
zh: 如今所有信息都存在某个地方。遗嘱也不例外。

en: All of it.
All right.
All slots full
All the great ideas and creations born here.
zh: 所有伟大的想法和创造都诞生在这里。

en: All the ink is dissolving.
All the pages are blank.
All this talk is pointless unless we find the vault before the people who killed my uncle do.
zh: 除非我们在杀我叔叔的人之前找到保险库，否则说这些都没用。

en: All those high-tech toys. I feel like a kid in, well, a toy store.
zh: 全是那些高科技玩意儿。我感觉自己像个进了玩具店的小孩。

en: All within a few seconds.
All you need is a thermal image scanner, and you can find it.
zh: 你只需要一台热成像扫描仪，就能找到它。

en: All's well that ends well?
Alley
Allure...
Almost.
Already hacked that.
Already, peace treaties have been signed across the globe, joining forces against this new threat.
zh: 全球各地已经签署了和平条约，联合力量对抗这一新威胁。

en: Alright smart guy, what do we do next?
zh: 好吧，聪明人，我们接下来怎么办？

en: Alright, I'll record it in the system.
Alright, Mr...
Alright, alright.
Alright, but don't do anything afterward.
zh: 好吧，但看完之后别做任何事。

en: Alright, but if you see any sign of danger, you come straight back.
zh: 好吧，但你要是看到任何危险的迹象，就马上回来。

en: Alright, enough of this.
Alright, fine.
Alright, let's go over this plan. Ed?
zh: 好了，我们来过一遍这个计划。埃德？

en: Alright, let's go.
Alright, let's just hear the short version.
zh: 好了，我们就听简短版本吧。

en: Alright, look...
Alright, thanks.
Alright, the magnetic fields are highly focused and only affect the marked areas.
zh: 好吧，磁场高度集中，只会影响标记区域。

en: Alright, we'll get some guys to search his residence.
zh: 好吧，我们派几个人去搜他的住处。

en: Alright, well, you follow up on that lead.
zh: 好吧，那你就去追查那条线索。

en: Alright, you changed the document orientation.
Alright.
Alright. Be careful.
Alright. But you'd better be on the level.
zh: 好吧。但你最好别耍花样。

en: Alright. No time to think. I'd better go with my gut.
zh: 好吧。没时间想了。我还是凭直觉吧。

en: Alright. Thanks.
Alright. We'll split up.
Alright...
Also pretty easy to crack, given enough time. I prefer keeping things under lock and key, myself.
zh: 只要有足够时间，破解起来也相当容易。不过我个人还是喜欢把东西锁起来。

en: Alternatively, you can click and drag an inventory item or memory directly onto a character in order to start a conversation about that item.
zh: 你也可以将物品栏中的物品或记忆直接拖到角色身上，和对方聊聊这件事。

en: Although after that issue with the big electromagnet, maybe he was just being practical.
zh: 不过经历了那次大电磁铁的事故之后，也许他只是务实罢了。

en: Although hitting him over the head hasn't improved his mood, any.
zh: 不过打了他脑袋一下，也没让他的心情好起来。

en: Always. No exceptions.
Amazing, wasn't it?!
Amul Batra
Amul Batra?
Amul and Reno just killed hundreds, Ray, THOUSANDS! With Resonance!
zh: 阿穆尔和雷诺刚刚杀了数百人，雷，数千人！用共振！

en: Amul and Reno must still have some sway with the police. Both our faces have been all over the news this morning.
zh: 阿穆尔和雷诺对警方肯定还有影响力。今早新闻上到处都是我们俩的脸。

en: Amul only called me just in time for me to arrive when I did.
zh: 阿穆尔打电话给我时，刚好赶得上我及时赶到。

en: Amul sent him. I had nothing to do with that.
zh: 是阿穆尔派他去的。我跟那件事毫无关系。

en: Amul versus Ed
An Escher print.
An ICU patient's room. I've been there once or twice, fortunately in an official capacity.
zh: 一间重症监护病房。我去过一两次，幸好是公务。

en: An LED light, joined to a fuse slot.
zh: 一个LED灯，连着一个保险丝插槽。

en: An access terminal for the mainframe.
An activation switch.
An aluminum trashcan.
An angel wearing a diaper.
An angel. A baby angel.
zh: 一个天使。一个婴儿天使。

en: An antique oak chest.
An apparatus for the dispensation of pharmaceuticals.
An automated alarm then notifies the intruder that they have invaded your personal space.
zh: 然后自动警报会通知入侵者，他们已经侵犯了你的个人空间。

en: An automated pharmacy machine.
An chain fence blocking off one exit to a back alley.
zh: 一道铁丝网围栏，封住了后巷的一个出口。

en: An early peek
An edifice of information, the beating heart of the police department.
zh: 一座信息大厦，警局跳动的心脏。

en: An empty pill bottle.
An empty prescription bottle for a drug called "Comfocil."
An event of that size would require two very precisely placed devices, miles apart, with the lab in the center.
zh: 那种规模的事件需要两个放置得极其精确的装置，相隔数英里，实验室位于正中央。

en: An extended smoke break.
An impassible obstacle.
An inlaid bronze safe.
zh: 一个镶饰的青铜保险箱。

en: An innocent woman, killed with MY gun.
zh: 一个无辜的女人，被我的枪打死了。

en: An instrument of wonder - the primal tool of the writer's trade.
zh: 一件奇妙的工具——作家行当的原始工具。

en: An interesting challenge.
An office filing cabinet.
An officer does not give his gun to *anyone.*
zh: 警官不会把自己的枪交给*任何人*。

en: An old bench beside the bus stop, for the convenience of passengers.
zh: 公交站旁的一张旧长椅，方便乘客使用。

en: An old bus stop.
An old set of drawers.
An old wooden door in a back alley.
zh: 后巷里一扇破旧的木门。

en: An ordinary filing cabinet.
An origami crane?
An ornate wooden chest.
An out-of-shape, middle-aged desk sergeant.
zh: 一个身材走样、中年的值班警佐。

en: An overflowing, festering trash can.
zh: 一个满溢、腐烂的垃圾桶。

en: An' my fat ass sure ain't getting in 'til it's gone.
zh: 那玩意儿不弄走，我这身肥肉可进不去。

en: An... eccentric man, to say the least.
zh: 一个……古怪的人，至少可以这么说。

en: An... na...
And Antevorta can crunch ALL of them, for everyone...?
zh: 而 Antevorta 能把每个人的这些数字，全都处理完……？

en: And Antevorta?
And I *know* he'll just blow it all on those little pills he likes so much.
zh: 而且我*知道*他会把钱全砸在他那么喜欢的小药丸上。

en: And I ain't one for jumping.
And I can smell a cigarette from even farther.
zh: 再远一点的烟味我也闻得到。

en: And I can't count the number of times you've needed to be reminded.
zh: 你需要被提醒多少次，我也数不清了。

en: And I don't want to give this guy an excuse to start shakin' his gums if I can help it.
zh: 而且只要我能避免，我就不想给这家伙一个开始嚼舌根的理由。

en: And I heard about some kind of new DNA search database we might be testing out within the future.
zh: 我还听说我们未来可能会测试某种新的DNA搜索数据库。

en: And I help with the use of the archive and the copy room.
zh: 我还帮忙处理档案馆和复印室的使用。

en: And I know how damaging to your reputation it would be if it got out that someone broke in and stole your files.
zh: 而且我知道，如果有人闯入并偷走你文件的事传出去，对你的名声会有多大损害。

en: And I mean to find out what.
And I need them now.
And I need to know more about the vault you built for him.
zh: 我需要了解更多关于你为他建造的保险库的事。

en: And I think we both want to figure out where he is.
zh: 我想我们都想弄清楚他在哪儿。

en: And I'll do it again if you don't start answering questions!
zh: 你要是不开始回答问题，我还会再打！

en: And I'm just getting my facts straight. That's all.
zh: 我只是在核实事实。仅此而已。

en: And I'm thinking to myself, well, that's just great, Saul, you're gonna die in this godforsaken lab...
zh: 我心里想，好啊，索尔，你要死在这该死的实验室里了……

en: And I'm to believe that you took the time to put the wrench away in the closet before jumping out?
zh: 那你是要我相信，你在跳出去之前还特意把扳手放回了维修间？

en: And I've got the broken ankle to prove it.
zh: 我扭伤的脚踝可以作证。

en: And Miss Castellanos, I know you've had a rough day.
zh: 还有卡斯特利亚诺斯小姐，我知道你今天过得很糟。

en: And Mrs. Krauze is on that cruise so there's no one in there who could help me.
zh: 而且克劳泽太太在坐游轮，所以里面没人能帮我。

en: And Resonance is just another piece for the collection?
zh: 共振只是收藏的又一件藏品？

en: And Resonance is, what? A trophy for your wall?
zh: 那共振是什么？你墙上的战利品？

en: And anyway, don't you have work to do?
zh: 再说了，你不是有活要干吗？

en: And as I mentioned, we are collectors of information.
zh: 正如我提到的，我们是信息的收集者。

en: And as soon as the devices have warmed up, the Resonance particles will take care of the rest.
zh: 等装置预热完毕，共振粒子会处理剩下的事。

en: And by "we" I mean "you."
And certainly not you.
And dirty magazines.
And do people buy them?
And even if I were looking for some fresh air, I wouldn't find it in downtown Aventine City.
zh: 就算我想找点新鲜空气，在阿文廷市中心也找不到。

en: And even then, I might opt for the convenience mart down the block.
zh: 就算真憋不住，我可能也会选择街角那家便利店。

en: And for snapping at you, for that matter.
And for your information, that is not what "irony" means.
zh: 顺便告诉你，那可不是“讽刺”的意思。

en: And he's risked a lot for us.
zh: 而且他为我们冒了很大风险。

en: And his secret is safe with me.
And how can I show they went out of their way?
zh: 我又怎么证明他们绕了远路？

en: And how could they get away with it right under my nose in *my* hospital?
zh: 他们怎么能在我眼皮底下、在*我的*医院里干这种事还不被发现？

en: And how do you know that?
And how much danger.
And if lives really are in danger...
zh: 而且如果真有人命危险的话……

en: And if they ARE worse, we took the Resonance device from the basement. They'll win no matter what.
zh: 如果他们真的更糟，我们从地下室拿走了共振装置。无论如何他们都会赢。

en: And if you need a second copy, just let me know.
zh: 如果你需要第二份副本，告诉我就行。

en: And it is definitely not in Ozzy's name.
zh: 而且这绝对不是奥兹的名字。

en: And it looks like the bottom needs to be at ten.
And let me tell you, the data accessing speeds are remarkable!
zh: 而且我告诉你，数据访问速度非常惊人！

en: And let's also keep in mind that I now know about it.
zh: 还有，别忘了，我现在知道了这件事。

en: And like you, I could only ask myself: Why? Why did a thing like this have to happen?
zh: 和你们一样，我只能问自己：为什么？为什么这样的事非得发生？

en: And my fat ass sure ain't getting in 'til it's gone.
zh: 在它消失之前，我这肥屁股肯定进不去。

en: And my uncle used to call me his Angel.
zh: 我叔叔以前叫我他的天使。

en: And not a moment too soon.
And not very well.
And now all this? Using Resonance for mass destruction...
zh: 现在又搞出这一切？用共振进行大规模破坏……

en: And now that Dr. Morales is dead, it's just out there waiting to be found.
zh: 现在莫拉莱斯博士死了，它就那么放在那里等着被人发现。

en: And now the lab looks like it was stepped on by Godzilla.
zh: 而现在实验室看起来像是被哥斯拉踩过一样。

en: And now-
And once this is done, I'll start again. And I'll make sure it's done right.
zh: 等这件事了结，我会重新开始。我会确保这次做对。

en: And other times, you gotta make your own orders.
zh: 还有些时候，你得自己下命令。

en: And people say *I* lack empathy.
zh: 还有人说我缺乏同理心呢。

en: And press that button right there.
And release a large amount of energy.
And remember, Mr. Abbot must stay in the interrogation room at all times.
zh: 记住，阿博特先生必须始终待在审讯室里。

en: And remember, Mr. Eddings must stay in the interrogation room at all times.
zh: 记住，埃丁斯先生必须始终待在审讯室里。

en: And remember, he's not to leave the interrogation room.
zh: 记住，他不得离开审讯室。

en: And remember, she's not to leave the interrogation room.
zh: 记住，她不得离开审讯室。

en: And rest assured - we will do everything in our power to keep America and the world safe...
zh: 请放心——我们将尽一切力量保护美国和世界的安全……

en: And she sees everything.
And since Congress rammed through Antevorta this morning, our window is quickly closing on that.
zh: 而且既然国会今早强行通过了Antevorta，我们这点机会也快没了。

en: And so did the dead rat inside of it.
And so, if you use the key we just made to decode the message...
zh: 所以，如果你用我们刚做出来的密钥来解码这条信息……

en: And some leaking water shorted out a security panel and shut the emergency door!
zh: 而且漏水短路了一块安全面板，把应急门关上了！

en: And someone took the mirror.
zh: 而且有人把后视镜拿走了。

en: And someone used his own technology to kill him.
zh: 有人用他自己的技术杀了他。

en: And that is why we collect.
zh: 这就是我们收集的原因。

en: And that it's pretty fun to watch in action.
zh: 而且看它运作还挺有意思的。

en: And that somebody is not going to be me.
And that you didn't report the theft to the police because of the damage it would do to your business.
zh: 而且你没有报警，因为那会损害你的生意。

en: And the angel... that's what uncle Javi used to call me!
zh: 还有天使……哈维叔叔以前就这么叫我！

en: And the battery is dead.
And the clever children followed the crumbs straight back home.
zh: 于是这两个聪明的孩子顺着面包屑一路回到了家。

en: And the explosion that killed him?
And the lock looks pretty cheap.
zh: 而且这锁看起来挺便宜的。

en: And the men and women of the United States of America.
zh: 以及美利坚合众国的男男女女。

en: And the rest of the time is mine to finish paper work or... whatever.
zh: 剩下的时间就归我自己，用来完成文书工作或者……随便什么。

en: And the wounds were instantly cauterized.
zh: 而且伤口被瞬间烧灼封住了。

en: And then we turn ourselves in.
And then we're going to need some tools.
zh: 然后我们还需要一些工具。

en: And then, just when I think the end is near, I see...
zh: 然后，就在我以为快结束的时候，我看到了……

en: And there is also a handy tool that will help you know what paperwork you need to gather to get approval for the document's release.
zh: 还有一个方便的工具，能帮你了解需要准备哪些文件，才能获得文件公开的批准。

en: And there's only one cop I can trust right now.
zh: 而现在我只信得过一个警察。

en: And there's your document.
And they betrayed me. They aren't going to use Resonance to help the world.
zh: 可他们背叛了我。他们不会用共振来造福世界。

en: And this is bullshit!
And this one was no different.
And this time, we don't have a key.
And though she knew she shouldn't, she loved me back.
zh: 尽管她知道不该如此，她还是爱着我。

en: And three: We need to figure out how to open the vault.
zh: 第三：我们得弄清楚怎么打开保险库。

en: And to be honest, I don't want anyone else touching this baby.
zh: 说实话，我不想让别人碰这宝贝。

en: And to do that, I've got to find a way to keep an eye on the alley without him noticing.
zh: 要做到这一点，我得想办法在不被他发现的情况下盯着那条巷子。

en: And together, we will stand stronger than ever.
zh: 团结在一起，我们将比以往任何时候都更强大。

en: And trust me, I much prefer my problems to be hypothesized, tested, and quantified.
zh: 相信我，我更喜欢我的问题是假设、验证并量化的。

en: And two: that it was Reggie's turn to go get some donuts.
zh: 第二：该轮到雷吉去买甜甜圈了。

en: And until recently Ed was a reliable, predictable cog.
zh: 而直到最近，埃德都是一个可靠、可预测的齿轮。

en: And we also oversee the city archives which are located in the building.
zh: 我们还负责管理位于这栋楼里的市档案馆。

en: And we have to do it now!
And we saw this shifty-eyed mope make a pickup!
zh: 然后我们看到这个眼神闪烁的家伙来取货！

en: And we're getting reports of a fire over at Juno.
zh: 还有报告说朱诺那边着火了。

en: And what can I do for you?
And what case is this in relation to?
And what do you do here?
And what is the lovely lady's full name?
zh: 这位可爱的女士全名是什么？

en: And what? What do I do now?
zh: 还有怎么办？我现在该怎么办？

en: And who? Who could have done this?
zh: 还有谁？谁可能做出这种事？

en: And why are they saying you killed a girl?
zh: 他们为什么说你杀了一个女孩？

en: And wills should be available as long as they were filed with a notary or attorney.
zh: 遗嘱只要在公证人或律师那里备过案，就应该能查到。

en: And with enough information, anything can be predicted.
zh: 只要有足够的信息，任何事都能被预测。

en: And with the fire and that cable taken care of, we can finally go in.
zh: 火和那根电缆都处理好了，我们终于能进去了。

en: And you barely scratched the thing's surface.
zh: 而你连这东西的皮毛都没摸到。

en: And you expect me to believe the Eleven Foundation are spearheading some Orwellian nightmare?
zh: 你就指望我相信十一基金会正在带头搞什么奥威尔式的噩梦？

en: And you know this for sure?
And you think the angel on this book might have something to do with you?
zh: 你觉得这本书上的天使可能和你有关？

en: And you thought this meant me?

Heads.

zh: 不过听说他花了两百五十块，就为了让自己的形象出现在一款游戏里。

en: Heat pump malfunction
Heating issue
Heavy door
Heck yeah we did.
Heh heh, I'm just teasing, boy.
Heh, well you got me there.
zh: 嘿，这你可说到点子上了。

en: Heh.
Heh. Alright, alright.
Heh. Five years later, and they STILL haven't been able to get it open.
zh: 呵。五年过去了，他们还是打不开它。

en: Heights and me are not best friends.
zh: 高处和我可不是好朋友。

en: Heiroglyph
Hello from Dave and Janet

Hello valued customer![[You've tried our 100 percent effective lengthening pills, and you're undoubtably running out of ruler. But are you concerned with your girth?[[Studies show that the ladies prefer something... robust.[[With our new pill, the EverWide, you'll be putting your money where her mouth is.[[Sign up today!
zh: 尊贵的顾客，您好！[[您已经试过我们百分之百有效的增大药丸，想必尺子都快不够长了。但您对自己的粗细满意吗？[[研究表明，女士们更喜欢……粗壮一点的。[[试试我们的新药 EverWide，让您花下的本钱，都能让她含在嘴里。[[今天就订购吧！

en: Hello?
Help us.
Here goes nothing.
Here he is.
Here is my uncle's death certificate.
zh: 这是我叔叔的死亡证明。

en: Here is my uncle's will.
Here we go.
Here we go...
Here we go... this'll take a while.
zh: 又来了……这得花上一会儿。

en: Here ya go.
Here's his credit report.
Here's the Resonance device, right as he left it.
zh: 共振装置就在这儿，和他离开时一模一样。

en: Here, I've got a print out.
Here, let me.
Here, take this.
Here. You can hold everything I'm carrying.
zh: 给。你可以拿着我身上所有的东西。

en: Hey Anna!
Hey Anna?
Hey Bennet.
Hey Bennet. You wanna pitch a few? It's been years since I was on a baseball field.
zh: 嘿，贝内特。想投几个球吗？我好久没上过棒球场了。

en: Hey Detective.
Hey Ed!
Hey Ed, do you need anything?
Hey Ed, hurry it up!
Hey Ed, you alright up there?
zh: 嘿，埃德，你在上面还好吗？

en: Hey Ed, you should take another look inside.
zh: 嘿，埃德，你应该再进去看看。

en: Hey Ed. Do you think you could reach that window if I boosted you up there?
zh: 嘿，埃德。要是我把你托上去，你觉得能够到那扇窗户吗？

en: Hey Ed. Go try that boulder again.
zh: 嘿，埃德。再去试试那块大石头。

en: Hey Ed. Have you tried pushing that big piece of stone?
zh: 嘿，埃德。你试过推那块大石头吗？

en: Hey Ed. Let me try boosting you up that window.
zh: 嘿，埃德。让我把你托上那扇窗户试试。

en: Hey Ed?
Hey Mr. Abbot.
Hey Ozzy.
Hey Ozzy. Do you know anything about gaining access to city blueprints?
zh: 嘿，奥兹。你知道怎么获取城市蓝图吗？

en: Hey Ozzy. Remember this?
Hey Ozzy. You want this back?
zh: 嘿，奥兹。你想把这个拿回去吗？

en: Hey Ray!
Hey Ray?
Hey Sugar!
Hey You!
Hey now, what about my ankle?
Hey there.
Hey you!
Hey!
Hey!  I asked you to stay in the interrogation room!
zh: 嘿！我让你待在审讯室里！

en: Hey!  It's my lucky number!
Hey! Back to the interrogation room!
Hey, Berry!
Hey, Officer Johnsen!
Hey, Officer Oink!
Hey, Ozzy!
Hey, did you know that-
Hey, do you have the key to that server room?
zh: 嘿，你有那间服务器机房的钥匙吗？

en: Hey, do you want to hear about-
Hey, do you want to see my-
Hey, don't get me started on luck again.
zh: 嘿，别又跟我提运气的事。

en: Hey, don't look at old Saul.
Hey, fancy that!
Hey, have you ever heard of Antevorta?
Hey, have you ever heard of this "Tortoise Security" outfit?
zh: 嘿，你听说过那个叫“托托伊斯安保”的公司吗？

en: Hey, how'd you get that? That was part of the file that was stolen!
zh: 嘿，你怎么拿到那个的？那是被盗文件的一部分！

en: Hey, it's a peso!
Hey, it's duct tape.
Hey, no problem!  I just-
Hey, shut up, lady!
Hey, that's a USB slot!
Hey, that's the book that Dr. Morales kept his personal notes in.
zh: 嘿，这就是莫拉莱斯博士用来记私人笔记的那本书。

en: Hey, uh...
Hey, wanna see my phone?
Hey, we've got the same model water cooler back at Juno Labs.
zh: 嘿，朱诺实验室里也有一台同型号的饮水机。

en: Hey, what's in that drawer over there?
zh: 嘿，那边那个抽屉里有什么？

en: Hey, you got the keys to the server room?
zh: 嘿，你有服务器机房的钥匙吗？

en: Hey.
Hey. Congratulations on that award.
Hey... there...
Hi Emma. It's been awhile.
Hi guys.
Hi there.
Hi!
Hi, I'm-
Hi, I've got a question about-
Hi.
High Score
High tech babble
Hippocrates
His janitor's uniform is pretty torn up.
zh: 他的清洁工制服破得厉害。

en: His name is Tom. I can introduce you if you want.
zh: 他叫汤姆。你想的话我可以介绍你们认识。

en: His paper clips, too.
His papers are spread all around now.
zh: 他的文件现在散落得到处都是。

en: His research.
His skills could come in handy, but I don't like the way he looks at Anna.
zh: 他的本事可能派得上用场，但我不喜欢他看安娜的眼神。

en: His wedding's next month?
Hitting something with a brick is my kind of problem-solving.
zh: 用砖头砸东西，这才是我擅长的解决问题方式。

en: Hm.
Hm? Sorry. I was just thinking of that computer by Officer Berry's desk.
zh: 嗯？抱歉。我刚才在想贝里警官桌旁的那台电脑。

en: Hm? Sorry. I was just wondering if I'm going to have a job in the morning.
zh: 嗯？抱歉。我只是在想明天早上我还有没有工作。

en: Hmm, this works in the movies.
Hmm. Could be a letter substitution cypher. That's pretty common.
zh: 嗯。可能是字母替换密码。这很常见。

en: Hmm. It's great that we got these blueprints, but they're useless without knowing where to go.
zh: 嗯。拿到这些蓝图是很好，但不知道去哪儿也是白搭。

en: Hmm. Something must have spooked him.
zh: 嗯。肯定有什么事吓到他了。

en: Hmm?
Hmmm.
Hmmm.  No phone service down here.
zh: 嗯。这下面没有手机信号。

en: Hmmm...
Hmmph.
Hmph.
Hnng-
Hnnggg...
Hold back.
Hold down LEFT MOUSE BUTTON to crawl. LEFT CLICK inventory item in the INV screen to use it.
zh: 按住鼠标左键爬行。左键点击物品栏（INV）中的物品，即可使用。

en: Hold on.
Hold that thought.
Hold this.
Hole in the wall
Holy shit, Ray, take a look at the TV.
Holy-
Homeless man
Honestly, Detective, I have no idea.
zh: 说实话，警探，我完全不知道。

en: Honestly? I don't really know much about it.
zh: 说实话？我其实不太了解。

en: Honestly? I'm a little scared of her.
Honestly? I'm trying not to think about it too much.
zh: 说实话？我尽量不去多想。

en: Hooligan
Hopefully heavy enough to hold that door shut.
zh: 但愿够重，能把那扇门顶住。

en: Hopefully no one heard us kick that door in.
zh: 希望没人听到我们踢开那扇门。

en: Hopefully we did well
Hopefully you didn't spook him.
Hopefully, he'll take these instead of the money.
zh: 但愿他会收下这些，而不是钱。

en: Hospital ID badge
Hospital elevator
Hospital entrance
Hospital sign
Hospital wards creep me out. Just a little. It's the beeping.
zh: 医院病房让我发毛。就一点点。是那哔哔声。

How 'bout that boulder, huh?
How about some water?
How about your role in the death of Anna Castellanos and Dr. Morales?
zh: 那你在安娜·卡斯特利亚诺斯和莫拉莱斯博士之死中扮演的角色呢？

en: How am I supposed to open this thing?
How avant-garde.
How can I crack the city archives?
zh: 我怎么才能黑进城市档案？

en: How can I get that Lab blueprint?
zh: 我怎么才能拿到那份实验室蓝图？

en: How can I help you?
How can I prove it?
How can a safe be "Rapture Ready?"
zh: 一个保险箱怎么能“被提准备好了”？

en: How can we get into the archive machine?
How can we hack into the archive machine?
How close were our estimates?
How convenient.
How could I use the will here?
zh: 我在这里怎么能用上遗嘱？

en: How could you pull that trigger on Anna?
zh: 你怎么能对安娜扣下扳机？

en: How did they find out so fast?
zh: 他们怎么这么快就知道了？

en: How did they get it? And what are they going to do with it?
zh: 他们是怎么弄到的？又打算拿它做什么？

en: How do I get out?
How do I love thy verdant hues, o beauteous shrub.
zh: 我多么爱慕你翠绿的色彩，哦美丽的灌木。

en: How do I request a document from the city archives?
zh: 我该怎么向市档案馆申请一份文件？

en: How do I use the master keycard?
zh: 我怎么用这张万能钥匙卡？

en: How do people work in these aquariums?
zh: 人们怎么能在这种鱼缸里工作？

en: How do we get through?
How do we keep running into each other?
How do we stop Ed?
How do we stop them?
How do you think we can get that safe open?
zh: 你觉得我们怎么才能打开那个保险箱？

en: How does one lose a car?
How is this going to help us?
How long does the process take?
How long have you been planning this?
How long were you working at Juno Labs, Ed?
zh: 你在朱诺实验室工作了多久，埃德？

en: How low can I go?
zh: 我还能堕落到什么地步？

en: How many more secrets?
How many times do I have to explain to you:
How may I direct your call?
How quickly I descended into a life of crime.
zh: 我这么快就堕入了犯罪生涯。

en: How the story grew
How well do you know Anna Castellanos?
zh: 你跟安娜·卡斯特利亚诺斯有多熟？

en: How will you do that?
How would we go about getting a building's blueprint from the city archive?
zh: 我们怎么才能从市档案馆拿到一栋建筑的蓝图？

en: How would you describe yourself?
How'd Amul and Reno get this far?
zh: 阿穆尔和雷诺是怎么走到这一步的？

en: How'd you find us?
How'd you get this number?
zh: 你怎么弄到这个号码的？

en: How'd you like Mike?
How're you going to do that without them seeing you?
zh: 你怎么做才能不被他们发现？

en: How's business?
How's it going up there?
How's that girlfriend of yours?
How's that?
How's the chief doing?
How's this for nonchalant?
How's your girth?
How've you been, my man Ozzy?
zh: 最近怎么样啊，我的老兄奥兹？

en: How?
However, it is conspicuously missing a handle.
zh: 不过，它明显少了一个把手。

en: Huh.
Huh. Fancy that.
Huh. They don't usually update the list that fast.
zh: 哈。他们通常不会那么快更新名单。

en: Huh?
Huh? There's another scrap of paper stuck to the back.
zh: 嗯？背面还粘着另一张纸片。

en: Human interest. "The mad safemaker."
zh: 人情味故事。“疯狂的保险柜制造者。”

en: Humanity can use it.  We can fulfill our potential!
zh: 人类可以利用它。我们可以实现我们的潜能！

en: I  cannot imagine a situation in which a cigarette butt would be useful.
zh: 我想不出烟头能有什么用处。

en: I "acquired" the formula and used the measurements from that hole in Morales' lab.
zh: 我“弄到”了公式，并用莫拉莱斯实验室那个洞的测量数据做了计算。

en: I -write- the news.
I ... panicked. Sorry. I don't deal well with guns.
zh: 我……慌了。抱歉。我不太会应付枪。

en: I WAS being pretty annoying, after all.
I Will Be There
I absolutely do not want that.
I actually don't believe in luck.
I added a few extra locks to the door.
zh: 我在门上多加了几把锁。

en: I agree, but he did give us some information. The Resonance devices that destroyed the lab needed to be placed four kilometers on either side of it.
zh: 我同意，但他确实给了我们一些信息。摧毁实验室的共振装置需要放在实验室两侧各四公里处。

en: I ain't a rookie no more, Detective.
zh: 我已经不是新人了，警探。

en: I ain't goin' in there 'til we do something about that cable.
zh: 不把那根电缆处理掉，我就不进去。

en: I ain't running in there while the place is on fire.
zh: 这地方着火的时候，我可不会冲进去。

en: I already am.
I already confirmed that Antevorta has my DNA.
I already got everything I needed from there.
zh: 我已经从那里拿到了所有需要的东西。

en: I already have a sample from myself.
zh: 我已经有自己的样本了。

en: I already know that we need to get Morales' will and death certificate in order to get Tortoise to talk.
zh: 我已经知道，要让托托伊斯开口，得拿到莫拉莱斯的遗嘱和死亡证明。

en: I already picked mine up this morning. Mostly just drug company ads.
zh: 我今天早上已经拿到我的了。基本上全是制药公司的广告。

en: I already showed him that.
zh: 我已经给他看过那个了。

en: I already showed him the will.
zh: 我已经给他看过遗嘱了。

en: I already swabbed my cheek once.
zh: 我已经刮过一次脸颊了。

en: I already swiped the card.
I already told you everything you need to know.
zh: 我已经把你需要知道的都告诉你了。

en: I already told you, I don't got those keys!
zh: 我不是跟你说过了吗，我没有那些钥匙！

en: I already took a DNA sample of myself.
zh: 我已经取过我自己的DNA样本了。

en: I always dreamed of Resonance bringing about world peace, but I never imagined it would be like this.
zh: 我一直梦想着共振能带来世界和平，但我从没想过会是这样。

en: I always have to get Johnsen to explain it to me. It takes hours.
zh: 我总得让约翰森给我解释怎么用。一弄就是好几个小时。

en: I always keep Se#or Bear near my treasure chest.
zh: 我一直把熊先生放在我的宝箱旁边。

en: I always wondered why Dr. Morales had this embossed on his journal.
zh: 我一直想知道为什么莫拉莱斯博士的日记本上压印着这个。

en: I am Oz, the Great and Powerful!
zh: 我就是奥兹，伟大而强大的奥兹！

en: I am a law abiding citizen! I help puppies across the street! I never even return a library book late!
zh: 我是守法公民！我扶老奶奶过马路！我连图书馆的书都没逾期还过！

en: I am a weak man, Anna.
I am but a humble craftsman in the field of boutique security.
zh: 我不过是精品安全领域里一个谦逊的手艺人。

en: I am going to kill you right after I kill Ed.
zh: 我杀了埃德之后马上就杀了你。

en: I am going to make you a new box.
zh: 我要给你做一个新盒子。

en: I am no longer the person I was.
I am not going to miss this bed when I leave here.
zh: 等我离开这里，绝不会想念这张床。

en: I am not going to smoke disgusting old cigarette ends.
zh: 我才不会去抽恶心的旧烟头。

en: I am not taking any of those.
I am ordering you to help me get that secure document.
zh: 我命令你帮我拿到那份机密文件。

en: I am shocked an appalled that you would even suggest such a thing!
zh: 你竟然提出这种事，我既震惊又愤慨！

en: I appreciate everything he's done for me.
zh: 我很感激他为我做的一切。

en: I assume a technician like yourself would know.
zh: 我猜像你这样的技术员应该知道。

en: I believe Dr. Morales wants us to find his vault because it contains the research and data needed to build and arm more Resonance devices.
zh: 我相信莫拉莱斯博士想让我们找到他的保险库，因为里面存有建造和武装更多共振装置所需的研究和数据。

en: I believe I explained the rules.
zh: 我想我已经解释过规矩了。

en: I believe he's complaining about another employee's poor hygiene.
zh: 我觉得他是在抱怨另一名员工卫生习惯差。

en: I believe it expects something thinner than my finger.
zh: 我觉得它需要比我的手指更细的东西。

en: I believe that's called circumstantial evidence.
I believe the artist was trying to demonstrate the dichotomy between his childlike mind and his withering body.
zh: 我认为画家是想表现他孩童般的心灵与衰朽躯体之间的对立。

en: I belong here as much as you do.
zh: 我跟你一样有资格待在这儿。

en: I bid you a good day, madam!
I bid you a good day, sir!
I blame bad company.
I bought all the cheap art in my apartment just to have something to fill the space.
zh: 我买下公寓里所有便宜的艺术品，只是为了填满空间。

en: I broke my promise to you, Anna. It was a lie.
zh: 我违背了对你的承诺，安娜。那是个谎言。

en: I brought up his name at the briefing when you and  Bennet were named as suspects-
zh: 当把你和贝内特列为嫌疑人时，我在简报会上提了他的名字——

en: I call it "Self-Portrait As An Ornate Wooden Puzzle Cube."
zh: 我叫它“华丽木制谜盒自画像”。

en: I call that a starter safe.
zh: 我管那个叫入门保险箱。

en: I came here to destroy them, same as you.
zh: 我来这里是为了摧毁它们，和你一样。

en: I can barely read the poster in the dark.
zh: 黑暗中我几乎看不清那张海报。

en: I can boost the skinny kid up there if the situation calls for it.
zh: 需要的话，我可以把那瘦小子托上去。

en: I can clear the front desk for a while.
I can climb out onto the fire escape!
zh: 我可以从防火梯爬出去！

en: I can control a number of functions from here, but what's really impressive is all that it's doing in the background.
zh: 我可以从这里控制许多功能，但真正厉害的是它在后台做的那些事。

en: I can cover your tracks for a while, but the chief's got everyone out looking for you.
zh: 我可以暂时帮你掩盖行踪，但局长已经派所有人出去找你了。

en: I can do no more.
I can draw a circle with this.
I can explain everything, Officer. You see...
zh: 警官，我可以解释一切。你看……

en: I can feel it!
I can feel it, I'm waking up.
zh: 我能感觉到，我正在醒来。

en: I can fix just about anything with duct tape.
zh: 我几乎能用胶带修好任何东西。

en: I can get one of you past Oink, but after that you're on your own..
zh: 我能帮你们中的一个绕过奥因克，之后就得靠你自己了。

en: I can get up and through it using the ladder.
zh: 我可以用梯子爬上去，从那里钻进去。

en: I can give you the paper work.
I can have one down here in an hour!
zh: 我一小时内就能调一份过来！

en: I can hide stuff under my bed. Sometimes I hide under there too.
zh: 我可以把东西藏在床底下。有时我也藏在那下面。

en: I can imagine.
I can never figure out how that damn thing works.
zh: 我永远搞不懂那鬼东西怎么用。

en: I can practically manage the whole police department from this baby.
zh: 我几乎能用这台宝贝管理整个警察局。

en: I can push the bookshelf to block the door!
I can see a dark area beyond the doors. Maybe a parking lot.
zh: 我能看到门后有一片黑暗区域。也许是停车场。

en: I can see a power cable shooting out sparks in the hallway through this glass door.
zh: 透过这扇玻璃门，我能看到走廊里一根电缆正在冒火花。

en: I can see something hidden below that.
zh: 我能看到那下面藏着东西。

en: I can smell a crime a mile away.
zh: 一英里外的犯罪我都能闻出来。

en: I can still hear someone trying to get through the door.
zh: 我还能听到有人想破门而入。

en: I can take care of myself.
I can think of more important things to do than rescuing an office chair.
zh: 我能想到比救一把办公椅更重要的事。

en: I can touch it, but not quite pull it back.
zh: 我能碰到它，但没法把它拉回来。

en: I can trace phones using this computer.
zh: 我可以用这台电脑追踪电话。

en: I can track it as long as it has that SIM card in it.
zh: 只要里面插着那张SIM卡，我就能追踪到它。

en: I can try.
I can turn invisible. It's my super power.
zh: 我能隐身。这是我的超能力。

en: I can use it to trace calls.
I can use my hospital ID card to unlock elevator access to the morgue.
zh: 我可以用我的医院ID卡解锁通往太平间的电梯权限。

en: I can use the terminal.
I can use them to help locate the vault.
zh: 我可以用它们来帮助定位保险库。

en: I can use these like in that story Mama read to me.
zh: 我可以像妈妈给我读的那个故事里那样用这些。

en: I can't believe I dropped it... if you hadn't picked it up, I...
zh: 我不敢相信我把它掉了……要不是你捡起来，我……

en: I can't believe I have to prove my own uncle is dead. It's been all over the news.
zh: 真不敢相信我还得证明我自己的叔叔死了。新闻都铺天盖地了。

en: I can't believe Saul let it get this bad.
zh: 真不敢相信索尔让它烂成这样。

en: I can't believe print newspapers still exist.
zh: 我真不敢相信纸质报纸还存在。

en: I can't believe she's...
I can't believe that piece of crap ever got a sequel, let alone a third movie.
zh: 我真不敢相信那部烂片居然还有续集，更别说第三部了。

en: I can't believe that this has been going on in *my* hospital!
zh: 我简直不敢相信这种事一直在*我的*医院里发生！

en: I can't believe this is happening...
zh: 真不敢相信会发生这种事……

en: I can't believe this!
I can't believe this. The detective seemed so... helpful.
zh: 我真不敢相信。那警探看起来那么……乐于助人。

en: I can't believe you cracked it!
zh: 我真不敢相信你把它解开了！

en: I can't break down that door with *her* watching.
zh: 有*她*看着，我不能破门而入。

en: I can't bring back Anna or Dr. Morales, but I can make *this* right.
zh: 我无法让安娜或莫拉莱斯博士复活，但我能让*这件事*回到正轨。

en: I can't climb back up.
I can't climb down with all this water.
I can't climb in with water pouring down it like this.
zh: 水这样哗哗地往下流，我爬不进去。

en: I can't climb up from this side. I'll have to get the doors open if I want to see inside.
zh: 我从这边爬不上去。想看到里面，就得把门打开。

en: I can't count the number of times you've reminded me.
zh: 你提醒过我多少次，我都数不清了。

en: I can't decide if his schtick is for real or just an act.
zh: 我分不清他那套做派是真的还是装的。

en: I can't do anything else except hope it holds.
zh: 除了指望它能撑住，我什么也做不了。

en: I can't do anything with that water.
zh: 我对这些水做不了什么。

en: I can't do anything with the sign.
zh: 我对这块牌子做不了什么。

en: I can't do anything with the water pouring out like this...
zh: 水这样一直涌出来，我什么也做不了……

en: I can't do anything with this while it's closed.
zh: 它关着的时候我什么也做不了。

en: I can't do much when I'm stuck on this thing.
zh: 困在这东西上，我也干不了什么。

en: I can't do much with it, it's written straight onto the wall.
zh: 我对它做不了什么，它是直接写在墙上的。

en: I can't do much with these other than wrap wires around them.
zh: 除了把电线缠上去，我对这些也做不了什么。

en: I can't do much with this with my bare hands.
zh: 光靠两只手，这东西我干不了什么。

en: I can't do much with this without a wire.
zh: 没有电线，我对这个做不了什么。

en: I can't do that!
I can't do this.
I can't do what I need to do while she's here.
zh: 她在这儿我没法做我要做的事。

en: I can't duct tape the roll of duct tape.
zh: 我不能用胶带把胶带卷粘起来。

en: I can't figure him out.
I can't fit that in the bottle.
zh: 我没办法把它塞进瓶子里。

en: I can't fix that with duct tape.
zh: 我没法用胶带修好那个。

en: I can't get a good look at it from over here.
I can't get a warrant on this.
zh: 我没法凭这个拿到搜查令。

en: I can't get at it.
I can't get in there. It's locked.
I can't get it in there.
I can't get past the fence.
I can't get them off with my bare hands.
I can't get there without that cop seeing me.
zh: 那个警察会看到我，我过不去。

en: I can't get there.
I can't get to the computer without him seeing me.
zh: 有他在，我靠近不了那台电脑。

en: I can't give you any information until I've seen the death certificate.
zh: 在看到死亡证明之前，我不能给你任何信息。

en: I can't give you any information until I've seen the will.
zh: 在看到遗嘱之前，我不能给你任何信息。

en: I can't go back to my apartment yet.
I can't go chat with Johnsen right now.
zh: 我现在不能去和约翰森聊天。

en: I can't ignore that note from my uncle.
zh: 我不能无视我叔叔的那张字条。

en: I can't just hand my badge over to any person I meet.
zh: 我不能随便把警徽交给我遇到的任何人。

en: I can't just waltz over to the archive and start fiddling with it.
zh: 我不能就这么大摇大摆走到档案库前开始摆弄它。

en: I can't just waste my treasure.
zh: 我不能就这样浪费我的宝贝。

en: I can't leave yet.
I can't leave. I've got to figure out where this hoodlum is headed.
zh: 我不能离开。我得弄清楚这个混混要去哪儿。

en: I can't let them finish their plan. Who knows what they'll do next?
zh: 我不能让他们完成计划。谁知道他们接下来会做什么？

en: I can't let them get in here!
I can't make heads or tails of it.
I can't make heads or tails out of these blueprints.
zh: 这些蓝图我完全看不懂。

en: I can't move them with my hands, but if I had something thin and hard...
zh: 我用手拧不动，但如果我有又薄又硬的东西……

en: I can't open it blind.
I can't open it from here.
I can't open it with my hands. There's a little screw holding it shut.
zh: 我用手打不开。有个小螺丝把它固定住了。

en: I can't place him at the moment.
I can't plug this in here.
zh: 我没法把这个插在这儿。

en: I can't process all this.
I can't pull it out from under that heavy metal slab.
zh: 我没法把它从那块沉重的金属板下抽出来。

en: I can't push it any further.
I can't put it back.
I can't put that in there.
I can't quite reach it from here.
I can't reach that sign.
I can't reach that.
I can't reach the crane from here.
zh: 我从这里够不到起重机。

en: I can't reach the rope from here.
I can't reach the window.
I can't reach through the cage to where the magnet is attached to the lock...
zh: 我够不到笼子里面磁铁连着锁的地方……

en: I can't reach up there.
I can't remember the last time I saw the sunrise.
zh: 我都不记得上次看到日出是什么时候了。

en: I can't remember whether it's dawn or dusk.
zh: 我记不清现在是黎明还是黄昏。

en: I can't say I know Johnsen all that well.
zh: 我不能说我很了解约翰森。

en: I can't say. I wasn't there when it happened, but it sounded... pretty bad.
zh: 我说不好。事发时我不在场，但听上去……相当糟糕。

en: I can't see it from here and I'm certainly not walking over there.
zh: 我从这里看不到，而且我绝对不会走过去。

en: I can't see it very well from here.
I can't see up there yet.
I can't see what I'm doing inside there.
zh: 我看不见里面在做什么。

en: I can't see what I'm doing with all this running water.
zh: 这么多流水，我看不清自己在做什么。

en: I can't see where that door leads.
zh: 我看不出那扇门通向哪里。

en: I can't see why I'd want to do that.
zh: 我看不出我为什么要那么做。

en: I can't share these with anyone.
zh: 我不能把这些分享给任何人。

en: I can't sneak past.
I can't speak for myself, but the one about anaesthetic and mind control was a big hit with one of the nurses.
zh: 我不能代表自己说，但关于麻醉剂和思想控制的那篇，有个护士特别喜欢。

en: I can't stand these things.
I can't take the pictures down.
I can't tell you why except to say that it could be the single most important thing in the history of mankind, but...
zh: 我不能告诉你原因，只能说它可能是人类历史上最重要的一件事，但是……

en: I can't think of a good reason to take that.
zh: 我想不出拿那个的好理由。

en: I can't think of a way to use a screwdriver with that.
zh: 我想不出怎么把螺丝刀用在那上面。

en: I can't think of any useful purpose for a two-legged table.
zh: 我想不出两条腿的桌子有什么用处。

en: I can't think of anything to do with Morales' will.
zh: 我想不出莫拉莱斯的遗嘱能拿来做什么。

en: I can't think of anything to do with that sign.
zh: 我想不出那个牌子能有什么用。

en: I can't think what I'd do with that.
zh: 我想不出拿它有什么用。

en: I can't think why I'd need to mop anything.
zh: 我想不出我有什么需要拖地的。

en: I can't turn this thing with my hands.
zh: 我没法用手转动这东西。

en: I can't unlock that.
I can't use it. Ray set a password.
I can't use that there.
I can't use the blueprints on that.
zh: 我没法把蓝图用在那个上面。

en: I can't use the computer while she's here.
zh: 她在这儿的时候我没法用电脑。

en: I can't walk through the crates when they're on the floor, and I can't walk under 'em when they're in the air...
zh: 箱子在地上时我走不过去，箱子在空中时我也走不过去……

en: I can't wedge the pipe between the doors.
zh: 我没法把管子塞进门缝。

en: I can't worry about that though. I've got to find Dr. Morales.
zh: 但我不能担心那个。我得找到莫拉莱斯博士。

en: I can't-
I can't.  Chief's got me tasked.
zh: 我做不到。局长给我派了任务。

en: I can, but I need to be adequately compensated for the risk I'm taking on.
zh: 能，但我得为承担的风险拿到足够的报酬。

en: I certainly won't be getting at it that way.
zh: 我肯定没法用那种方式拿到它。

en: I charmed information out of that receptionist once. I can probably do it again.
zh: 我曾经从那个前台嘴里套出过信息。我大概还能再来一次。

en: I cleaned my ears this morning.
I climbed out an access tube and ran the rest of the way.
zh: 我从检修管道爬出来，剩下的路是跑过来的。

en: I climbed out the grate.
I collected a sample of DNA from the mouth of the can I found in the Antevorta Project's trash can.
zh: 我从Antevorta项目垃圾桶里找到的罐子口部采集了DNA样本。

en: I could cut the rope...
I could draw a circle on something, I guess.
zh: 我想我可以在什么东西上画个圈。

en: I could get fired if I give my ID to anyone else.
zh: 我要是把证件给别人，可能会被开除。

en: I could get in very deep shit for this, alright?
zh: 我可能会因为这事惹上大麻烦，明白吗？

en: I could go for some coffee, though.
I could have done something!
I could hide inside this door, but I wouldn't be able to see out. The windows are painted black.
zh: 我可以藏在这扇门里，但那样就看不到外面了。窗户被涂成了黑色。

en: I could hide under the covers!
I could just request one just like it from supplies, if I really wanted one.
zh: 如果我真想要一个，我完全可以从供应处申请一个一模一样的。

en: I could kick it down, but then we'd be heard.
zh: 我可以踹开，但那样会被听到。

en: I could kick it in, but someone might hear.
zh: 我可以踢开它，但可能有人会听到。

en: I could look up some interesting information on that computer.
zh: 我可以在那台电脑上查到一些有趣的信息。

en: I could probably bend it in my hands if I wanted to.
zh: 我要是想的话，大概能用手把它掰弯。

en: I could smash it against my forehead, but I left that Ray back in college.
zh: 我可以把它往额头上砸，但那个雷已经留在大学时代了。

en: I could totally be a novelist.
zh: 我完全可以当个小说家。

en: I could use a vacation.
I could use it for fanning myself, but I'm not hot.
zh: 我可以用它扇风，但我又不热。

en: I could use it to see inside something - but what?
zh: 我可以用它来看清什么东西的内部——但看什么呢？

en: I could use these cotton swabs to take a DNA sample of myself.
zh: 我可以用这些棉签取我自己的DNA样本。

en: I could vault over the fence, but I know they have security cameras.
zh: 我可以翻过围栏，但我知道他们有监控摄像头。

en: I couldn't have done it without you.
I couldn't see it coming, I couldn't stop it!
zh: 我没能预见，也没能阻止！

en: I couldn't tell anyone!
I couldn't tell you.
I dare you to try. No, I INSIST you try.
zh: 我赌你打不开。不，我非要你试试。

en: I did, but I had the weirdest night last night.
zh: 本来是，但昨晚我经历了最诡异的一夜。

en: I didn't come here to sleep.
I didn't even know of its existence until earlier today, so I can't be sure.
zh: 我今天早些时候才知道它的存在，所以我也不能确定。

en: I didn't know the way would be blocked.
I didn't know they were here too.
zh: 我不知道他们也在这里。

en: I didn't listen to him.
I didn't mean to kill her!
I didn't really get it.
I didn't smoke 'em and I'm not cleaning 'em up.
zh: 又不是我抽的，我才不收拾。

en: I didn't think so.
I didn't wake you up did I?
I didn't wanna clean up, so I just pushed these things under the bed.
zh: 我不想收拾，就把这些东西都塞到床底下了。

en: I didn't want it to happen this way...
zh: 我不想让事情变成这样……

en: I didn't want the police involved, and after you worked your way in anyways...
zh: 我不想让警察牵扯进来，而等你无论如何都混进来之后……

en: I do math for Dr. Morales.
zh: 我为莫拉莱斯博士做数学。

en: I do not -read- the news.
I do not think I will live very long past this day.
I do that?
I do.
I don't believe in luck.
I don't blog. I report the facts.
zh: 我不写博客。我报道事实。

en: I don't drive anything that's not imported.
zh: 不是进口的东西我都不开。

en: I don't even know much about him.
zh: 我对他甚至都不太了解。

en: I don't even want to call it music; it all sounds like "womp womp womp" to me.
zh: 我甚至不想管那叫音乐；对我来说全是“咚呲咚呲咚呲”。

en: I don't even want to touch that crap.
zh: 我连碰都不想碰那玩意儿。

en: I don't get a lot of calls so I didn't need any bells and whistles.
zh: 我没什么电话，所以不需要那些花哨功能。

en: I don't get abstract art.
I don't give out confidential information on my security systems, especially huge commisions like the City Archive.
zh: 我不会泄露我安保系统里的机密信息，尤其是像市档案馆这样的大客户。

en: I don't go in there unless I really have to go.
zh: 除非实在憋不住，我都不进去。

en: I don't got the keys for that door.
I don't have a warrant for that.
I don't have all day.
I don't have any reason to swab that.
I don't have anything to say to her.
I don't have the clearance to access those blueprints.
zh: 我没有权限访问那些蓝图。

en: I don't have the key or know the combo to that lock.
zh: 我没有钥匙，也不知道那把锁的密码。

en: I don't have the strength to turn this.
I don't have time for my bed right now.
zh: 我现在没时间管我的床。

en: I don't have time for origami.
I don't have time for reading that marketing mumbo-jumbo.
zh: 我没时间看那些营销废话。

en: I don't have time to clean up after you, you little brat!
zh: 我没时间跟在你屁股后面收拾，你这个小鬼！

en: I don't have time to hear any more about Saul.
zh: 我没时间再听索尔的事了。

en: I don't have time to tell the whole story now-
zh: 我现在没时间把整件事讲清楚——

en: I don't hear anything anymore...
zh: 我再也听不到任何声音了……

en: I don't know anything about it. They are pretty cagey up there, to be honest.
zh: 我完全不知道。说实话，他们那儿的人嘴很紧。

en: I don't know how I feel about that yet.
zh: 我还不知道该怎么看待这件事。

en: I don't know how that's going to help me here.
zh: 我不知道那在这里能帮上什么忙。

en: I don't know how to use the peso like that.
zh: 我不知道该怎么那样用这枚比索。

en: I don't know if I should.
zh: 我不知道该不该这么做。

en: I don't know if we should trust that Amul guy.
zh: 我不知道我们该不该相信那个阿穆尔。

en: I don't know much about art, but that painting's pretty nice.
zh: 我不太懂艺术，但那幅画挺不错的。

en: I don't know much about computers, but Morales lab has cooler computers than I've ever seen.
zh: 我对电脑不太懂，但莫拉莱斯实验室里的电脑比我见过的都酷。

en: I don't know much about him.
I don't know that I should reveal that to him unless I think it will help me.
zh: 我不确定该不该告诉他，除非我觉得这对我有帮助。

en: I don't know the code, and there isn't time to try and figure it out right now.
zh: 我不知道密码，现在也没时间试着破解。

en: I don't know the combination, but I might be able to break it open-
zh: 我不知道密码，但我也许能把它撬开——

en: I don't know what I could do with that poster.
zh: 我不知道拿那张海报能做什么。

en: I don't know what I could do with that.
zh: 我不知道我能拿那个做什么。

en: I don't know what I could do with this.
zh: 我不知道拿这个能做什么。

en: I don't know what I would do with that valve.
zh: 我不知道拿那个阀门能干什么。

en: I don't know what I would need to mess with those for.
zh: 我不知道我干嘛要去动那些东西。

en: I don't know what else it could be.
I don't know what it is and I don't need it.
zh: 我不知道那是什么，也不需要它。

en: I don't know what kind of information is written in it, but I don't think I should be passing it around.
zh: 我不知道里面写了什么信息，但我觉得不该把它传来传去。

en: I don't know what that is.
I don't know what that means.
zh: 我不知道那是什么意思。

en: I don't know what that's going to do for me.
zh: 我不知道那对我有什么用。

en: I don't know what this document is about, but I know it's not what I'm looking for.
zh: 我不知道这份文件是关于什么的，但我知道不是我要找的。

en: I don't know what this file is supposed to be about.
zh: 我不知道这份文件应该是关于什么的。

en: I don't know what to ask about that.
zh: 我不知道该问那个什么。

en: I don't know what to do with it, it's just a piece of paper.
zh: 我不知道拿它怎么办，就是一张纸而已。

en: I don't know what to use it on.
I don't know where the next girl is, but she should be here any minute.
zh: 我不知道下一个女孩在哪，但她随时会到。

en: I don't know why I would do that.
zh: 我不知道我为什么要那样做。

en: I don't know why I'd want to put that in there.
zh: 我不知道我为什么要把那个放进去。

en: I don't know why, but I love big blue cups.
zh: 我不知道为什么，但我喜欢蓝色的大杯子。

en: I don't know, but listen...
I don't know, man.
I don't know.
I don't know. Maybe he didn't!
I don't like the idea of Ed and Anna going off into the cemetery alone.
zh: 我不喜欢埃德和安娜单独去墓地这个主意。

en: I don't like the look of that door.
zh: 我不喜欢那扇门的样子。

en: I don't like the stairs in the basement.
zh: 我不喜欢地下室的楼梯。

en: I don't like tinkerin' with anything that has more buttons than my remote control.
zh: 我不喜欢摆弄任何按钮比遥控器还多的东西。

en: I don't like you, Ed, but I'm not qualified to judge you. Not after... last night.
zh: 我不喜欢你，埃德，但我也没资格评判你。昨晚之后……更没资格。

en: I don't like your tone.
I don't love the brand -that- much.
zh: 我还没那么喜欢那个牌子。

en: I don't need a boost any more. I'll just use the ladder.
zh: 我不需要再被托上去了。我用梯子就行。

en: I don't need a drink right now.
I don't need any of that stuff.
I don't need any of them.
I don't need any paintings.
I don't need anything from there.
zh: 我不需要从那儿拿任何东西。

en: I don't need anything in there.
zh: 我不需要里面的任何东西。

en: I don't need it.
I don't need that sign.
I don't need that.
I don't need the designs for anything.
I don't need the servers right now.
I don't need this.
I don't need to ask about it.
I don't need to ask about that right now.
I don't need to ask about that.
I don't need to ask him about any of that crap.
I don't need to ask him about that. I can read it myself.

en: I guess he's the owner of the shop.
