en: I guess if I can't stick around, I could just run with what I've got so far.
zh: 我想，既然我不能留下来，那我就用手头已有的东西直接发出去。

en: I guess it couldn't hurt to have some around.
zh: 我想身边备一些也无妨。

en: I guess it's kind of my lucky charm.
I guess it's sturdy enough to hold me.
zh: 我想它够结实，能撑住我。

en: I guess it's useful to have a police officer on my side.
zh: 有个警察站在我这边，我想还挺有用的。

en: I guess no one will notice one more little ding...
zh: 我想没人会注意到再多一个小坑……

en: I guess that was a little strange...
I guess that was the wrong door.
I guess that's something.
I guess they don't trust scientists not to toy with the electrical system.
zh: 我猜他们是不信任科学家不会乱动电力系统。

en: I guess they keep the computers in there.
zh: 我猜他们把电脑放在里面。

en: I guess they're mine now.
I guess those weren't the pills he was looking for.
zh: 看来那不是他要找的药。

en: I guess we don't need to wonder if Bennet's on the level anymore.
zh: 看来我们不用再怀疑贝内特是不是可靠了。

en: I guess we know what caused that blackout now.
zh: 我想我们现在知道那次停电是什么造成的了。

en: I guess we need to access Juno Lab's blueprints on file at Police Headquarters.
zh: 我想我们需要去警察总部调取朱诺实验室的存档蓝图。

en: I guess we'll be in the news by now.
zh: 我猜我们现在该上新闻了。

en: I guess you really love your work, huh?
zh: 我猜你真的很热爱你的工作，是吧？

en: I guess.
I h-hope it's strong enough to stop him.
zh: 我、我希望它够结实，能挡住他。

en: I h-hope that slows him down.

I had a great time during our chat, too! You're so funny![[I can't believe I'm saying this, but I think I really like you, Steve, and I think we should meet.[[If you're interested, pick the time and location.[[I seriously can't believe this matchmaking service actually might have worked to bring together two people perfect for each other...
zh: 我们聊天时我也很开心！你太有趣了！[[我不敢相信我居然会说这种话，但我想我真的喜欢你，史蒂夫，我觉得我们应该见个面。[[如果你有兴趣，就定个时间和地点吧。[[我真的不敢相信这个婚介服务居然真的可能把两个天造地设的人凑到一起……

en: I had a lot of questions and my gut was telling me exactly two things.
zh: 我有很多疑问，而直觉明确告诉我两件事。

en: I had better come up with some other way of convincing him.
zh: 我最好想点别的办法说服他。

en: I had no clue where it came from or why it was there, but now...
zh: 我完全不知道它从哪来、为什么在那儿，但现在……

en: I had no idea that what he was working on was so dangerous.
zh: 我完全不知道他研究的东西这么危险。

en: I had to leave... to hide. The police suspected I had something to do with his death, and I,  I was a coward.
zh: 我不得不离开……躲起来。警方怀疑我与他的死有关，而我，我是个懦夫。

en: I had to think of something to stop her!
zh: 我必须想个办法阻止她！

en: I had to use the light from the refrigerator to work on my equations last night.
zh: 昨晚我只好借着冰箱的光算方程。

en: I hate TV at the best of times.
I hate that the chemistry department smoked in the lab hallway.
zh: 我讨厌化学系的人在实验室走廊里抽烟。

en: I hate to break into the tech room again, but it doesn't look like we have a choice.
zh: 我不想再闯进技术室，但看起来我们别无选择。

en: I have a contact at the National Credit Service. He can get anyone's financial transaction history.
zh: 我在国家信用服务局有个联系人。他能拿到任何人的金融交易记录。

en: I have a credit card statement showing that he spent a lot of money here.
zh: 我有信用卡账单显示他在这里花了很多钱。

en: I have a credit card statement suggesting that you did.
zh: 我有信用卡账单表明你确实建过。

en: I have a credit card statement that proves you did.
zh: 我有信用卡账单证明你确实建过。

en: I have a giant squid!
I have contacts. People who live under the radar. You need to know something, they can get it.
zh: 我有线人。活在雷达底下的人。你想知道什么，他们都能搞到。

en: I have no idea what I'm looking at.
zh: 我完全看不懂这是什么。

en: I have no idea what an FTTN is. I've never seen it on any medical chart, I know that.
zh: 我不知道FTTN是什么。我从没在任何病历上见过，这点我确定。

en: I have no idea what any of these gadgets do.
zh: 我完全不知道这些小玩意儿是干什么的。

en: I have no idea what any of those things do.
zh: 我完全不知道那些东西是干什么的。

en: I have no idea what that thing is, but it's dripping blood.
zh: 我不知道那东西是什么，但它在滴血。

en: I have no idea why.
I have no idea.
I have no idea. Oink tried to explain it to me, but I fell asleep halfway through.
zh: 我完全不知道。奥因克试着跟我解释过，但我听到一半就睡着了。

en: I have no idea. Our boy Ed might be a scumbag, but he's no dummy.
zh: 我不知道。我们这位埃德也许是个混蛋，但他可不傻。

en: I have no idea. You  know this place better than I do.
zh: 我不知道。这地方你比我熟。

en: I have no particular desire to add the post office sign to my posessions.
zh: 我没什么特别的兴趣把邮局的招牌加进我的财产里。

en: I have no reason to leave the apartment. I need to call Dr. Morales back first.
zh: 我没有理由离开公寓。我得先给莫拉莱斯博士回电话。

en: I have no reason to leave the apartment. I need to figure out who called me first.
zh: 我没有理由离开公寓。我得先弄清楚是谁给我打的电话。

en: I have no way of getting in there.
I have some more questions.
I have some questions for you too but they can wait for tomorrow.
zh: 我也有几个问题要问你，不过可以等到明天。

en: I have something that might help.
zh: 我有样东西也许能帮上忙。

en: I have that phone already.
I have these blueprints of Juno Labs. Could you tell me where you built the vault?
zh: 我有朱诺实验室的这些蓝图。你能告诉我你把保险库建在哪里了吗？

en: I have this ... thing.
I have to admit, it's tempting. But no. I'm happy where I am.
zh: 我得承认，这挺诱人的。但还是算了。我对现在的位置很满意。

en: I have to admit. I know things are dire and we're in a race to get these Resonance devices and all...
zh: 我得承认。我知道情况紧急，我们还在争分夺秒地找这些共振装置……

en: I have to borrow some of these, ma'am.
I have to go.
I have to say - I'm really impressed by all your security.
zh: 我得说——你这儿的安保让我印象深刻。

en: I have to trust him.
I haven't accomplished all the goals in my notes yet.
zh: 我还没完成笔记里的所有目标。

en: I haven't answered all the questions in my notes yet.
zh: 我还没回答完笔记里的所有问题。

en: I haven't been here in a long time.
I haven't seen a single construction worker up on the roof since we started this case.
zh: 从我们接手这案子起，我在楼顶就没见过一个建筑工人。

en: I haven't seen that style of bus stop for at least ten years now.
zh: 这种样式的公交站，我至少有十年没见过了。

en: I haven't seen you since that thing that we did regarding that person.
zh: 自从我们为那个人做的那件事之后，我就没见过你了。

en: I haven't spoken to him since I was a kid.
zh: 我从小就没跟他说过话。

en: I haven't used this thing except when I propped it open last night because I needed the light.
zh: 除了昨晚我需要光线把它撑开之外，我没用过这东西。

en: I haven't, but we pulled a fast one on the police before. Maybe we can do it again.
zh: 我没忘，但我们以前骗过警察。也许可以再来一次。

en: I heard Stanford's following up on some suspected Islamic radicals.
zh: 我听说斯坦福在追查一些可疑的伊斯兰激进分子。

en: I heard you before. Could you stop moaning about it?
zh: 我刚才听见了。你能不能别再抱怨了？

en: I honestly don't know much about them.
zh: 说实话，我对它们了解不多。

en: I hope I don't have to climb up there again.
zh: 希望我不用再爬上去一次。

en: I hope I don't need to use this.
I hope I made a good impression.
zh: 我希望我留下了好印象。

en: I hope I make a good first impression.
zh: 我希望我能留下好的第一印象。

en: I hope Reggie's payin' attention.
I hope she keeps believing I'm an authorised repairman.
zh: 我希望她继续相信我是授权维修工。

en: I hope that door leads somewhere interesting, after all that effort.
zh: 费了这么大劲，希望那扇门通向有趣的地方。

en: I hope that fire unit gets here soon. This does not look good.
zh: 我希望消防队快点到。这看起来不妙。

en: I hope the bad guys don't start chasing us through here. I could probably hop over that fence, but you...
zh: 希望那些坏蛋不会追着我们穿过这里。我大概能翻过那道栅栏，但你……

en: I hope the owner of this thing has insurance.
zh: 希望这东西的主人有保险。

en: I hope they haven't cancelled my password yet.
zh: 希望他们还没注销我的密码。

en: I hope this forklift can handle the weight...
zh: 希望这台叉车能承受得住这个重量……

en: I hope we're not too late.
I hope you feel the same way.[[Yours,[Steve
zh: 我希望你也有同感。[[你的，[史蒂夫

en: I hope you will forgive me... my Anna Angel.
zh: 我希望你能原谅我……我的安娜天使。

en: I hoped that I could live with uncle Javi.
zh: 我曾希望能和哈维叔叔一起生活。

en: I hurt my shoulder when I was a kid.
I imagine the security business is doing pretty well for you.
zh: 我猜你的安保生意做得挺不错。

en: I imagine your patients must be missing you. Will they be okay without you?
zh: 我想你的病人一定很想你。没有你他们能行吗？

en: I just don't feel like climbing the giant crane.
zh: 我就是不想爬那台巨大的起重机。

en: I just don't understand.
I just need a boost. Can't you just try?
zh: 我只需要你托我一把。你就不能试试吗？

en: I just need to know what I'm looking for.
zh: 我只需要知道自己在找什么。

en: I just need to remember the secret knock.
zh: 我只需要记起那个暗号敲门声。

en: I just need to talk to my buddy. He'll help us out.
zh: 我只需要跟我哥们谈谈。他会帮我们的。

en: I just really didn't want to have to tell you this.
zh: 我真的不想告诉你这件事。

en: I just remembered I haven't charged my phone in three days. I hope the battery lasts.
zh: 我刚想起来我三天没给手机充电了。希望电池撑得住。

en: I just remembered something I had to do.
zh: 我刚想起有件事得去做。

en: I just stopped the timer, now give it to me.
zh: 我刚停了计时器，现在把它给我。

en: I just thought... you know, guy talk.
zh: 我只是觉得……你知道，男人之间的闲聊。

en: I just... I don't understand why this had to happen.
zh: 我只是……我不明白为什么会发生这种事。

en: I just... noticed!
I just... the coin is just something I'd rather not talk about.
zh: 我只是……那枚硬币的事，我还是不想谈。

en: I keep a hamper near my bed. Throwing my clothes on the floor would only make them dirtier.
zh: 我在床边放了个洗衣篮。把衣服扔地上只会让它们更脏。

en: I keep all my little gadgets in there.
zh: 我所有的小玩意儿都放在那里。

en: I keep it in the maintenance closet.
I keep my alarm clock next to my bed.
I keep my treasure in there.
I kinda daze out when Ed starts talkin' science.
zh: 埃德一开口讲科学我就走神。

en: I kinda daze out when you start talkin' science.
zh: 你一开口讲科学我就走神。

en: I knew I should have been complaining more about the chemistry department's smoking!
zh: 我就知道我该多抱怨抱怨化学系的人抽烟的事！

en: I knew he was hiding things from me. I knew it.
zh: 我就知道他有事瞒着我。我就知道。

en: I knew he was up to something!
zh: 我就知道他在搞什么名堂！

en: I knew it!
I knew the chief had it in for me, but I didn't know she had it this bad.
zh: 我知道局长针对我，但没想到这么严重。

en: I knew there was something odd about that construction site.
zh: 我就知道那个工地有点不对劲。

en: I knew you didn't have anything.
I knew you sounded shady so I did some checking up on you, Amul.
zh: 我就觉得你听起来鬼鬼祟祟的，所以查了查你，阿穆尔。

en: I know better than to be messing with electrified water.
zh: 我可知道不能碰带电的水。

en: I know enough about that thing to know not to touch.
zh: 我对那东西了解得够多，知道不能碰。

en: I know her a little.
I know how to keep out of sight.
I know my own strength and that is beyond it.
zh: 我知道自己的力气有多大，那超出了我的能力。

en: I know she has the key to solving Doctor Morales' murder. Somehow.
zh: 我知道她掌握着解开莫拉莱斯博士谋杀案的关键。不知怎么的。

en: I know that painting. "Blood under a Microscope," right?
zh: 我认得那幅画。《显微镜下的血》，对吧？

en: I know they built the archive. Why?
zh: 我知道档案库是他们建的。怎么了？

en: I know!
I know, I know.
I know, it's OK.
I know, right? Otherwise, I might be able to hack in.
zh: 我知道，对吧？不然我或许还能黑进去。

en: I know.
I know. But I don't understand...
I know. He hasn't shut up about it since he got it.
zh: 我知道。他拿到之后就没停过嘴。

en: I know. I also know what the Eleven Foundation has done. Lesser of two evils. I'm sorry.
zh: 我知道。我也知道十一基金会做过什么。两害相权取其轻。对不起。

en: I let you do it. I helped you do it. I'm just as culpable as you are.
zh: 是我让你做的。是我帮你做的。我跟你一样有罪。

en: I like action and having fun, and dislike sitting in offices and wearing suits.[[My life moves as fast as my stock car down the final stretch and that's how I like it.[[I'm looking for someone to take to the movies, and enjoy some fine dining on the town.[[
zh: 我喜欢行动和找乐子，讨厌坐在办公室里穿西装。[[我的人生就像我的赛车在最后直道上一样飞驰，我就喜欢这样。[[我想找个人一起看电影，在城里享受美食。[[

en: I like her.
I like it though.
I like it!
I like that logo. Very cute.
zh: 我喜欢那个标志。很可爱。

en: I like that one.
I like the sign.
I like the title.
I like the vibe.
I like this one.
I like you, Detective.  No beating around the bush. Just business.
zh: 我喜欢你，警探。不拐弯抹角。直奔正题。

en: I live for my art.
I look the other way because he's my pal, but one day he's gonna get us both in trouble.
zh: 他是我哥们，所以我睁一只眼闭一只眼，但总有一天他会把咱俩都拖下水。

en: I looked everywhere, and it turns out-
zh: 我到处都找遍了，结果发现——

en: I lost a car once.
I love signing classic cars out of the impound lot.
zh: 我最喜欢从扣押场里领出经典老爷车。

en: I love these little back doors.
I loved the Wizard of Oz when I was little.
zh: 我小时候很喜欢《绿野仙踪》。

en: I loved your piece on invasive ground squirrel species affecting the local rodentia population.
zh: 我很喜欢你写的那篇关于入侵性地松鼠物种影响当地啮齿动物种群的文章。

en: I made a promise to stop swiping random junk, and I mean to stick to it.
zh: 我承诺过不再顺手拿杂七杂八的东西，我打算说到做到。

en: I managed to pry the doors open. Nothing stands between me and the darkness now.
zh: 我设法撬开了门。现在我和黑暗之间再无阻隔。

en: I managed to pry them open to escape when the brownout hit.
zh: 停电那会儿，我硬是把它们撬开逃了出来。

en: I mean it.
I mean, I definitely would, if I were you.
zh: 我是说，如果我是你，我肯定会好奇的。

en: I mean, you're probably looking for some way to escape this conversation, and here I am asking personal questions.
zh: 我是说，你大概正想找机会逃离这场对话，而我却在这儿问私人问题。

en: I might as well swab this again.
I might be able to force them open.
I might be able to get to Dr. Morales.
zh: 我也许能到莫拉莱斯博士那儿。

en: I might be questioning a few suspects today.
zh: 我今天可能要审问几个嫌疑人。

en: I might cut myself.
I might find a use for this.
I might get a warrant for Ozzie's house when this is all over.
zh: 等这一切结束后，我也许能拿到搜查奥兹家的搜查令。

en: I might have agreed with you once, but now?
zh: 我以前也许会同意你，但现在？

en: I might need the interrogation room.
I might take one later.
I miss Henry, the old pharmacist.
zh: 我想念亨利，那位老药剂师。

en: I miss Mama.
I miss cash.
I miss my bed.
I miss you, Uncle Javi.
I must have written it down... s-somewhere...
zh: 我一定把它写下来了……在、在什么地方……

en: I must've dozed off while looking at Uncle Javi's journal...
zh: 我一定是看着哈维叔叔的日记时睡着了……

en: I must've dozed off...
I must've fallen asleep while reading. Thank God I'm still wearing my clothes.
zh: 我肯定是看书时睡着了。谢天谢地，我还穿着衣服。

en: I must've left it in there when I took them off last night.
zh: 昨晚脱裤子时肯定把它落在里面了。

en: I need a document from the city archives.
zh: 我需要市档案馆的一份文件。

en: I need a keyhole for this key.
zh: 我需要一个配得上这把钥匙的锁孔。

en: I need a wrench.
I need access to that mainframe.
I need an ambulance at the Juno Lab immediately.
zh: 我需要一辆救护车立刻赶到朱诺实验室。

en: I need an egghead.
I need another copy of that will.
zh: 我需要那份遗嘱的副本。

en: I need another one of your little... favors.
zh: 我需要你再帮我一个小……忙。

en: I need it now, mi t%o!
I need some hard evidence.
I need some kind of hard evidence tying him to a crime.
zh: 我需要某种确凿证据，把他和犯罪联系起来。

en: I need something a bit more incisive.
I need the financial records of a man who recently died.
zh: 我需要一个最近去世的人的财务记录。

en: I need to continue deeper.
I need to distract Johnsen somehow.
zh: 我得想办法分散约翰森的注意力。

en: I need to figure out what it means.
zh: 我得弄清楚它是什么意思。

en: I need to find a way off this fire escape, quickly.
zh: 我得赶紧想办法离开这个防火梯。

en: I need to find a way through these bars.
zh: 我得想办法穿过这些栅栏。

en: I need to find a way to get you inside, too.
zh: 我也得想办法把你弄进去。

en: I need to find a way to watch the target. I don't know for sure he came from the other side of the fence.
zh: 我得想办法盯住目标。我不确定他是不是从围栏另一边过来的。

en: I need to find him something he wants.
zh: 我得找点他想要的东西。

en: I need to get Johnsen out of the way first.
I need to get a building's blueprint from the city archive.
zh: 我需要从市档案馆拿到一栋建筑的蓝图。

en: I need to get a copy of the Juno Laboratory's blueprints.
zh: 我需要拿一份朱诺实验室蓝图的副本。

en: I need to get a document from the city archives.
zh: 我需要从市档案馆取一份文件。

en: I need to get a document out of the city archives.
zh: 我需要从市档案馆取一份文件。

en: I need to get closer.
I need to get her to let me stay in the room alone with the mainframe.
zh: 我得让她同意让我单独和主机待在房间里。

en: I need to get in there to trace the phone number we found on this resonance device.
zh: 我得进去追踪我们在共振设备上找到的电话号码。

en: I need to get into the building NOW, and I can't climb up by myself.
zh: 我现在就得进那栋楼，可我自己爬不上去。

en: I need to get into the lab IMMEDIATELY.
zh: 我需要立刻进入实验室。

en: I need to get rid of her so I can find out what they are hiding.
zh: 我得把她支开，才能查出他们在隐瞒什么。

en: I need to get upstairs.
I need to hold onto it for now.
I need to hold onto this.
I need to keep out of Johnsen's way.
I need to keep these with me.
I need to keep this stuff for now, because of the magnets.
zh: 因为那些磁铁，我现在得留着这些东西。

en: I need to know about my uncle's vault.
zh: 我需要知道我叔叔的保险库的事。

en: I need to know how to find the vault. Is there anything here that can help me?
zh: 我需要知道怎么找到保险库。这里有什么能帮我的吗？

en: I need to know whether anyone unusual has been in here looking at the mainframe today?
zh: 我想知道今天有没有什么不寻常的人来这里看过主机？

en: I need to lock Ed out somehow!
zh: 我得想办法把埃德锁在外面！

en: I need to move it to get into the building.
zh: 我得把它挪开才能进楼。

en: I need to see a therapist about this obsessive behavior.
zh: 我这强迫症得去看心理医生了。

en: I need to see that death certificate.
zh: 我需要看那份死亡证明。

en: I need to swipe my hospital ID.
I need to take a look at some of your files.
zh: 我需要看看你的一些文件。

en: I need to take care of it.
I need to talk to Ozzy about that.
zh: 我得找奥兹谈谈这件事。

en: I need to think about this.
I need to try using something thinner first.
zh: 我得先试试更薄的东西。

en: I need to use a terminal.
I need to use this on something.
zh: 我得把这个用在什么东西上。

en: I need to watch it.
I need two things to get at anyone's records.
zh: 要查任何人的记录，我需要两样东西。

en: I need you to help me access a high-security document.
zh: 我需要你帮我访问一份高安全级别的文件。

en: I need you to tell me about that vault.
zh: 我需要你告诉我那个保险库的事。

en: I need you to tell me about the vault.
zh: 我需要你告诉我保险库的事。

en: I need you to tell me exactly what happened this morning.
zh: 我需要你告诉我今天早上到底发生了什么。

en: I need you to tell me how I can access documents above my security clearance.
zh: 我需要你告诉我，怎样才能访问超出我安全权限的文件。

en: I need your help on the city archives.
zh: 我需要你帮忙查市档案馆。

en: I needed to get you out of the way.
I never forget my friends!
zh: 我永远不会忘记我的朋友！

en: I never had much of a green thumb.
I never knew the man, myself. You'd have better luck figuring that out than I would.
zh: 我自己从没见过那个人。你查这个比我更有戏。

en: I never really knew my uncle Angelo.
zh: 我其实不怎么了解安杰洛叔叔。

en: I never said I actually intended on sending it.
zh: 我从没说过我真打算把它寄出去。

en: I never said it was wrong, per se...
zh: 我本身从没说过那不对……

en: I never thought about them holding someone in.
zh: 我从没想过它们也能把人关在里面。

en: I never understood art.
I only engage in menial labour for the express purpose of infiltration.
zh: 我只为潜入的目的才从事体力杂活。

en: I only got here a few minutes before you did!
I only need to clip this on when I'm on duty.
zh: 我只需要在执勤时把这个夹上。

en: I only sneak into patient's rooms if there's a *really* good story to be had.
zh: 只有在有*非常*好的故事可挖时，我才会溜进病房。

en: I only started here a week ago.
zh: 我才刚来这儿一个星期。

en: I only use them when I need a complicated simulation, or a brute-force solution.
zh: 我只在需要复杂模拟或暴力求解时才用它们。

en: I picked up that microwave on the cheap.
zh: 那台微波炉是我便宜买来的。

en: I plan to go in the front door. Less effort.
zh: 我打算走前门。省点力气。

en: I planted those notes.
I prefer my car.
zh: 我还是更喜欢自己的车。

en: I prefer solving crime the old-fashioned way.
zh: 我更喜欢用老办法破案。

en: I prefer to play "bad cop."
I prefer to think of myself as a sanitation engineer.
zh: 我更愿意把自己看作卫生工程师。

en: I probably shouldn't show her that...
zh: 我大概不该给她看那个……

en: I promise I'm not like a stalker or anything!
zh: 我保证我不是什么跟踪狂之类的！

en: I promise you
I promise.
I propose a trade.
I pulled this off one of the ladder mechanisms on the side of my building.
zh: 这是我从我公寓楼侧面的一个梯子装置上拆下来的。

en: I put one in this jar every day I was away.
zh: 我离开的每一天都往这个罐子里放一枚。

en: I put them on display, no one even glances at them!
zh: 我把它们摆出来展示，可连看都没人看一眼！

en: I radioed in for fire support, but all the trucks are deployed around the city right now.
zh: 我呼叫了消防支援，但现在全城的消防车都派出去了。

en: I read it on this website I visit.
zh: 我在我常看的那个网站上读到的。

en: I really don't know why I did that. I could have just gone in the main entrance.
zh: 我真不知道我为什么那样做。我本可以直接从正门进去的。

en: I really don't need other doctors' paperwork as well as my own.
zh: 我真的不需要除了自己的文件之外，还要别的医生的文件。

en: I really don't think starting a conversation with him about that is necessary or well-advised.
zh: 我真觉得没必要也不该跟他谈那件事。

en: I really don't think that's a good idea.
zh: 我真的觉得那不是个好主意。

en: I really don't understand why people spoil a perfectly good wall with cheap art.
zh: 我真不明白为什么人们要用廉价艺术品糟蹋一面完好的墙。

en: I really don't want to cart round random paintings.
zh: 我真不想随身带着些乱七八糟的画到处跑。

en: I really don't want to go there.
I really doubt that would do anything.
zh: 我很怀疑那能有什么用。

en: I really hope it doesn't come to that, because there is no way I'm fitting in there.
zh: 我真希望不会到那一步，因为我根本挤不进去。

en: I really hope we don't have to go up there.
zh: 我真希望我们不用上去那里。

en: I really miss frozen pizza.
I really must get back to obeying the law, now. Bye.
zh: 我真的得回去守法了。再见。

en: I really need to get a security system, but the prices listed here are outrageous.
zh: 我确实该装个安防系统，但这里标的价格太离谱了。

en: I really need to know about that vault.
zh: 我真的需要知道那个保险库的事。

en: I really need your help with the city archives.
zh: 我真的需要你帮忙查市档案馆。

en: I really screwed up there.
I really should report this.
zh: 我真的应该上报这件事。

en: I remember clearly that our suspect went through a door, not over the fence.
zh: 我记得很清楚，我们的嫌疑人是从一扇门进去的，不是翻栅栏。

en: I remember enough high school science to know that water plus electricity equals bad.
zh: 我高中科学还记得够清楚，水加电等于糟糕。

en: I remember him being over at our house a lot, visiting with my parents and me.
zh: 我记得他常来我们家，看望我父母和我。

en: I remember something.
I remember something...
I removed the old rusted pipe from the sprinkler system.
zh: 我从喷淋系统上拆下了那根生锈的旧管子。

en: I replaced the old rusted pipe from the sprinkler system with a newer one.
zh: 我把喷淋系统里那根生锈的旧管子换成了新的。

en: I said clean up this room!
zh: 我说过把这房间收拾干净！

en: I said forget it!
I said that was none of your business. Now drop it.
zh: 我说过那不关你的事。别再提了。

en: I saw Dr. Morales die with my own eyes, and now I have to prove it?
zh: 我亲眼看着莫拉莱斯博士死了，现在还得我来证明？

en: I saw a bar decorated like that once.
zh: 我见过一家酒吧装修成那样。

en: I saw a fire start through the glass doors.
zh: 我看到玻璃门后有火燃起。

en: I saw him come in here the other...
zh: 我看见他进来的，就在另一……

en: I saw the award on the wall. Congratulations.
zh: 我看到墙上的奖了。恭喜。

en: I saw the award on the wall. Nice job.
zh: 我看到墙上的奖了。干得漂亮。

en: I saw the lights go out, and then it got hot, and I felt a vibration...
zh: 我看见灯灭了，然后变热了，我感觉到一阵震动……

en: I saw uncle Javi's body in the morgue.
zh: 我在太平间看到了哈维叔叔的尸体。

en: I see a lot of addicts like him.
zh: 我见过很多像他这样的瘾君子。

en: I see a lot of dead bodies in my line of work.
zh: 干我这行，我见过很多尸体。

en: I see her on the elevator and in the cafeteria, sometimes.
zh: 我有时在电梯和食堂见到她。

en: I see you on the train every day.
zh: 我每天都在车上见到你。

en: I see you've got some paperwork piled up.
zh: 我看你桌上堆了不少文件。

en: I see.
I see...
I set up my own news website, the AbbotPost.
zh: 我自己办了个新闻网站，叫AbbotPost。

en: I should ask her about it before we go any further.
zh: 在我们继续之前，我应该先问问她这件事。

en: I should ask her some questions.
I should ask you the same thing!
I should be more careful with my cell.
I should find a way through those doors.
zh: 我应该想办法穿过那些门。

en: I should find a way to get a better look at that water leak.
zh: 我该想办法更仔细地看看那处漏水。

en: I should get closer.
I should give this to Ed.
I should give this to Ozzy.
zh: 我应该把这个交给奥兹。

en: I should handle these myself.
I should hold on to the page with the results.
zh: 我应该留着那页有结果的。

en: I should just get what I need and fast.
zh: 我得赶紧拿到我需要的东西。

en: I should just stop talking, shouldn't I?
I should just wrap the wire around it.
zh: 我只要把电线缠上去就行。

en: I should open the curtain first.
I should place both of you under arrest.
zh: 我应该把你们俩都逮捕。

en: I should probably avoid talking about it while Bennet's around.
zh: 贝内特在的时候我大概不该谈这件事。

en: I should probably just get the notes, shouldn't I?
zh: 我还是直接去拿笔记吧，对吧？

en: I should probably just hand it to her.
zh: 我大概应该直接把它交给她。

en: I should probably wait until we are out of earshot.
zh: 我大概该等我们走到听不见的地方再说。

en: I should probably wait until we are somewhere else.
zh: 我大概该等我们到别处再说。

en: I should see if they got round to it.
zh: 我该看看他们去了没有。

en: I should see if they have my DNA in here...
zh: 我该看看这里有没有我的DNA……

en: I should seriously stop before I electrocute myself.
zh: 我真该停手了，免得把自己电死。

en: I should start there.
I should take a closer look at that lock.
I should try just looking at the paper.
zh: 我应该直接看看那张纸。

en: I should try the handle.
I should use a cotton swab containing a DNA sample.
zh: 我应该用一根沾有DNA样本的棉签。

en: I shouldn't be leaving this just lying around.
zh: 我不该把这东西随便乱放。

en: I shouldn't be swinging this heavy thing around.
zh: 我不该把这重东西甩来甩去。

en: I shouldn't be tossing away what isn't mine.
zh: 我不该把不属于我的东西扔掉。

en: I shouldn't bother her about that any more.
zh: 我不该再拿那件事烦她了。

en: I shouldn't contaminate the crime-scene with my fingerprints.
zh: 我不该用指纹污染犯罪现场。

en: I shouldn't give him anything.
I shouldn't let on that I overheard that conversation.
zh: 我不该让他们知道我偷听到了那段对话。

en: I shouldn't mess with these or I might contaminate the sample.
zh: 我不该乱动这些，否则可能污染样本。

en: I shudder to think about the power these resonance devices have.
zh: 一想到这些共振装置的威力，我就不寒而栗。

en: I smelled a story. So I followed you guys.
zh: 我嗅到了新闻。所以就跟着你们了。

en: I somehow don't want to go hang out with the vegetables.
zh: 不知怎的，我不想去和那些植物人待在一起。

en: I spent hours verifying these equations for Doctor Morales.
zh: 我花了几个小时为莫拉莱斯博士验证这些方程式。

en: I spent plenty of time arresting vandals when I was a beat cop.
zh: 我当巡警的时候，可没少花时间抓破坏公物的人。

en: I spent too much time in cubicles before landing my dream job as an investigative journalist.
zh: 在当上调查记者这份梦寐以求的工作之前，我在格子间里待了太久。

en: I spent weeks on these and couldn't even sell them for ten bucks at the art show.
zh: 我花了好几周画这些，在艺术展上连十块钱都卖不出去。

en: I started out working the copier at the Aventine Star.
zh: 我一开始就是在阿文廷星报操作复印机的。

en: I still have Dr. Morales' notes. I just need a lab and a team...
zh: 我还有莫拉莱斯博士的笔记。我只需要一个实验室和一个团队……

en: I still keep it close.
I still need to clear away that slab of concrete before I can go inside.
zh: 我还得先清掉那块混凝土板才能进去。

en: I still need to put out that fire before I can go inside.
zh: 我还得先把那火扑灭才能进去。

en: I still need to stop power to those cables before I can go inside.
zh: 我还得先切断那些电缆的电源才能进去。

en: I suggest you point those accusations at Mr. Eddings.
zh: 我建议你把那些指控指向埃丁斯先生。

en: I suppose I haven't.
I suppose I should speak to her.
I suppose it could be used as a weapon.
I suppose that's possible...
I sure could, little man!
I sure did!
I sure do. He's a fine officer.
zh: 当然认识。他是个好警官。

en: I swear to God, if you step out of line...
zh: 我对天发誓，你要是敢越界……

en: I take that back about the charm.
zh: 我收回刚才说魅力的话。

en: I think I can fit in here.
I think I can manage to stay awake for now.
zh: 我想我现在还能保持清醒。

en: I think I can remove that flap.
zh: 我想我能把那个翻盖取下来。

en: I think I finally understand how the copier works now.
zh: 我想我终于明白复印机怎么用了。

en: I think I got it!
I think I made a wrong turn somewhere.
zh: 我想我是在哪儿拐错弯了。

en: I think I might have come into contact with one of those, but where?
zh: 我想我可能接触过其中一个，但在哪儿呢？

en: I think I offended Ozzy somehow.
zh: 我好像不知怎么得罪奥兹了。

en: I think I should start by hooking it up to the primary pin.
zh: 我想我应该先把它接到主引脚上。

en: I think I'd better leave him be.
I think I'd prefer to find a more subtle way in.
zh: 我想我还是找个更隐蔽的方式进去吧。

en: I think I'd prefer to simple walk in the door.
zh: 我想我还是更愿意直接走门进去。

en: I think I'd rather hold it for now.
I think I'll keep it - it'll save a lot of paper work.
zh: 我想我会留着它——这能省下很多文书工作。

en: I think I'll keep my cell phone with me.
zh: 我想我还是把手机带在身上。

en: I think I'll leave him be.
I think I'll leave it alone.
I think I'll leave that alone.
I think I'll let it drop.
I think I'll stay over here until that electrified water is out of the way, thank you.
zh: 我想我还是待在这边，等那片带电的水消失再说，谢谢。

en: I think I'll take the slow way downstairs.
zh: 我想我还是走楼梯慢慢下去吧。

en: I think I've taken this about as far as I can.
I think Ray was supposed to introduce us to somebody.
zh: 我记得雷说要介绍个人给我们认识。

en: I think all the flashy lights are just for effect.
zh: 我觉得那些闪来闪去的灯纯粹是装样子。

en: I think every head doctor downstairs had one of these in their office.
zh: 我想楼下每个心理医生办公室里都有一幅这样的画。

en: I think he might be behind my uncle's death.
zh: 我觉得他可能跟我叔叔的死有关。

en: I think he really believes in his work.
zh: 我觉得他是真心相信自己的工作。

en: I think it may be a fern, but I'm not sure.
zh: 我觉得这可能是蕨类，但我不确定。

en: I think it would be a good idea to get a look at that computer.
zh: 我觉得去看看那台电脑是个好主意。

en: I think it's loose enough to...
I think it's time to see the wizard.
zh: 我想是时候去见巫师了。

en: I think not.
I think so.
I think someone already did.
zh: 我想已经有人这么做了。

en: I think someone was-
I think that broken window's the only way in.
zh: 我觉得那扇破窗户是唯一的入口。

en: I think that entering a combination into the keypad turns these pins on and off.
zh: 我想在键盘上输入组合会开关这些引脚。

en: I think that goes to the basement.
zh: 我想那是通往地下室的。

en: I think that might be a little hazardous.
zh: 我觉得那可能有点危险。

en: I think that's the computer terminal for accessing the Antevorta mainframe.
zh: 我想那是用来访问Antevorta主机的电脑终端。

en: I think that's the security room.
I think the artist was trying to convey the feeling of working in the fields on a hot summer morning.
zh: 我觉得画家是想表达在炎夏清晨田间劳作的感觉。

en: I think the blueprints are all we need for now.
zh: 我觉得目前有蓝图就够了。

en: I think the sound is coming from my pants...
zh: 我觉得声音是从我裤子里传出来的……

en: I think the water just locked us out.
zh: 我觉得是水把我们锁在外面了。

en: I think the water leak shorted the access panel, slamming the door shut.
zh: 我觉得是漏水让门禁面板短路了，把门锁死了。

en: I think these things are used for cleaning out ears, not cleaning off phones.
zh: 我觉得这东西是用来掏耳朵的，不是用来擦手机的。

en: I think these things are used for cleaning out ears, not cleaning out discarded aluminum cans.
zh: 我觉得这东西是用来掏耳朵的，不是用来清理废弃铝罐的。

en: I think they have several offices.
zh: 我想他们有好几间办公室。

en: I think this is how it's supposed to work.
zh: 我想这应该是它的运作方式。

en: I think this is it!
I think this pin feeds electricity to the grid.
zh: 我觉得这个引脚向电网供电。

en: I think this wire used to connect the primary pin to the terminal pin through the intermediary pins.
zh: 我想这根电线以前是通过中间引脚把主引脚连接到终端引脚的。

en: I think we can use both switches to toggle those moving catwalks. We don't have to be on the second level.
zh: 我想我们可以用两个开关来切换那些移动的通道。我们不必待在二层。

en: I think we have all the information Mr. Tortoise needs. Let's get over there.
zh: 我想托托伊斯先生需要的信息我们都有了。我们过去吧。

en: I think we learned today that alarms are bad.
zh: 我想我们今天学到了，警报器很糟糕。

en: I think we might need some sort of tool to help open it.
zh: 我觉得我们可能需要什么工具来帮忙打开它。

en: I think we need to take a closer look at that phone.
zh: 我觉得我们得仔细看看那部手机。

en: I think we should trust him.
zh: 我觉得我们应该相信他。

en: I think we'd better take a look around the lab. Make sure everything's okay.
zh: 我想我们最好在实验室里四处看看。确保一切正常。

en: I think we've learned today that alarms are bad.
zh: 我想我们今天学到了，警报器很糟糕。

en: I think you should take it easy on the pills and have a glass of water.
zh: 我觉得你该少吃点药，喝杯水。

en: I think you'll like these better.
I think you're in enough trouble already. No need for more violence, right?
zh: 我觉得你麻烦已经够多了。没必要再动粗，对吧？

en: I thought he blamed me for his brother's death.
zh: 我以为他把兄弟的死怪在我头上。

en: I thought so.
I thought the archives were here.
I thought the city was too broke for new construction projects.
zh: 我还以为这座城市穷得搞不起新工程了。

en: I thought the hospital was going broke.
zh: 我还以为医院快破产了。

en: I thought there would be more police in this police station.
zh: 我以为警察局里会有更多警察。

en: I thought you had forgotten about your old pal, the wizard.
zh: 我还以为你把你老朋友，那个巫师，给忘了。

en: I thought you said you weren't a stalker.
zh: 我记得你说过你不是跟踪狂。

en: I thought you were maintenance.
I thought you worked the early morning shift?
zh: 我以为你上的是清晨班？

en: I told him that I was trying to get into it too.
zh: 我跟他说我也正想入门。

en: I told you I broke my ankle getting out of the building, didn't I?
zh: 我告诉过你，我逃出大楼时摔断了脚踝，对吧？

en: I told you someone was following us!
zh: 我告诉过你有人在跟踪我们！

en: I told you, I can't go anywhere 'cause of my ankle, remember?
zh: 我告诉过你，因为我的脚踝，我哪儿也去不了，记得吗？

en: I told you. I can't just give that information away. That's priveleged information.
zh: 我说过了。我不能随便透露那个信息。那是特权信息。

en: I took measurements.
I took some vacation time because of my uncle's death.
zh: 我因为叔叔去世请了假。

en: I traced his phone to the hospital!
zh: 我追踪到他的手机信号在医院！

en: I traced it to Ed's apartment.
I traced it to a warehouse near Juno Labs.
zh: 我追踪到朱诺实验室附近的一个仓库。

en: I tracked Mr. Abbot's cell phone.
zh: 我追踪了阿博特先生的手机。

en: I trust Bennet.
I trusted them. I... did these horrible things for them.
zh: 我信任过他们。我……为他们做了那些可怕的事。

en: I try not to think about those days.
zh: 我尽量不去想那些日子。

en: I try to avoid nurses of the non-"naughty" variety.
zh: 我尽量避开那种不“调皮”的护士。

en: I try to keep out of the offices.
I understand, Detective. Just give me a while. It *is* my uncle, after all.
zh: 我明白，警探。再给我一点时间，毕竟那*可是*我叔叔。

en: I unscrewed the magnet from the lock.
zh: 我把磁铁从锁上拧了下来。

en: I use the wrench I keep in the maintenance closet.
zh: 我用维修间里那把扳手。

en: I use these drawers to store some electronics and other items I need for my work.
zh: 我用这些抽屉存放一些电子设备和工作中需要的其他东西。

en: I used to come here a lot when I broke my shoulder as a kid.
zh: 我小时候摔断肩膀时，常来这里。

en: I used to do the same thing at the Aventine Star.
zh: 我以前在阿文廷星报也干过同样的事。

en: I used to keep all my treasures in that chest...
zh: 我以前把所有宝贝都收在那个箱子里……

en: I used to market it to children, until some kid locked his dad's wallet in it and forgot the combination.
zh: 我以前把它卖给小孩，直到有个孩子把他爸的钱包锁在里面，还忘了密码。

en: I used to sit under the window and listen to my mama read stories.
zh: 我以前常坐在窗下听妈妈读故事。

en: I used to work for the Aventine Star, but print media is dead.
zh: 我以前为《阿文廷星报》工作，但纸媒已经死了。

en: I usually end up standing on the subway holding on to one of these for dear life.
zh: 我坐地铁时通常都是抓着其中一根拼命站稳。

en: I want to help you.
I wanted to protect Resonance, yes, but there's so much more at stake now...
zh: 我确实想保护共振，没错，但现在有远比这更重要的东西……

en: I was asking about what happened at the laboratory, sir.
zh: 我问的是实验室里发生了什么，先生。

en: I was at the hospital working on another story and I heard the two of you talking about this vault and how the police may be involved...
zh: 我当时在医院做另一篇报道，听到你们俩在谈论那个保险库，还有警方可能牵涉其中……

en: I was at the part where I was mopping, right?
zh: 我说到我在拖地那部分，对吧？

en: I was betrayed myself. I've murdered two people, because I thought the end result would be worth it.
zh: 我自己也被背叛了。我杀了两个人，因为我觉得最终的结果值得。

en: I was going to go talk him out of it, I wasn't going to set that timer...
zh: 我本来打算去劝他放弃的，我没打算启动那个计时器……

en: I was just finishing the postmortem and death cert.
zh: 我刚做完尸检和死亡证明。

en: I was just going to go down to the mess and grab a bite.
zh: 我正打算去食堂吃点东西。

en: I was just in the middle of a very delicate operation, putting the final touches on a new safe.
zh: 我当时正在做一个非常精细的操作，给一个新保险箱做最后的收尾。

en: I was just walking through the park.
I was lucky that this apartment was on the market for so cheap when I needed it.
zh: 我很幸运，在我需要的时候这间公寓的租金这么便宜。

en: I was lucky, really. If I'd got off one stop later, I'd have been trapped on the train.
zh: 我运气真好。要是晚一站下车，我就被困在列车上了。

en: I was nearby, so they told me to check it out.
zh: 我当时就在附近，所以他们让我来看看。

en: I was on a subway headed here when all the lights went out.
zh: 灯全灭的时候，我正在来这里的地铁上。

en: I was on my way to see him.
I was raised by my grandparents.
I was sending cookies to my dear old gran in Newcastle.
zh: 我是给我在纽卡斯尔的亲爱的老奶奶寄饼干。

en: I was so scared of him.
I was too old, too weak, and too corrupt.
zh: 我太老了，太虚弱了，也太堕落了。

en: I was trained to do real police work. Not origami.
zh: 我受训是为了干真正的警察工作。不是折纸。

en: I was very close to him.
I was wondering when you'd come and see me!
zh: 我还在想你什么时候会来看我呢！

en: I was-
I wasn't aware that the mainframe was in need of repairs, sir.
zh: 我不知道主机需要维修，先生。

en: I wasn't even here.
I wasn't here when you saw him yesterday.
zh: 你昨天看到他的时候我不在场。

en: I went on a date and suddenly found myself with a whole lot more job security and the ability to choose my own hours.
zh: 我去赴了个约，突然发现自己工作保障多了不少，还能自己挑工作时间。

en: I went there a lot when I broke my shoulder as a kid.
zh: 我小时候摔断肩膀时经常去那里。

en: I will be. Thanks.
I will not let it all be for nothing!
I will not let your discovery be misused.
zh: 我不会让你的发现被滥用。

en: I will radio in for help only if I can't handle the situation here.
zh: 只有我处理不了这里的情况时，我才会用无线电求援。

en: I will.
I will... I will...
I wish I could get him to open up.
zh: 我希望我能让他敞开心扉。

en: I wish I could keep it, but Bennet would probably shoot me.
zh: 我真想留着它，但贝内特大概会开枪打我。

en: I wish I could, but I didn't supervise its construction. I just designed it and provided the materials.
zh: 我也想告诉你，但我没有监督它的建造。我只是设计了它并提供了材料。

en: I wish I did. I wasn't there, so I can't say for sure.
zh: 我希望我知道。我当时不在场，所以没法确定。

en: I wish I had answers for you, but I can tell you this: none of us are alone.
zh: 我希望我能给你答案，但我可以告诉你这一点：我们没有人是孤独的。

en: I wish I had answers for you. I wish I could understand the hearts and minds of the ones who did this.
zh: 我希望我能给你答案。我希望我能理解那些做出这种事的人的心和头脑。

en: I wish I had known before that this was a no-smoking zone.
zh: 我真希望早点知道这里是禁烟区。

en: I wish I'd been to see uncle Javi in his lab... before this all happened.
zh: 我真希望自己曾去哈维叔叔的实验室看过他……在这一切发生之前。

en: I won this in a game of poker from a computer hacker that I did a story on.
zh: 这是我做报道时从一个电脑黑客那里打扑克赢来的。

en: I won't even call you a coward. Well, not to your face.
zh: 我甚至不会叫你胆小鬼。好吧，不会当面叫。

en: I won't get rid of the image of Morales falling out of that door any time soon.
zh: 我短时间内忘不掉莫拉莱斯从那扇门里摔出来的画面。

en: I wonder if Morales made any more notes on this pad?
zh: 不知道莫拉莱斯有没有在这个本子上留下更多笔记？

en: I wonder if any of the mechanisms can fit inside each other?
zh: 不知道这些结构能不能互相嵌进去？

en: I wonder if the cop by the archive panel ever takes a break?
zh: 不知道档案室面板旁那个警察会不会休息？

en: I wonder if there's anything else useful in the archives.
zh: 不知道档案里还有没有别的有用的东西。

en: I wonder if they feel the same impatience that I feel when not serving their purposes.
zh: 不知道它们不发挥作用时，是否也和我一样不耐烦。

en: I wonder what effect the news that someone broke in and stole your files would have on your business' reputation.
zh: 我想知道，有人闯入并偷走你文件的消息，会对你的生意名声造成什么影响。

en: I wonder what happens if you turn off the power to the extended platforms?
zh: 不知道切断延伸平台的电源会怎样？

en: I wonder what he's getting up to in there.
zh: 不知道他在里面搞什么名堂。

en: I wonder what sort of narcotics he had in that pill bottle.
zh: 不知道他那个药瓶里装的是什么麻醉药。

en: I wonder what that was all about.
zh: 不知道那到底是怎么回事。

en: I wonder what they are building above the hospital?
zh: 不知道他们在医院上面建什么？

en: I wonder what was on them?
I wonder what's inside that beautiful safe.
zh: 不知道那个漂亮的保险箱里装着什么。

en: I wonder what's on TV?
zh: 不知道电视上在播什么？

en: I wonder where that door goes?
zh: 不知道那扇门通向哪里？

en: I wonder where that leads?
I wonder who he really works for?
zh: 不知道他到底为谁工作？

en: I wonder why there's a drawer under the terminal.
zh: 我想知道为什么终端下面有个抽屉。

en: I work as a detective for the Aventine Police Department. My daily activities include catching serial killers, tracking down terrorists, and busting corrupt politicians.[[It keeps a girl busy, what can I say?[[I'm looking for someone who can fill the hole in my life left by being so devoted to my job.[[We'll see how things go. Talk to you again soon.[[
zh: 我在阿文廷警察局当侦探，日常工作就是抓连环杀手、追踪恐怖分子、扳倒贪腐政客。[[没办法，姑娘我就是这么忙。[[我太投入工作了，所以想找个人填补生活中的空缺。[[先相处看看吧，回头再聊。[[

en: I work in the ICU - the Intensive Care Unit.
I work with a very sensitive client base.
zh: 我服务的客户群体非常敏感。

en: I work wonders!
I worked all night on these equations. I think I'm going to hold on to them.
zh: 我整晚都在算这些方程。我想我还是留着吧。

en: I would definitely recognize that awful sound.
zh: 那种讨厌的声音我肯定认得出来。

en: I would love to get back in bed. But I've got to stop whatever's making that noise first!
zh: 我很想回到床上。但我得先让那噪音停下来！

en: I would need proof of death, and a copy of his notarized will before I could release my records to anyone.
zh: 我需要死亡证明，以及他经公证的遗嘱副本，然后才能把我的记录交给任何人。

en: I wouldn't do those things, Reg.
I wouldn't know what to do with those things even if they were working.
zh: 就算那些东西还能用，我也不知道该拿它们怎么办。

en: I wouldn't know what to do with those things even if they weren't shutting off every few seconds.
zh: 就算那些东西不是每隔几秒就断电，我也不知道该拿它们怎么办。

en: I wouldn't know. Let's see if there are any witnesses.
zh: 我不知道。看看有没有目击者。

en: I wouldn't mess with those.
I'd appreciate a ride, thank you.
zh: 那就麻烦你送我一程，谢谢。

en: I'd be ruined!
I'd better ask for help.
I'd better ask the detective for help.
I'd better avoid asking him about that. I don't want a sales pitch.
zh: 我最好别问他那件事。我可不想听推销。

en: I'd better be a bit more delicate than that.
I'd better be careful or the mirror will fall out.
zh: 我最好小心点，不然镜子会掉出来。

en: I'd better be careful waving this mirror around. It's sharp.
zh: 我最好小心点挥这面镜子。它很锋利。

en: I'd better buy a new bulb by tonight or I'll be doing my work on the floor by refrigerator light again.
zh: 我最好今晚之前买个新灯泡，不然又得坐在地板上借冰箱的光干活了。

en: I'd better check my notes on my phone.
zh: 我最好看看手机上的笔记。

en: I'd better find out what's up.
zh: 我最好去看看怎么回事。

en: I'd better find something else to use this with.
zh: 我最好找点别的东西来搭配这个用。

en: I'd better get down first.
I'd better get him down first.
I'd better get in closer.
I'd better get that DNA sample to Antevorta before it dries up.
zh: 我最好趁 DNA 样本还没干，把它送到 Antevorta 去。

en: I'd better get that burned wire out of the way before grabbing a new one.
zh: 我最好先把那根烧坏的电线弄开，再拿一根新的。

en: I'd better have a closer look first.
I'd better hold on to my phone.
zh: 我最好还是留着我的手机。

en: I'd better hold on to these.
I'd better leave it.
I'd better let go of the wire before I switch it on.
zh: 我最好在打开开关前松开电线。

en: I'd better look closer to figure out exactly where to place them.
zh: 我最好仔细看看，弄清楚到底该把它们放在哪里。

en: I'd better look through his belongings to make sure he's not carrying another gun.
zh: 我最好翻翻他的东西，确认他没带另一把枪。

en: I'd better not bother her.
I'd better not leave the Detective stranded.
zh: 我最好别把警探扔在那儿不管。

en: I'd better not push my luck any further.
zh: 我最好别再得寸进尺了。

en: I'd better not touch it when it's live.
I'd better not try to climb down the vent with all that water.
zh: 有那么多水，我最好别试着爬下通风口。

en: I'd better not, this journal is important.
zh: 我最好别这样，这本日志很重要。

en: I'd better put the pipe back up into position, though.
zh: 不过我还是得把管子放回原位。

en: I'd better review all the notes in my phone first.
zh: 我最好先查看一下手机里的所有笔记。

en: I'd better stick to the keyboard.
I'd better take this journal with me.
I'd better talk to Ed about it.
zh: 我最好跟埃德谈谈这事。

en: I'd better think about how I'm going to use that.
zh: 我最好先想想该怎么用它。

en: I'd better try to stop the smoke at the source.
zh: 我最好从源头阻止烟雾。

en: I'd better turn the power off before touching those.
zh: 碰那些之前我最好先断电。

en: I'd better wait to ask Oink - he gets funny if you don't follow the 'rules.'
zh: 我最好还是等问了奥因克再说——你要是不守“规矩”，他就会闹别扭。

en: I'd estimate there's a high chance that panel controls access to the city archives.
zh: 我估计那个面板很可能控制着城市档案的访问权限。

en: I'd guess that gives access to the lab's records and results.
zh: 我猜它能访问实验室的记录和结果。

en: I'd guess that's where they keep... tech.
zh: 我猜那是他们放……技术设备的地方。

en: I'd hate to be alone here.
zh: 我可不想一个人待在这儿。

en: I'd have reported those chain-smokers from the Chemistry department months ago.
zh: 我几个月前就该举报化学系那些老烟枪了。

en: I'd have to explain how we got the credit card report.
zh: 我得解释我们是怎么拿到信用卡报告的。

en: I'd have to get past the secretary to get in there.
zh: 我得绕过那个秘书才能进去。

en: I'd have to walk right in front of the cop on the desk.
zh: 我得从坐在桌前的警察正前方走过去。

en: I'd hire someone else, but, well...
I'd like to do a story on that guy.
zh: 我想给那家伙写篇报道。

en: I'd like to get a few more things out of the archives... you know, for research.
zh: 我想从档案里再弄点东西出来……你知道，为了研究。

en: I'd like to get to know you better.
I'd like to know more about you.
I'd like to snoop in there, but I need to keep my mind on the job in hand.
zh: 我倒想进去窥探一番，但我得把心思放在手头的案子上。

en: I'd like to take a look at that mainframe terminal if it's alright.
zh: 如果可以的话，我想看看那台主机终端。

en: I'd like to take a look at that mainframe terminal if that's alright.
zh: 如果可以的话，我想看看那台主机终端。

en: I'd love to, son, except I can't even get up.
zh: 我很乐意，孩子，可我连站都站不起来。

en: I'd need access to a terminal.
I'd put my back out trying to shift that.
zh: 我要是去挪那个，腰会闪的。

en: I'd rather leave that to Anna.
zh: 我宁愿把那个留给安娜。

en: I'd rather not die of black mold poisoning.
zh: 我可不想死于黑霉菌中毒。

en: I'd rather not touch it.
I'd rather not touch them.
I'd rather not.
I'd rather pay.
I'd rather still have him here.
I'd really rather not touch this.
I'd really rather not.
I'd say it's primitive Etruscan terracotta.
zh: 我猜是原始伊特鲁里亚陶器。

en: I'd say we need a wrench.
zh: 我觉得我们需要一把扳手。

en: I'll be back.
I'll be cleaning plenty of graffiti on the prison chain gang if I don't get on with this job.
zh: 要是我不赶紧办正事，就得在监狱囚犯队里清理一大堆涂鸦了。

en: I'll be fine. Don't worry about it.
I'll be here!
I'll be so happy when I can get out of this place.
zh: 等我能离开这地方，我会高兴死的。

en: I'll bet.
I'll catch who ever violated this no-smoking zone.
zh: 我会抓住违反这个禁烟区规定的人。

en: I'll catch you later.
I'll check it out.  You stay out here.
zh: 我进去看看。你留在外面。

en: I'll come in right now.
I'll drive you to the hospital after I check things out inside.
zh: 等我进去检查完，就开车送你去医院。

en: I'll get back to you on that.
I'll get back to you.
I'll give Bennet his credit card back.
zh: 我会把信用卡还给贝内特。

en: I'll give it a shot.
I'll go in and check it out.  You stay out here.
zh: 我进去看看。你留在外面。

en: I'll grieve later. But now? I need to focus.
zh: 我以后再悲伤。但现在？我需要集中精力。

en: I'll grow some eyes in the back of my head.
zh: 我后脑勺上再长几只眼睛呗。

en: I'll have to climb up there to check it out.
I'll have to cut him off!
I'll have to extend it, though, if I want to get up there.
zh: 不过要想上去，我得把它伸出来。

en: I'll have to get closer.
I'll have to get rid of her.
I'll have to get rid of the secretary before I can check out the filing cabinet.
zh: 我得先把那秘书支开，才能查看文件柜。

en: I'll have to get this from the archive upstairs.
zh: 我得去楼上档案室拿这个。

en: I'll have to stick with the window.
I'll have to try these out on the locked doors around the lab.
zh: 我得拿这些去试试实验室周围那些锁着的门。

en: I'll hide this in here so they can't find it.
zh: 我把这个藏在这里，他们就找不到了。

en: I'll just add 'theft' to my growing list of crimes.
zh: 我只好把‘盗窃’也加进我越来越长的罪状清单里了。

en: I'll just be careful with it and only use it where a wrench is required.
zh: 我会小心使用，只在需要扳手的地方用。

en: I'll just have to find something to screw.
zh: 我只好找点东西来拧了。

en: I'll just hold on to the can.
zh: 我还是留着这个罐子吧。

en: I'll just hold on to them until I need them.
zh: 我先留着它们，等需要的时候再用。

en: I'll just jot this down.
I'll just keep my phone to myself.
I'll just keep notes of any passwords I come across in my phone.
zh: 我会把遇到的所有密码都记在手机里。

en: I'll just keep this in my pocket unless I need to throw my weight around.
zh: 除非需要耍横，否则我就把它揣兜里。

en: I'll just leave it alone.
I'll just leave it on the wall.
I'll just leave it there.
I'll just leave it up there.
I'll just leave it where it is.
zh: 我还是把它留在原处吧。

en: I'll just stick to looking at the paper for now.
zh: 眼下我还是先盯着这张纸看吧。

en: I'll just stick to looking casually into it.
zh: 我还是就随便往里看看吧。

en: I'll just swab my cheek with one of these.
zh: 我就用其中一根刮一下脸颊。

en: I'll just swap out the battery...
I'll just take this.
I'll just use it where I need it.
zh: 我就在需要的地方用它吧。

en: I'll keep it to myself.
I'll keep my wallet in my pants where it belongs, thank you.
zh: 我还是把钱包放在裤子里，放它该在的地方，谢谢。

en: I'll keep the chief off your backs.
zh: 我会帮你挡住局长的压力。

en: I'll keep this.
I'll leave it there.
I'll leave that alone.
I'll leave the note where it is.
zh: 我就把便条留在原处吧。

en: I'll leave the rest of you to deal with Ozzy. Me, I could get written up just thinking about him.
zh: 剩下的你们去对付奥兹吧。我光是想想他，就可能被记过。

en: I'll live. Let's just find the doctor.
zh: 我死不了。我们赶紧找到医生吧。

en: I'll look closer to figure out exactly where this goes.
zh: 我会仔细看看，弄清楚这个到底该放哪里。

en: I'll look closer to figure out where this goes.
zh: 我会仔细看看，弄清楚这个该放哪里。

en: I'll need to apply a bit more force.
I'll need to ask someone to boost me up.
I'll need to go down there and check it out.
I'll pass.
I'll probably leave the part where I destroy someone's property out of my report.
zh: 我大概会把毁坏别人财物那部分从报告里略去。

en: I'll say one thing for you, Ozzy. When you find a theme, you run with it.
zh: 我得说你一句，奥兹。你一旦找到个主题，就一路走到底。

en: I'll see if I can reach it with this...
zh: 我看看能不能用这个够到它……

en: I'll see you there. I'm literally shaking right now.[[Yours,[Amy
zh: 到时候见。我现在真的在发抖。[[你的，[艾米

en: I'll show you.
I'll take care of him.
I'll take your word for it.
I'll thank you not to wave that picture around!
zh: 请你别拿着那张照片晃来晃去！

en: I'll transfer you to the district office.
zh: 我给您转接到地区办公室。

en: I'll transfer you.
I'll try and contain my disappointment.
zh: 我会尽量克制我的失望。

en: I'll try swabbing my phone.
I'll try swabbing the mouth of the can.
I'll unfold it.
I'll wait until later for the chit-chat.
I'm Ed.
I'm a bit busy right now, Anna. Ask me later.
zh: 我现在有点忙，安娜。晚点再问我。

en: I'm a bit surprised you haven't worked that out yet.
zh: 我有点惊讶你还没想明白。

en: I'm a cop. A detective in the Aventine police force.
zh: 我是警察。阿文廷警局的警探。

en: I'm a cop. Here's my badge.
zh: 我是警察。这是我的证件。

en: I'm a cop. I need to get access to these files.
zh: 我是警察。我需要访问这些文件。

en: I'm a doctor at Aventine General Hospital.
zh: 我是阿文廷综合医院的医生。

en: I'm a doctor, not a janitor.
I'm a doctor. I see a lot of dead bodies.
zh: 我是医生。我见过很多尸体。

en: I'm a free agent now, Ray.
I'm a friend of Ray Abbot.
I'm a friend of Ray's.
I'm a friend of Raymond Abbot.
zh: 我是雷蒙德·阿博特的朋友。

en: I'm a little too busy to start scrubbing.
zh: 我有点太忙了，没空开始刷洗。

en: I'm a mathematician.
I'm a senior database administrator.
zh: 我是高级数据库管理员。

en: I'm a subway man, m'self. At least the trains run on time.
zh: 我自己是坐地铁的人。至少列车准点。

en: I'm afraid I didn't bring any paint.
I'm afraid I'll be *in* the news.
I'm afraid my ball playing days are long gone.
zh: 恐怕我打棒球的日子早就过去了。

en: I'm afraid not.
I'm afraid not. If he told anyone, it wasn't me.
zh: 恐怕不知道。如果他告诉过谁，那也不是我。

en: I'm afraid our relationship was purely professional. I don't know much.
zh: 恐怕我们的关系纯粹是工作上的。我知道的不多。

en: I'm afraid that not even duct tape can help me here.
zh: 恐怕在这里连胶带都帮不了我。

en: I'm already in enough trouble without spying on the chief, too.
zh: 我已经够麻烦了，不能再偷窥局长了。

en: I'm already where I need to be.
zh: 我已经在我该在的地方了。

en: I'm asking you to help me.
I'm being followed. I know they want Resonance, and I know they mean me harm.
zh: 有人在跟踪我。我知道他们想要共振，也知道他们想害我。

en: I'm bringing Ed here up to the interrogation room.
I'm bringing Ray here up to the interrogation room.
I'm bringing this young lady up to the interrogation room.
zh: 我带这位年轻女士去审讯室。

en: I'm calling him right now.
I'm certainly not getting through with force.
I'm certainly not putting it back.
zh: 我肯定不会把它搬回去。

en: I'm clutching it as tight as I can!
zh: 我已经尽可能紧紧抓住了！

en: I'm confident enough in my sexuality to own a pink alarm clock.
zh: 我对自己的性取向足够自信，可以拥有一个粉色闹钟。

en: I'm curious about this friend of yours. Are we ever going to meet him?
zh: 我对你这位朋友很好奇。我们到底能不能见到他？

en: I'm definitely not getting any closer to that water as long as it's swimming with lighning bolts.
zh: 只要那片水里还游着闪电，我绝对不会再靠近。

en: I'm definitely not touching that.
I'm destroying it all.
I'm drawing a blank.
I'm drawing a blank. Any ideas?
zh: 我脑子一片空白。有什么想法吗？

en: I'm finally seeing clearly. I know what I have to do.
zh: 我终于看清了。我知道自己该做什么。

en: I'm fine.
I'm fresh out of ideas.
I'm getting tired of this wild goose chase.
zh: 我受够这种徒劳的搜寻了。

en: I'm glad I could help.
I'm glad he's with me.
I'm glad you asked!
I'm going to be best man at his wedding next month.
zh: 下个月我要当他的伴郎。

en: I'm going to destroy them.
I'm going to find a way to get it open.
I'm going to find you and I'm going to kill you.
zh: 我会找到你，然后杀了你。

en: I'm going to get to the bottom of this.
zh: 我会把这件事查个水落石出。

en: I'm going to have to find a way through these.
I'm going to hold on to this.
I'm going to kill you.
I'm going to make a new one.
I'm going to need a wrench.
I'm going to need some supplies.
I'm going to need you to tell me about that vault.
zh: 我需要你告诉我那个保险库的事。

en: I'm going to need your help up there.
I'm going to pull the plug to Oink's favorite toy.
zh: 我要拔掉奥因克最爱玩具的插头。

en: I'm going up again.
I'm gonna have to get closer.
I'm guessing it has to do with one of my uncles - Javi or Angelo.
zh: 我猜这跟我其中一个叔叔有关——哈维或者安杰洛。

en: I'm guessing it's a repository of all his secret project research.
zh: 我猜里面存放着他秘密项目的全部研究资料。

en: I'm guessing that Ed doesn't have a lot of guests over for dinner.
zh: 我猜埃德不会请很多客人来吃晚饭。

en: I'm guessing we need some fuses if we're going to get that control panel to work right.
zh: 我猜我们得找些保险丝，才能让那个控制面板正常工作。

en: I'm here to ask some questions, ma'am.
zh: 我是来问几个问题的，女士。

en: I'm here.
I'm holding out for the Pulitzer Prize.
I'm in deep, now.
I'm in the chem lab, mopping up the floors, dancing the cha-cha-cha...
zh: 我在化学实验室里拖地，跳着恰恰恰……

en: I'm in the dark as much as you are.
I'm informing him of where he can shove his stupid questions.
zh: 我在告诉他可以把那些蠢问题塞到哪儿去。

en: I'm joking, son.
I'm just here to watch the box.
zh: 我只是来看守这个箱子的。

en: I'm just messin' with ya'!
I'm just saying that it would be a shame.
I'm just thankful for the new central control system.
zh: 我只庆幸有了新的中央控制系统。

en: I'm just thankful you got there when you did. At least I was able to speak to him one more time before he... well.
zh: 我只庆幸你及时赶到了。至少我还能再跟他说一次话，在他……唉。

en: I'm just writing a strongly-worded e-mail to my boss, who just asked me for his password FOR THE SEVENTEENTH TIME.
zh: 我正在给老板写一封措辞严厉的邮件，他刚刚第十七次问我要密码。

en: I'm listed as the sole beneficiary.
I'm looking for the blueprints to Juno Lab. Would you know how to get them?
zh: 我在找朱诺实验室的蓝图。你知道怎么弄到吗？

en: I'm man enough to admit that if it ain't a car or a faucet, I've got to call in somebody else.
zh: 我够爷们儿，敢承认如果这不是车或水龙头，我就得叫别人来。

en: I'm more of a 'hands-on experience' kind of guy, to be honest.
zh: 说实话，我更像是个靠‘实践经验’的人。

en: I'm never going back to that.
zh: 我再也不会回到那种生活了。

en: I'm not agreeing or disagreeing. Just getting all the facts.
zh: 我没同意也没反对。只是在弄清所有事实。

en: I'm not allowed in there.
I'm not allowed to let anyone else touch it.
I'm not climbing over unless he goes first.
zh: 除非他先翻，否则我不翻。

en: I'm not climbing that fence unless I really need to.
zh: 除非真的有必要，否则我不会翻那道栅栏。

en: I'm not close enough to chat.
zh: 我离得不够近，没法交谈。

en: I'm not close enough yet.
I'm not close enough.
I'm not covering that back up.
zh: 我不会把那个盖回去的。

en: I'm not feeling very thirsty right now.
I'm not getting any cell phone service.
I'm not getting in this way.
I'm not giving my lucky coin away.
zh: 我不会把我的幸运币送人。

en: I'm not going anywhere, Anna Angel.
zh: 我哪儿也不去，安娜小天使。

en: I'm not going back down.
I'm not going down there.
I'm not going in there without more backup than a sleazy hack with pretensions to grandeur.
zh: 没有比一个装腔作势的三流记者更强的后援，我可不会进去。

en: I'm not going in there!
I'm not going to be able to break these boards.
I'm not going to be able to get back to sleep now. Better figure out who was calling.
zh: 我现在是睡不着了。最好弄清楚是谁打来的电话。

en: I'm not going to be able to get back to sleep now. I'd better call Dr. Morales back.
zh: 我现在是睡不着了。最好给莫拉莱斯博士回个电话。

en: I'm not going to be able to pry that open with my bare hands.
zh: 我赤手空拳可撬不开那东西。

en: I'm not going to get reprimanded for this, am I?
zh: 我不会因为这事挨批吧？

en: I'm not going to give him that at the moment.
zh: 我现在不打算给他那个。

en: I'm not going to go through someone's desk.
zh: 我不会去翻别人的桌子。

en: I'm not going to judge.
I'm not going to take the patient files from the walls.
zh: 我不会把病人档案从墙上拿下来。

en: I'm not going to tell you anything!
zh: 我什么都不会告诉你的！

en: I'm not going to use my treasure like that.
zh: 我不会那样用我的宝贝。

en: I'm not handing my cell phone over to anyone.
zh: 我不会把我的手机交给任何人。

en: I'm not here for-
I'm not here to make your career, Ray.
zh: 我不是来成就你的事业的，雷。

en: I'm not meant to be here, so I'd better not call attention to myself.
zh: 我不该来这儿，所以最好别引人注意。

en: I'm not much of an electrician, but I'm pretty sure these fuses go with this panel.
zh: 我不太懂电工，但我很确定这些保险丝是配这块面板的。

en: I'm not officially meant to be here today.
zh: 我今天本来不该正式来这儿。

en: I'm not on the "Most Wanted" list. Yet.
zh: 我不在“头号通缉犯”名单上。暂时。

en: I'm not paid to be curious.
I'm not putting it back in there!  I paid for it!
zh: 我才不会把它放回去！我可是付了钱的！

en: I'm not really supposed to have these drugs, so I'd rather not throw them around.
zh: 这些药我本来就不该拿着，所以还是别到处乱扔了。

en: I'm not really sure what to do with it.
zh: 我不太确定拿它怎么办。

en: I'm not really sure why there are a bunch of cotton swabs in this office, though.
zh: 不过我不太确定这办公室里为什么有一堆棉签。

en: I'm not really the muscle-bound type.
zh: 我可不是那种肌肉发达的类型。

en: I'm not sure
I'm not sure I believe it myself. But that note... there's no explaining that.
zh: 我自己都不太敢相信。但那张纸条……那没法解释。

en: I'm not sure I feel comfortable dealing with an addict like Ozzy.
zh: 跟奥兹这样的瘾君子打交道，我不太自在。

en: I'm not sure I like that.
I'm not sure exactly what to make of Tortoise.
zh: 我不太确定该怎么看托托伊斯。

en: I'm not sure how a broken mirror is going to help me here.
zh: 我不确定一面破镜子在这里能帮上什么忙。

en: I'm not sure how hitting that with a brick is going to solve the problem.
zh: 我不确定拿砖头砸它能解决问题。

en: I'm not sure how my notes are going to help me here.
zh: 我不确定我的笔记在这里能帮上什么忙。

en: I'm not sure how my treasure is going to help.
zh: 我不确定我的宝贝能帮上什么忙。

en: I'm not sure how that's going to help me here.
zh: 我不确定那在这里能帮上什么忙。

en: I'm not sure how this box helps me here.
zh: 我不确定这个盒子在这里能帮上什么忙。

en: I'm not sure how using my phone like that is going to help.
zh: 我不确定那样用手机能有什么用。

en: I'm not sure if I can explain the cypher properly. I can barely understand it myself.
zh: 我不确定能不能把密码解释清楚。我自己都勉强看得懂。

en: I'm not sure that anything in there can help us.
zh: 我不确定里面有什么能帮到我们。

en: I'm not sure that's a relevant question.
zh: 我不确定那是个相关的问题。

en: I'm not sure that's relevant right now.
zh: 我不确定那现在有什么关系。

en: I'm not sure what I could do with a piece of the sign.
zh: 我不知道拿一块牌子碎片能做什么。

en: I'm not sure what I could do with that.
zh: 我不知道拿那个能做什么。

en: I'm not sure what I'd get by swabbing that.
zh: 我不确定擦拭那个能有什么收获。

en: I'm not sure what I'm going to do to fix this.
zh: 我不知道该怎么修好这个。

en: I'm not sure what that's going to accomplish.
zh: 我不确定那样能有什么效果。

en: I'm not sure what this is.
I'm not sure what to an empty pop can is going to do for me here.
zh: 我不确定一个空易拉罐在这儿能帮我做什么。

en: I'm not sure what to do with a pop can here.
zh: 我不确定在这儿拿个易拉罐能做什么。

en: I'm not sure what to do with that.
zh: 我不确定该拿那个怎么办。

en: I'm not sure what to do with this.
zh: 我不确定该拿这个怎么办。

en: I'm not sure what to use it on.
I'm not sure who this guy is, but if he has a criminal history, the police might know something about it.
zh: 我不确定这家伙是谁，但如果他有犯罪记录，警方也许知道些什么。

en: I'm not sure why I bought a mini-fridge. I usually eat everything the same day I buy it.
zh: 我不确定自己为什么买了个迷你冰箱。我通常买回来当天就吃光。

en: I'm not sure. I'd have to be closer to estimate the height and calculate the degree of-
zh: 不好说。我得靠近点才能估算高度，算出角度——

en: I'm not taking them with me.
I'm not telling him that unless I think it will help me.
zh: 除非我觉得这对我有帮助，否则我不会告诉他。

en: I'm not tired.
I'm not very thirsty.
I'm not working for anybody ever again.
zh: 我再也不会为任何人工作了。

en: I'm not yet sure what its purpose is, but I've got a lead on someone who does.
zh: 我还不确定它的目的是什么，但我有线索能找到知道的人。

en: I'm not your damn secretary. And since when do you do any paperwork, anyway?
zh: 我又不是你的破秘书。再说你什么时候做过文书工作？

en: I'm not!
I'm off to see the wizard, the wonderful wizard... etc.
zh: 我要去见巫师，那位了不起的巫师……等等。

en: I'm off-duty. Doctor Cheng would *not* welcome help.
zh: 我下班了。程医生*不会*欢迎帮忙的。

en: I'm okay. Let's just go.
I'm on it!
I'm on my way.
I'm on the right track here.
I'm only asking -
I'm out of ideas, how about you?
I'm pretty sure I'd get spotted.
I'm pretty sure it's coming from the bedroom.
zh: 我很确定是从卧室传来的。

en: I'm pretty sure it's nailed to the wall.
zh: 我敢肯定它是钉在墙上的。

en: I'm pretty sure the call couldn't have come from there, though.
zh: 不过我很确定电话不可能是从那里打来的。

en: I'm pretty sure the records are upstairs, not downstairs.
zh: 我很确定档案在楼上，不在楼下。

en: I'm pretty sure the sound is coming from behind me.
zh: 我很确定声音是从我身后传来的。

en: I'm psyching myself up to phone that murdering bastard.
zh: 我正在给自己做心理建设，好去给那个杀人混蛋打电话。

en: I'm rambling, aren't I?
I'm ready when you are, Anna. Just let me know.
zh: 你准备好我就准备好，安娜。告诉我就行。

en: I'm ready when you are.
I'm ready.
I'm right here, you know.
I'm right here.
I'm scared!
I'm serious. It's strange, isn't it? You joining up with us, having exactly the connections we need?
zh: 我是认真的。这很奇怪，不是吗？你加入我们，恰好拥有我们需要的人脉？

en: I'm so close to the end of the mystery now.
zh: 我离谜团的终点已经很近了。

en: I'm so glad you think so!
I'm so glad you think so.
I'm sorry for interrupting your quiet time, but what do I need to give you again?
zh: 抱歉打扰你清静，但我到底要给你什么来着？

en: I'm sorry sir, I can't give out that sort of information to anyone without authorisation from my superiors.
zh: 抱歉先生，没有上级授权，我不能向任何人透露这类信息。

en: I'm sorry to hear that.
zh: 听到这个消息我很难过。

en: I'm sorry we were keeping you out of the loop, Detective, but we had to.
zh: 抱歉我们一直瞒着你，警探，但我们不得不这么做。

en: I'm sorry,
I'm sorry, I can't think straight right now.
I'm sorry, I just-
I'm sorry, I'm a mathematician -- better with numbers than with people.
zh: 抱歉，我是个数学家——比起和人打交道，我更擅长和数字打交道。

en: I'm sorry, but I need to follow the law to the letter, here.
zh: 抱歉，但在这里我必须严格依法办事。

en: I'm sorry, but I really need those results.
zh: 抱歉，但我真的需要那些结果。

en: I'm sorry, but we really need to get into that archive.
zh: 抱歉，但我们真的需要进入那个档案馆。

en: I'm sorry.
I'm sorry. If I only had more time to calculate the distance and area of effect...
zh: 对不起。要是我有更多时间计算距离和影响范围……

en: I'm sorry...
I'm staying with Ed.
I'm still not sure what purpose they're supposed to serve here, though.
zh: 不过我还是不清楚它们在这里能派上什么用场。

en: I'm supposed to lock the door if I'm not here, but...
zh: 我不在的时候应该锁门，但是……

en: I'm supposed to meet with my uncle's lawyer about his will next week, but I don't think we've got that kind of time.
zh: 我下周本该去见叔叔的律师谈遗嘱，但我觉得我们没那么多时间。

en: I'm sure I'll find plenty of uses for it.
zh: 我肯定能找到很多用途。

en: I'm sure it's hooked up to the hospital's internal network, and not to the Antevorta mainframe.
zh: 我敢肯定它连的是医院内部网络，而不是Antevorta主机。

en: I'm sure the producers are pretending that it was intended to be a trilogy all along.
zh: 我敢肯定制片人正假装它一直就是三部曲。

en: I'm sure there's useful information on that computer.
zh: 那台电脑上肯定有有用的信息。

en: I'm sure you'll survive.
I'm tall, but not that tall.
I'm technically meant to stay there while upstairs.
zh: 严格来说，我在楼上时应该待在那里。

en: I'm telling you, this new reorganization is really busting my buttons.
zh: 我跟你说，这次新改组真是把我逼疯了。

en: I'm the one with the gun, darlin'.
I'm too absent-minded. That coin wouldn't last a week in my pocket.
zh: 我太健忘了。那枚硬币在我口袋里撑不过一星期。

en: I'm trying to figure something out about this piece of paper I found in this book.
zh: 我正在琢磨在这本书里找到的那张纸上的东西。

en: I'm very sorry for your loss.
zh: 对你失去亲人，我深表遗憾。

en: I'm waiting!
I'm working on it. I just need a little time.
zh: 我正在弄。只是需要一点时间。

en: I'm, uh, here to fix the mainframe.
I'm, uh...
I'm... I'm sorry.
I've actually got to go.
I've already finished them. There's no need for any more calculations.
zh: 我已经算完了。不需要再计算了。

en: I've already forced them open.
I've already got a sample from myself.
zh: 我已经从自己身上取到样本了。

en: I've already got a sample from the can.
zh: 我已经从罐子上取到样本了。

en: I've already got a sample.
I've already got one in my office.
zh: 我办公室里已经有一幅了。

en: I've already got one of these at my apartment.
zh: 我公寓里已经有一个了。

en: I've already got some, though.
I've already got the key.
I've already got the page with the results.
zh: 我已经拿到那页有结果的了。

en: I've already got too much junk.
I've already set the timer, so just sit tight for a few minutes.
zh: 我已经设好了计时器，所以稍等几分钟就好。

en: I've been helping you!
I've been here all weekend thinking about it.
zh: 我整个周末都在这里思考这件事。

en: I've been in the media a long time, and I know spin doctoring when I hear it.
zh: 我在媒体干了很久，一听就知道什么是舆论操控。

en: I've been working here for five and a half years!
zh: 我在这儿干了五年半了！

en: I've done my best to minimize the area of effect to just the Antevorta mainframe...
zh: 我已尽力把影响范围缩小到只覆盖Antevorta主机……

en: I've done my best.
I've done some poking around for info on "A. Batra" and all I can find is something called "Antevorta." We should check that out before doing anything.[[-J[[[
zh: 我查了一些关于"A. Batra"的信息，只找到一个叫"Antevorta"的东西。我们动手之前应该先查查那个。[[-J[[[

en: I've exposed more bad guys than you ever will!
zh: 我揭发的坏人比你一辈子揭发的都多！

en: I've got a bunch of electronics stashed in here.
zh: 我在这儿塞了一堆电子设备。

en: I've got a catalog here at the desk if you're interested.
zh: 如果你感兴趣，桌上有一本目录。

en: I've got a credit card statement proving it.
zh: 我有信用卡账单可以证明。

en: I've got a few more questions for you, sir.
zh: 先生，我还有几个问题要问你。

en: I've got a number of very good stories out of him.
zh: 我从他那里套出了不少好料。

en: I've got a reputation to uphold.
I've got a spare battery in my drawer.
zh: 我抽屉里有一块备用电池。

en: I've got a spare battery in my drawer.  It should still be charged.
zh: 我抽屉里有块备用电池。应该还有电。

en: I've got a watch.
I've got access to the panel, but I can't just start futzing with it. Not with Johnsen watching.
zh: 我能接触到控制面板，但不能就这么乱动。约翰森正盯着呢。

en: I've got enough hubcaps.
zh: 我的轮毂盖已经够多了。

en: I've got it right here.
I've got it wedged in there as best as I can.
I've got just the use for this step ladder.
zh: 这架梯子正好派得上用场。

en: I've got no patience for journalists. Personal reasons.
zh: 我对记者没耐心。个人原因。

en: I've got orders from higher up, sir.
zh: 长官，我接到了上级的命令。

en: I've got the looking casual part down.
zh: 装随意的部分我已经搞定了。

en: I've got the story now.
zh: 我现在知道来龙去脉了。

en: I've got to deal with that rogue power cable.
zh: 我得处理掉那根失控的电缆。

en: I've got to drop this ladder!
I've got to find a way in there.
I've got to find a way to deal with them first.
zh: 我得先想办法处理掉它们。

en: I've got to find a way to watch him when he leaves.
zh: 我得想办法在他离开时盯住他。

en: I've got to find a way...
I've got to get in to Dr. Morales.
zh: 我得进去找莫拉莱斯博士。

en: I've got to get off this fire escape.
I've got to get us a better line of sight.
I've got to make sure I see where he goes when he leaves.
zh: 我得确保看清他离开后去了哪里。

en: I've got to see a doctor about this ankle first.
zh: 我得先去看医生，治治这脚踝。

en: I've got to stay on task.
I've got to take it with me.
I've gotta say, you really kept your head back there in the lab.
zh: 我得说，你在实验室里真是够镇定的。

en: I've hacked my share of computers, but that archive is quite formidable.
zh: 我黑过不少电脑，但那个档案库相当难对付。

en: I've had a few run-ins with the law - a hazard of the investigative profession.
zh: 我跟法律打过几次交道——干调查这行的风险。

en: I've half a mind to set the drug squad on him when this is all over.
zh: 等这一切结束后，我有点想叫缉毒组去查他。

en: I've just been using my wrench to turn it on and off.
zh: 我一直用我的扳手来开关它。

en: I've just got to get these screws off...
zh: 我得把这些螺丝弄下来……

en: I've looked everywhere in this room, but I can't find it.
zh: 这个房间我到处都找过了，但找不到。

en: I've made a few good arrests in that stinking alley outside the window.
zh: 我在窗外那条臭巷子里抓过几个不错的犯人。

en: I've never heard of FTTN numbers.
I've never met a problem that duct tape couldn't solve.
zh: 我还没遇到过管道胶带解决不了的问题。

en: I've never seen a perp with a clean bathroom.
zh: 我从没见过哪个嫌犯的浴室是干净的。

en: I've never seen anything like it.
I've not got the patience for this.
I've only got two keys on here. One is for maintenance, and the other doesn't work on this door.
zh: 我这儿只有两把钥匙。一把是维修用的，另一把开不了这扇门。

en: I've seen that print in five different places in this hospital.
zh: 我在医院里五个不同的地方见过那幅画。

en: I've seen your site, Ray. It's very impressive.
zh: 我看过你的网站，雷。非常令人印象深刻。

en: I've signed hundreds of death certificates.
zh: 我签过几百份死亡证明。

en: I've still got my lucky coin.
I've told you, I can't give you any information until I've seen the death certificate and the will.
zh: 我跟你说过了，在看到死亡证明和遗嘱之前，我不能给你任何信息。

en: I've used this thing before.
I've watched her so many times on this train.
zh: 我在这趟火车上看了她好多次。

en: I've worked so long for this.
I, Um...
I, uh, think it's just an automatic safeguard.
zh: 我，呃，想这只是个自动保护装置。

en: I-
I- er...
I... I didn't lock the door!
I... I just can't. It's too late for that.
zh: 我……我就是做不到。已经太迟了。

en: I... I just couldn't take the risk.
zh: 我……我就是不能冒这个险。

en: I... I remember...
I... I'm dreaming... Wake up.
I... I'm sorry you feel that way.
I... Ok.
I... agree.
I... did but...
I... huh?
I... just noticed...
I... really don't want to think about that.
zh: 我……真的不想去想那件事。

en: I... right. Sorry.
I... see.
ICU computer
ICU door
INSANE ACHIEVEMENT: Escape from the monster without locking the door
zh: 疯狂成就：不锁门从怪物手中逃脱

en: INSANE ACHIEVEMENT: Open Tortoise's safe without using any "vision aids"
zh: 疯狂成就：不使用任何“视觉辅助”打开托托伊斯的保险箱

en: INV
Ick. Right. I'll keep that in mind.
If Dr. Morales bought the vault from Tortoise Security, that has to be our next step.
zh: 如果莫拉莱斯博士是从托托伊斯安保公司买的保险库，那这就是我们的下一步。

en: If Dr. Morales has a vault somewhere with more of this technology contained inside...
zh: 如果莫拉莱斯博士在某个地方有个保险库，里面装着更多这种技术……

en: If Ed had left any blood-stained clothes in there, it might help our case.
zh: 如果埃德在里面留下什么带血的衣物，也许对我们的案子有帮助。

en: If Ed put a Resonance device down here, and there's no signal, how can he activate the cell phone trigger?
zh: 如果埃德在这里放了一台共振装置，而这里又没有信号，那他怎么激活手机触发器？

en: If Ed put a Resonance device down here, it's got to be behind one of these doors.
zh: 如果埃德在这里放了共振装置，肯定在其中一扇门后面。

en: If Ed was at the Antevorta office, then there's only one witness. We gotta talk to that receptionist.
zh: 如果埃德当时在Antevorta办公室，那就只有一个目击者。我们得跟那个前台谈谈。

en: If I call Ed again, he might figure out we know his number and ditch the phone.
zh: 如果我再打给埃德，他可能会发现我们知道他的号码，然后把手机扔掉。

en: If I can adequately secure the replacement pipe and we divert water through it, it should start up the sprinklers and put out the fire.
zh: 如果我能把替换管固定好，让水流改道通过它，应该就能启动喷淋器把火扑灭。

en: If I can figure out that panel, I should be able to get the information I need.
zh: 如果我能弄懂那个面板，应该就能拿到我需要的信息。

en: If I can find a way to repair that leak, maybe the sprinklers can take care of the fire.
zh: 如果我能想办法修好那个漏水口，也许喷淋头就能把火灭掉。

en: If I can get the right amount of power to this pin, it should open the door.
zh: 如果我能给这个引脚输送适量的电力，应该就能打开门。

en: If I can normalize the bottom pin, I think it will trigger the door opening mechanism.
zh: 如果我能让底部引脚恢复正常，我想这会触发电网开门机制。

en: If I cared about money, do you think I would have become a cop?
zh: 如果我在乎钱，你觉得我会去当警察吗？

en: If I could just see inside the mechanism, I might be able to crack it.
zh: 要是我能看到里面的结构，也许就能打开它。

en: If I ever remember to buy a new bulb, I'll worry about overcoming the height issue.
zh: 等我哪天记得买新灯泡，再来操心怎么解决高度问题吧。

en: If I get closer, I can swipe it.
zh: 如果我靠近点，就能刷它。

en: If I had permission, I could use that to access the Antevorta mainframe.
zh: 如果我有权限，我就能用它访问Antevorta主机。

en: If I hadn't seen the photos, I'd guess it was some sort of powerful laser.
zh: 要不是我看过照片，我会猜是某种强力激光。

en: If I knew what any of it did.
zh: 前提是我知道它们是干什么的。

en: If I knew, I'd have put an APB out on him. Conspiracy or no conspiracy.
zh: 要是我知道，早就发通缉令了。管他什么阴谋不阴谋。

en: If I mounted these things on planes or satellites, just how big could you make this blast?
zh: 如果我把这些东西装在飞机或卫星上，这爆炸能搞到多大？

en: If I ran a criminal conspiracy I'd pick a headquarters with a little more ... class.
zh: 如果是我经营一个犯罪阴谋，我会选一个更有……格调的总部。

en: If I recall correctly, you said you used your wrench to break the window before you jumped out.
zh: 如果我没记错，你说过你是用扳手砸破窗户才跳出来的。

en: If I remember right, there is an extendable walkway that is activated by one of these switches. The one at the far end of the collider, I think.
zh: 如果我没记错，这些开关中有一个能启动一条可伸缩走道。我想是对撞机最远那头的那个。

en: If I walk down the stairs, I'll be seen.
zh: 如果我走下楼梯，会被看见的。

en: If I was going outside, I'd rather just walk out the door.
zh: 如果我要出去，我宁愿直接走门。

en: If I were a bad guy, you figuring things out would be the least of my worries.
zh: 如果我是坏人，你查清一切是我最不担心的事。

en: If I'm right, then this panel controls the security door.
zh: 如果我没猜错，这块面板控制着那扇安全门。

en: If Morales was right, and someone on the force was after him...
zh: 如果莫拉莱斯说得对，警局里有人在追查他……

en: If and when the Rapture comes to pass, a licensed blasphemer will trigger the mechanism, destroying all your documents.
zh: 如果被提真的降临，一位持证亵渎者会触发机关，销毁你所有的文件。

en: If anyone asks, I never saw any of you.
zh: 要是有人问起，我从没见过你们任何人。

en: If anyone can help me get to the bottom of this mystery, she can.
zh: 如果有人能帮我揭开这个谜团的真相，那就是她。

en: If every person has an FTTN number, then they must be stored somewhere.
zh: 如果每个人都有FTTN号码，那它们一定被存在某个地方。

en: If he can get us the information we need, I don't care what he does in his spare time.
zh: 只要他能弄到我们需要的信息，我不在乎他业余时间干什么。

en: If he was here now, it'd save us all some time.
zh: 要是他现在在这儿，能给我们省不少时间。

en: If he wasn't with me, I'd be in more trouble than you.
zh: 要不是他跟我在一起，我的麻烦比你还大。

en: If it has a USB slot, I can hack into anything.
zh: 只要有USB插口，我什么都能黑进去。

en: If it's all the same, I'd rather not.
zh: 如果都一样的话，我宁愿不要。

en: If it's meatspace, count me out, dude.
zh: 要是现实世界的事，别算上我，老兄。

en: If my calculations are correct...
zh: 如果我的计算没错的话……

en: If only like Icarus, I could fly towards the sun and leave this grimy locale.
zh: 要是我能像伊卡洛斯那样，飞向太阳，离开这个肮脏的地方就好了。

en: If only we had some leverage to use against that Tortoise guy.
zh: 要是我们手里有能对付那个托托伊斯的把柄就好了。

en: If somebody was in Ed's apartment, we shouldn't go back there until this thing is done.
zh: 如果有人进过埃德的公寓，在这件事结束之前我们不该回去。

en: If someone was following us, we must've lost 'em.
zh: 如果有人跟踪我们，肯定被我们甩掉了。

en: If the chemistry department wants to poison themselves in a non-smoking building, they can clean up after themselves.
zh: 要是化学系的人想在无烟楼里毒死自己，那就自己收拾干净。

en: If the light worked it might help me find the source of that noise.
zh: 要是灯能用，也许能帮我找到那噪音的来源。

en: If the person in my apartment is robbing me, he can have them.
zh: 如果闯进我公寓的人是在抢劫，那就让他拿去吧。

en: If the scientists ever come back here, they won't be smoking.
zh: 要是那些科学家再回来，他们就不能抽烟了。

en: If the target is Antevorta on floor seven, and one Resonance device is here in the basement, then the other must be...
zh: 如果目标是七楼的Antevorta，而一个共振装置在地下室，那另一个一定在……

en: If the wrong people got a hold of that kind of information...
zh: 如果那种信息落到了不该有的人手里……

en: If there was only some way we could find this guy in the photo Tortoise gave me.
zh: 要是有什么办法能让我们找到托托伊斯给我的照片里的这个人就好了。

en: If there's a third fuse, this room is the only place we're going to find it.
zh: 如果有第三根保险丝，只可能在这个房间里找到。

en: If they ever put me on that, I'll shoot someone.
zh: 要是他们把我安排到那上面，我会开枪打人的。

en: If this is a police station, where are all the cops?
zh: 如果这是警察局，那警察都去哪儿了？

en: If this is another cheesy pickup line, I swear I'm going to...
zh: 如果这又是老套的搭讪台词，我发誓我要……

en: If this story doesn't pan out, at least I've got a pretty big one as a back up.
zh: 如果这个故事查不出结果，至少我还有个更大的当备选。

en: If we can find the guy who sold Morales the vault, maybe they can help us find it.
zh: 如果我们能找到把保险库卖给莫拉莱斯的人，也许他们能帮我们找到它。

en: If we didn't need his help so badly, I'd insist he check into rehab.
zh: 要不是我们那么需要他帮忙，我会坚持让他去戒毒所。

en: If we don't find him in time...
zh: 要是我们没能及时找到他……

en: If we find him, we might be able to figure out who was behind Javi's death.
zh: 如果我们找到他，也许就能查出是谁害死了哈维。

en: If we find out who's behind all this, we need Ray to tell the world.
zh: 如果我们查出这一切是谁干的，我们需要雷告诉全世界。

en: If we get them open, it's not going to be with force.
zh: 就算我们能打开它们，也绝不是靠蛮力。

en: If we need my uncle's DNA to get his FTTN number, then I'm the one who should get it.
zh: 如果我们需要我叔叔的DNA来获取他的FTTN号码，那应该由我去取。

en: If we want to get into that archive, we need to find someone who knows more than we do.
zh: 如果我们想进入那个档案库，就得找个比我们懂得多的人。

en: If we're getting into that locker, we'll have to do it another way.
zh: 要打开那个储物柜，我们得另想办法。

en: If we're gonna get in there, we're going to need some help.
zh: 如果我们想进去，就需要一些帮助。

en: If you calibrate it right, it lets you see through just about anything.
zh: 只要校准得当，几乎能看穿任何东西。

en: If you can crack it, you can have it!
zh: 只要你能撬开，它就是你的！

en: If you can't listen, I don't see why I should tell you again.
zh: 如果你听不进去，我没理由再说一遍。

en: If you ever get him, do you think I can get first crack at an interview?
zh: 如果你哪天抓到他，你觉得我能第一个采访他吗？

en: If you gotta go, now's the time.
zh: 你要上厕所的话，就趁现在。

en: If you hadn't knocked me out and tied me up, I could have saved Anna.
zh: 要不是你把我打晕绑起来，我本可以救下安娜的。

en: If you help us, I promise I'll forget the whole thing about someone breaking in and stealing your files.
zh: 如果你帮我们，我保证忘掉有人闯入并偷走你文件的事。

en: If you hit heads five times in a row, you might feel pretty lucky.
zh: 如果你连续五次抛到正面，你可能会觉得自己很幸运。

en: If you knew that the explosion was caused by a Resonance blast, why didn't you say anything earlier?
zh: 如果你知道爆炸是共振冲击造成的，为什么之前不说？

en: If you know how.
If you know it, then it isn't a secret any more. My guess is they changed it.
zh: 既然你知道，那就不算暗号了。我猜他们换了。

en: If you need more than that, you aren't the right men for the job.
zh: 如果你需要的不止这些，那你就不是干这活儿的合适人选。

en: If you really want to know: I sit here, do my paperwork, and make sure only authorized personnel touch the box.
zh: 如果你真想知道：我坐在这儿，处理文书，确保只有授权人员碰箱子。

en: If you say so.
If you set off a Resonance blast, won't you kill them too?
zh: 如果你引发共振爆炸，不也会把他们一起杀死吗？

en: If you take one more step, I will shoot you, Ray!
zh: 你再走一步，我就开枪了，雷！

en: If you talk to him about that, he'll go on for hours.
zh: 你要是跟他聊起那事，他能说上好几个小时。

en: If you write about this, you don't refer to me by name. Got it?
zh: 如果你要写这件事，别提到我的名字。明白吗？

en: If you're free later on, I'd love to take you out somewhere.
zh: 如果你晚些时候有空，我很想带你出去转转。

en: If you're going to shoot us, shoot us!
If you're going to shoot us, shoot us!.
If you've got something to say about me, say it to my face.
zh: 你要是对我有什么意见，就当面说。

en: Ignore the question.
Imagine it! Unlimited clean energy. Faster than light travel. Instant communication over unlimited distances...
zh: 想象一下！无限的清洁能源。超光速旅行。无限距离的即时通讯……

en: Impressive designs. They yours?
Impressive security you've got here.
In a few hours, your faces will be all over the TV and net.
zh: 几小时后，你们的脸就会出现在电视和网络上。

en: In case you haven't noticed, I'm kind of busy right now, so if you could just...
zh: 如果你没注意到的话，我现在挺忙的，所以你能不能就……

en: In cases where Homeland security has put a lock on a document?
zh: 如果国土安全部把某份文件锁定了呢？

en: In fact, Dr. Morales and I developed a precise formula predicting the inverse-relationship-
zh: 事实上，莫拉莱斯博士和我推导出了一个精确公式，可以预测这种反比关系——

en: In fact, I've been having trouble keeping up with all the work that's been coming my way.
zh: 事实上，我快应付不过来源源不断的活儿了。

en: In fact, he probably won't even notice.
zh: 事实上，他可能根本不会注意到。

en: In fact, on this side of the apartment, the sound isn't very loud.
zh: 事实上，在公寓这一侧，声音不太响。

en: In fact, the sound is pretty quiet over here. I must be getting colder.
zh: 事实上，这边声音挺小的。我一定是越来越冷了。

en: In five... ten years, when we're living in a new age of peace and prosperity...
zh: 五年……十年后，当我们生活在一个和平繁荣的新时代……

en: In just a few moments, the timer will run out and the Resonance devices I've placed will wipe this Antevorta system from existence.
zh: 再过片刻，计时器就会走完，我放置的共振装置将把这个Antevorta系统从世上抹去。

en: In my experience, it just makes things worse.
zh: 依我的经验，那只会让事情更糟。

en: In order to comply with federal guidelines...
In other words, it lets me see inside the box.
zh: 换句话说，它能让我看到盒子内部。

en: In peace.
In some ways, I was closer to you than I was to my own father.
zh: 某种程度上，我和你比和我亲生父亲还亲近。

en: In that case, I'm sure you know what to do.
zh: 既然这样，我相信你知道该怎么做。

en: In that mainframe is the DNA of every person in America.
zh: 那台主机里存着美国每个人的DNA。

en: In that vault is...
In the wrong hands, the contents of this vault would be an incredibly powerful and destructive weapon.
zh: 若落入坏人手中，这间保险库里的东西将成为一件极其强大且具毁灭性的武器。

en: In theory.
In what way does Reno "see everything."
zh: 雷诺是怎么“看到一切”的？

en: In what way, exactly?
Inbox
Including his designs for the Resonance devices used to separate them.
zh: 包括他用来分离粒子的共振装置的设计图。

en: Increasing government surveillance powers in the name of anti-terrorism.
zh: 以反恐之名扩大政府监控权力。

en: Independent
Indicator lights
Information. It's our business to know everything.
zh: 信息。我们的本行就是无所不知。

en: Information...
Initiating a Dialog
Insert DNA Sample.
Insert DNA sample for verification
Inspection scheduled
Inteflexone
Inteflexone 10mg
Inteflexone 10mg, Dorphine Drip 30mg
Intellithene
Intellithene 20mg

zh: 是我多心，还是奥兹看起来有点精神紧张？

en: Is it money?
Is it working?
Is it?
Is she psychic?
Is someone in my apartment?
Is that all?
Is that important?
Is that the dead guy from the lab?

zh: 我叔叔受伤时就在那里吗？

en: Is the chief trustworthy?
Is the locking mechanism controlled from somewhere else?
zh: 锁闭装置是从别处控制的吗？
