Is there a problem with that?
Is there any way of breaking into Johnsen's computer?
zh: 有什么办法能闯进约翰森的电脑吗？

en: Is there anything we need in the copy room?
zh: 复印室里有什么我们需要的东西吗？

en: Is there likely to be anything on the lab terminal?
zh: 实验室终端上可能有什么东西吗？

en: Is there some kind of degree you need for that?
Is this going to be a buddy cop thing now?
zh: 这现在要变成搭档警探那一套了吗？

en: Is this what you use to trace phones?
zh: 你就是用这个追踪电话的？

en: Is- is this real?
Isn't that Juno Labs?
Isn't that something he should already have?
zh: 那东西他不是本来就应该有吗？

en: It allows everyone to access data at speeds according to their process' priority.
zh: 它让每个人都能按照自己进程的优先级来以相应速度访问数据。

en: It always gets a laugh at Christmas parties.
zh: 圣诞派对上总能逗人笑。

en: It broke.
It can't be a coincidence.
It can't quite fit in the crack to move the bolt.
zh: 它塞不进缝隙去拨动门闩。

en: It comes in useful for stakeouts, undercover situations, and dates.
zh: 这对蹲点、卧底和约会都很有用。

en: It could be booby trapped!
It could be something to do with the key code required to access the vault.
zh: 这可能和进入保险库所需的钥匙密码有关。

en: It could save so many lives.
It could...
It does kind of look like that, doesn't it?
zh: 看起来确实有点像，对吧？

en: It does sound like it's coming from somewhere around here, though.
zh: 不过听起来确实像是从这附近某处传来的。

en: It doesn't do anything without a handle.
zh: 没有把手它什么也做不了。

en: It doesn't even have any wheels!
It doesn't have any water, but it's got plenty of rust.
zh: 里面没有水，但锈倒是不少。

en: It doesn't look like I can actually do anything with these.
zh: 看起来我对这些做不了什么。

en: It doesn't look like it even works.
It doesn't look like it has a touch sensitive display.
zh: 它看起来没有触摸感应显示屏。

en: It doesn't look like that door has been opened in a while.
zh: 那扇门看起来有阵子没开过了。

en: It doesn't really do anything by itself.
It doesn't seem to be the fridge making that noise.
zh: 那噪音似乎不是冰箱发出的。

en: It evokes the feeling of a warm mid-summer night of wine-fueled passion under the stars.
zh: 它让人想起仲夏夜星空下，酒意催情的温暖感觉。

en: It feels good to do some real police work for a change.
zh: 偶尔干点真正的警察工作，感觉不错。

en: It felt good to finally talk about my family with someone.
zh: 终于能跟人谈谈我的家人，感觉真好。

en: It fits perfectly.
It gives access to the building network, files, security system, and other utilities.
zh: 它可以访问楼宇网络、文件、安全系统和其他功能。

en: It gives me shivers just to think how much power is contained in this little device.
zh: 一想到这个小装置里蕴含着多大的力量，我就不寒而栗。

en: It goes into effect immediately, and I urge world leaders to adopt the program as well.
zh: 它立即生效，我敦促世界各国领导人也采纳这个项目。

en: It has decimated processing times for fingerprint and facial recognition scanning.
zh: 它大幅缩短了指纹和面部识别扫描的处理时间。

en: It has its moments.
It has my birthday on it.
It has not one, but two primary data trunks.
zh: 它有不止一条，而是两条主数据干线。

en: It helps the government track the flow of dollars around the globe.
zh: 它能帮政府追踪美元在全球的流动。

en: It is obviously coming in contact with one of the downed cables on the other side of the door.
zh: 它显然碰到了门另一侧垂落的电缆。

en: It is so important that I get this document.
zh: 拿到这份文件对我来说太重要了。

en: It is strange to use a computer that doesn't have a mouse.
zh: 用一台没有鼠标的电脑，感觉真奇怪。

en: It just doesn't feel safe.
It just gets stuck to itself, and then you have to throw it away because you can't separate it.
zh: 它只会粘在自己身上，然后你分不开就只能扔掉。

en: It just leads to the crane on the building site
zh: 它只是通向建筑工地的起重机

en: It just looks like a lot of old physics notes.
zh: 看起来只是一堆旧的物理笔记。

en: It learns.
It lets you interact with 3D models and simulate different conditions.
zh: 它能让你与3D模型互动，并模拟不同的条件。

en: It looks as if you should be able to slide one piece into another.
zh: 看起来应该能把一块滑进另一块里。

en: It looks broken.
It looks charged already.
It looks encrypted
It looks like Ed was trying to figure out exactly where the device needed to be placed.
zh: 看起来埃德在试图算出装置需要放置的确切位置。

en: It looks like I need a key to turn it on.
zh: 看起来我需要一把钥匙才能启动它。

en: It looks like a big ol' chunk of concrete just popped right off the wall.
zh: 看起来一大块混凝土刚从墙上掉了下来。

en: It looks like a blackout!
It looks like a paint store exploded.
zh: 看起来像是一家油漆店爆炸了。

en: It looks like an ordinary drafting compass.
zh: 它看起来像一把普通的绘图圆规。

en: It looks like business is doing well.
It looks like employee payroll records.
zh: 看起来是员工工资记录。

en: It looks like it can open.
It looks like it fell from the structure above.
zh: 看起来是从上面的结构掉下来的。

en: It looks like it leads to an elevator for a building crane.
zh: 看起来它通向建筑起重机的电梯。

en: It looks like it's supposed to have a handle.
zh: 看起来它应该有个把手。

en: It looks like something died in there.
zh: 里面好像有什么东西死了。

en: It looks like that's the pipe that caused the water leak.
zh: 看起来就是那根管子导致了漏水。

en: It looks like these power cables used to provide power to parts of the building.
zh: 这些电缆以前好像是给大楼部分区域供电的。

en: It looks like they discussed whether or not to get an espresso machine for the break room.
zh: 看起来他们讨论了要不要给休息室买台浓缩咖啡机。

en: It looks like this pin receives power.
zh: 这个引脚似乎接收电力。

en: It looks like tribal art.
It looks loose.
It looks really seedy past that fence.
zh: 那道栅栏后面看起来很不安全。

en: It looks safe enough in there now.
zh: 现在里面看起来够安全了。

en: It looks securely fastened to the wall.
zh: 它看起来牢牢固定在墙上。

en: It makes less sense than my last girlfriend.
zh: 比我上一个女朋友还让人摸不着头脑。

en: It matches my mood.
It means a lot.
It means that she wasn't their real mam{.
zh: 意思是她不是他们真正的妈妈{。

en: It might be helpful to us.
It might be important for my case.
zh: 它可能对我的案子很重要。

en: It might make for an alternate entrance if the front door is out of the question.
zh: 如果前门走不通，那也许能当另一个入口。

en: It most certainly is not alright!
It must be coming from the other end.
zh: 肯定是从另一头传来的。

en: It must be destroyed.
It must be mechanized.
It must be written in a different kind of ink.
zh: 它一定是用另一种墨水写的。

It must have been you who sent that thug to scare Anna!
zh: 一定是你派那个暴徒去吓唬安娜的！

en: It must have something to do with the event!
zh: 这肯定和那次事件有关！

en: It must've fried when the water hit the panel.
zh: 水打到面板上时它肯定烧坏了。

en: It must've slid over here when his table collapsed.

en: It needs to be used with a card.
It no longer holds a Resonance particle, so it should be harmless.
zh: 它不再含有共振粒子，所以应该无害。

en: It obviously means everything to him.
zh: 这显然对他意味着一切。

en: It really is a filthy bathroom.
It requires some screws to be of much use.
zh: 得配上一些螺丝才能派上用场。

zh: 上面写着“除掉那个记者”。

zh: 上面写着“15:00:00 14A 延迟前移。”

zh: 上面说需要一句“密钥短语”。

zh: 上面说这个阀门控制喷淋系统。

en: It seems I'm fated to keep coming back here.
zh: 看来我注定要一直回到这里。

It seems like we've got two options: the door or the window.
zh: 看起来我们有两个选择：门或者窗户。

en: It seems that these lights indicate the power levels of the main pins at the top and bottom of the grid.
zh: 这些灯似乎显示电网顶部和底部主引脚的电平。

en: It seems to be doing the trick. I'd better not mess with it.

en: It seems to be made of some sort of very thick glass.
zh: 它似乎是由某种非常厚的玻璃制成的。

zh: 它似乎想要薄薄的塑料片，而不是厚厚的皮革片。

en: It should give you enough time to trace some phone numbers.

It should take him a while to figure out where the problem is.

en: It should work on any device that has a USB port.

en: It sounds like a waterfall behind me.

zh: 上面还有我上周的草稿和咖啡杯，都放在我离开时的位置。

en: It still might be of use to me, though.
zh: 不过它也许还是对我有用。

en: It stinks that Tortoise was robbed like that. But I have to admit...
zh: 托托伊斯被那样抢劫真是倒霉。但我得承认……

It took a while, but we finally made a path to Morales' lab.
zh: 花了好一阵功夫，我们终于清出了一条通往莫拉莱斯实验室的路。

en: It was "Rey." The stone is worn.
It was a Sunday morning, just like any other...
zh: 那是个周日早晨，和别的早晨没什么两样……

en: It was an accident.
It was built to house electronic data and some types of small devices.
zh: 它是用来存放电子数据和某些类型的小型设备的。

en: It was chaos here. We were so short-staffed I had to go out on patrol!
zh: 这里一片混乱。人手太少了，我不得不出去巡逻！

en: It was cramped, and full of black mold.
It was in my pocket all this time!
zh: 原来它一直在我的口袋里！

en: It was just a facade.
It was my birthday!
It was my cell phone!
It was ruined!
It was supposed to just be Anna and me!
zh: 本来应该只有安娜和我！

en: It was, er...
It wasn't a nice way to go, I'll give it that. I was there, and I still can't believe what I saw.
zh: 那可不是什么好死法，这点我承认。我当时在场，到现在都不敢相信我看到的一切。

en: It wasn't an accident...
It wasn't like that!
It wasn't me, Reg.
It weighs just less than a kilogram, I'd say.
zh: 我估计重量不到一公斤。

en: It will need to be hoisted up by that mechanism next to it.
zh: 得用旁边的那个装置把它吊上去。

en: It will think it's grabbing a non-restricted document.
zh: 它会以为自己抓取的是一份非受限文件。

en: It won't turn any more.
It won't work. The battery's dead.
It worked!
It would be a crime to remove one of those sweet odes to pictorial art from its setting.
zh: 把那些对绘画艺术的甜蜜颂歌从原处拿走，那可是犯罪。

en: It would be easier to open the window than to break it.
It would be impossible to climb in there like this.
zh: 这样根本不可能爬进去。

en: It would be more welcoming if the place weren't on fire.
zh: 如果这地方没着火，会更欢迎人一些。

en: It'll probably take a wrench to turn that.
zh: 大概得用扳手才能转动。

en: It'll set them back years. It gives us time to reveal to the world that the Eleven Foundation was behind these attacks!
zh: 这会让他们倒退好几年。这给了我们时间向全世界揭露，这些袭击的幕后黑手是十一基金会！

en: It'll set them back years. Long enough to reveal what they did.
zh: 这会让他们倒退数年。足够久到揭露他们做过的事。

en: It's Dr. Morales' simulator.
zh: 那是莫拉莱斯博士的模拟器。

en: It's EXACTLY what I promised Dr. Morales I wouldn't let happen!
zh: 这正是我向莫拉莱斯博士保证过不会发生的事！

en: It's Oink's baby.
zh: 那是奥因克的心肝宝贝。

en: It's Se#or Bear!
It's a Phillips head screwdriver.
It's a bell.
It's a bit big for a souvenir.
It's a book...
It's a box.
It's a broken piece of brick.
It's a card reader. Unfortunately I don't have the appropriate card.
zh: 这是个读卡器。可惜我没有合适的卡。

en: It's a copy of a fax asking for Antevorta to lower their energy consumption.
zh: 这是一份传真的副本，要求Antevorta降低能耗。

en: It's a database of people's DNA!
It's a display showing off the company's award winning security system.
zh: 这是一个展示公司获奖安防系统的展台。

en: It's a drop-off point for all sorts of things, none of them nice.
zh: 那是个各种东西的交接点，没一样是干净的。

en: It's a hand-crank that controls the fire-escape ladders.
zh: 这是控制消防梯的手摇柄。

en: It's a hardhitting piece of investigative journalism.
zh: 这是一篇很有冲击力的调查报道。

en: It's a horse of a different color, man.
zh: 这完全是另一回事了，老兄。

en: It's a hospital, like the sign says.
zh: 就像牌子上写的，这是一家医院。

en: It's a jar full of coins.
It's a keyring with a couple keys on it.
zh: 这是一个挂着几把钥匙的钥匙圈。

en: It's a list of office expenses for things like coffee and Q-tips...
zh: 这是一份办公开支清单，比如咖啡和棉签之类的东西……

en: It's a little too thick...
It's a magnetic lock.
It's a pretty sturdy locker. I can't pull it open.
zh: 这柜子挺结实的。我拉不开。

en: It's a report written by an employee...
zh: 这是一名员工写的报告……

en: It's a round indentation on the side of the monitor.
zh: 这是显示器侧面的一个圆形凹槽。

en: It's a security camera.
It's a semingly random string of ones and zeroes...
zh: 这是一串看似随机的一和零……

en: It's a shame we can't trace this phone number.
zh: 可惜我们没法追踪这个电话号码。

en: It's a sign - a sign not to go in that place.
zh: 这是个标志——一个别进那地方的标志。

en: It's a sign listing the features and benefits of Tortoise brand security systems.
zh: 这是一块标牌，列出了托托伊斯牌安防系统的功能和优点。

en: It's a small safe.
It's a small, round device with a cell phone for a trigger.
zh: 这是一个圆形小装置，用一个手机作为触发器。

en: It's a spare battery for my prepaid phone.
zh: 这是我预付费手机的备用电池。

en: It's a strong door.
It's a sturdy hollow metal pipe.
zh: 这是一根结实的空心金属管。

en: It's a therapy exercise.
zh: 这是一种心理治疗练习。

en: It's a tripod with a device on top of it.
zh: 这是个三脚架，上面装着个装置。

en: It's a two-foot hollow metal rod.
zh: 这是一根两英尺长的空心金属棒。

en: It's a word.
It's about an hour past sunrise, but in this concrete jungle the sun barely reaches the streets during the day.
zh: 现在大约是日出后一小时，但在这片水泥丛林里，白天阳光几乎照不到街道上。

en: It's about time.
It's absolutely pitch black beyond these doors.
It's after midnight. I must've dozed off while reading.
zh: 已经过了午夜。我一定是看书时睡着了。

en: It's all out there, networked, consumable, predictable-
zh: 全都在那里，联网、可消费、可预测——

en: It's already open.
It's alright, Irina.
It's alright. I know none of it was my fault.
zh: 没事。我知道那都不是我的错。

en: It's an amazing piece of handiwork!
zh: 这是一件了不起的手工杰作！

en: It's an amazing piece of technology.
zh: 那真是件了不起的技术产品。

en: It's an automatic medication dispenser.
It's an award for safemaking, given last year.
zh: 这是去年颁发的制柜业奖项。

en: It's an elegant art. One that doesn't really get appreciated around here.
zh: 这是一门优雅的艺术。在这里却得不到什么赏识。

en: It's an ethical one.
It's an illegal database of people's DNA.
zh: 那是一个非法的民众DNA数据库。

en: It's an invoice from a vendor who supplied computer parts.
zh: 这是一家供应电脑零件的供应商开的发票。

en: It's an old-fashioned bell.
It's an open fuse slot.
zh: 这是个空的保险丝插槽。

en: It's an origami bird.  It looks like something is written on this paper...
zh: 是一只折纸鸟。纸上好像写着什么……

en: It's an ultrasonograph, a portable hand-held scanner for seeing inside patients' bodies.
zh: 这是超声波扫描仪，一种便携式手持扫描器，能看到病人体内。

en: It's as if she's covering something up.
It's bad, Reg.
It's been all over the news.
It's been my experience that folks with the right authority have access to minor legal documents.
zh: 根据我的经验，有权限的人能接触到次要法律文件。

en: It's been pretty busy since the blackout yesterday.
zh: 昨天停电之后一直挺忙的。

en: It's behind a thick glass door.
zh: 它在一扇厚厚的玻璃门后面。

en: It's blinking. I suppose that means this one is live.
zh: 它在闪。我想这说明这个是激活的。

en: It's called "Blood Under a Microscope."
It's certainly not going to be of any use. I'll just leave it here.
zh: 它肯定没什么用了。我就把它留在这儿吧。

en: It's completely empty apart from one small jar of cocktail onions.
zh: 里面空空如也，只有一小罐鸡尾酒洋葱。

en: It's covered in rust and old water streaks.
zh: 上面全是锈迹和旧水渍。

en: It's crazy - I've never even got a parking ticket.
zh: 太疯狂了——我连停车罚单都没收到过。

en: It's currently switched off.
It's currently switched on.
It's dark and scary outside.
It's dark under there. I don't like it...
It's designed to destroy everything inside if someone manages to hack through all the layers of security.
zh: 如果有人设法突破所有安全层，它被设计成会摧毁里面的一切。

en: It's embossed onto the cover.
It's empty.

en: Let me think about this for a second...
Let's avoid the chief if we can help it.
zh: 能避免的话，我们还是避开局长吧。

en: Let's cool off, get some rest, and think about our next move. We'll regroup right here in the morning.
zh: 大家冷静一下，休息休息，想想下一步怎么办。明早我们还在这里碰头。

en: Let's follow the breadcrumbs he left for us.
zh: 我们跟着他留下的面包屑走吧。

en: Let's get going, then.
Let's get him rambling again...
Let's get in closer and size up the situation.
Let's get this open...
Let's get up there. Whatever he's doing, we can stop that at least.
zh: 我们上去吧。不管他在做什么，至少我们能阻止那件事。

en: Let's give it a try.
Let's give this a try.
Let's go!
Let's go.
Let's have a look, shall we?
Let's have a look.
Let's hope Ed's still carrying his phone.
zh: 但愿埃德还带着他的电话。

en: Let's just break it open.
Let's just figure out where those Resonance devices were placed so we can follow his trail.
zh: 我们先弄清楚那些共振装置被放在哪里，好顺着他的踪迹追下去。

en: Let's just get through the door and get out of here.
zh: 我们赶紧穿过门离开这里吧。

en: Let's just get up there.
Let's keep digging. Something will elucidate us eventually.
zh: 继续挖吧。总会有什么让我们豁然开朗的。

en: Let's keep in mind that someone broke into your office and stole a client's information...
zh: 别忘了，有人闯入了你的办公室，偷走了一个客户的信息……

en: Let's keep the badge in the pants, Winston. Badge in the pants.
zh: 把警徽放回裤子里，温斯顿。警徽放回裤子里。

en: Let's look around some more. We must have missed something.
zh: 我们再四处找找。我们肯定漏掉了什么。

en: Let's look around the room a bit.
zh: 我们在房间里四处看看吧。

en: Let's look around.
Let's look at that piece of paper some more.
Let's meet
Let's move, Jimmy. If Ed's at the Antevorta office, we gotta get over there.
zh: 走吧，吉米。如果埃德在Antevorta办公室，我们得赶过去。

en: Let's pick one.
Let's pretend that all made sense... What's the big deal?
zh: 就当那些都说得通吧……那有什么大不了的？

en: Let's say - hypothetically - you might be right about Antevorta.
zh: 假设——只是假设——关于Antevorta你可能是对的。

en: Let's see if we can take a closer look...
zh: 我们看看能不能凑近点……

en: Let's see now, what should I type...
zh: 让我想想，我该输入什么……

en: Let's see what we've got to work with, here.
zh: 看看这里有什么能用的。

en: Let's see what's going on in the world today.
zh: 看看今天世界上都发生了什么。

en: Let's see...
Let's stop that question right there...
zh: 这个问题就到此为止吧……

en: Let's take a quick look inside and once I can confirm that an ambulance is needed, I'll call for one.
zh: 我们先进去快速看一眼，一旦我确认需要救护车，我就叫一辆。

en: Let's talk about this!
Let's try this again.
Let's wrap it up, lads.
Letting the characters be psychic
Liar. I saw you pull the trigger. We saw the device in your apartment.
zh: 骗子。我看见你扣动扳机。我们看见了你公寓里的装置。

Light switch
Like I said earlier, I want to visit my uncle's grave at All Saint's Cemetery.
zh: 就像我之前说的，我想去诸圣公墓看看我叔叔的墓。

zh: 就像我说的，我不擅长和人打交道，抱歉。

en: Like I said, he was paranoid.
Like I said, nothing's ever really a coincidence.
zh: 我说过，从来就没有什么真正的巧合。

en: Like I said, we can activate the magnets using those switches. That should raise the metal crates.
zh: 就像我说的，我们可以用那些开关激活磁铁。那应该能把金属板条箱升起来。

en: Like a sunset on the Rhine, or diving girls in the Aegean sea in springtime.
zh: 就像莱茵河上的日落，或是春天爱琴海里潜水的女孩。

zh: 和你们所有人一样，我今天早上醒来时面对的是一个不同的世界。

zh: 和这座城市里的其他东西一样，地铁门上满是涂鸦。

en: Like hell I will!
Like hell you were!
Like it or not, Ray and I are in this together.
zh: 不管喜不喜欢，雷和我现在是一条船上的人。

en: Like me.
Like not murdering girls who like you.
zh: 比如不杀喜欢你的女孩。

en: Like rows of corn in an endless cornfield...
zh: 就像无尽玉米地里的一排排玉米……

en: Like she used to...
Like the mouth of a hatchling, awaiting its mother's bounty.
zh: 就像雏鸟的嘴，等待着母亲的恩赐。

en: Like they're trying to melt my brains out, you know.
zh: 就像他们想把我的脑子融掉一样，你知道吧。

en: Likely lead-based paint.
Likewise.
Listen to Saul's whole story without interrupting him
zh: 不打断索尔，听完他的整个故事

Listen, Ed. We found the Resonance device in the basement. We took it.
zh: 听着，埃德。我们在地下室找到了共振装置。我们拿走了。

Listen, I've pretty much milked the medical staff dry at this point.
zh: 听着，我已经把医护人员能问的都问干了。

en: Litter
Little point in lugging that old thing around right now.
zh: 现在拖着那老东西到处走没什么意义。

en: Live Resonance device
Lives could depend on it.
Lives will be lost if you don't help us get that document.
zh: 如果你不帮我们拿到那份文件，会有人丧命的。

en: Locked
Locked again.
Locked chest
Locked door
Locked tight.
Locked up tight.
Locked, and probably irrelevant anyway.
zh: 锁着，而且大概也无关紧要。

en: Locked.
Locked.  Johnsen has the keys.
zh: 锁着。钥匙在约翰森那里。

en: Locked.  Johnsen keeps the keys.
zh: 锁着。钥匙在约翰森那儿。

en: Locker
Locks, cogs and keys.
Logan Cunningham
Logan Cunningham is all business
Logan Noir
Logging in
Login information incorrect.
Login successful.
Logout
Long story.
Long time no see, Ozzy!
Long time no see.
Long-Term Memory
Long-term memories
Look at me!  I'm like MacGyver out here!

en: Look at this place. Not even a kitchen.
zh: 看看这地方。连厨房都没有。

en: Look at those fuses. They have numbers on them. That must mean something.
zh: 看那些保险丝。上面有数字。肯定有含义。

en: Look for another Resonance device.
Look, I admit things got a little out of hand...

en: Look, I remember Dr. Morales.
zh: 听着，我记得莫拉莱斯博士。

en: Look, I told you, I just watch the box.
zh: 听着，我说过了，我只是看着箱子。

en: Look, I'll just go and call this into the station. We can dust your apartment. Figure out who that scumbag was...
zh: 这样，我先去把这事报告给局里。我们可以去你公寓取证。查查那混蛋是谁……

en: Look, I'm just Dr. Morales' mathematician.
zh: 听着，我只是莫拉莱斯博士手下的数学家。

en: Look, do you need anything important? 'Cause I've got a lot of work to do.
zh: 听着，你有什么要紧事吗？我还有很多活要干。

en: Look, he's in the building. He's hurt!
zh: 听着，他就在楼里。他受伤了！

en: Look, just because I'm good with numbers doesn't mean I know how to break into high-security systems.
zh: 听着，我擅长数字不代表我知道怎么闯入高安全系统。

en: Look, lives will be lost if you don't help us get that document.
zh: 听着，如果你不帮我们拿到那份文件，会有人丧命的。

en: Look, mister...
Look, relax. He might be fine.
zh: 听着，放松点。他也许没事。

en: Look, sir, my shift's over and I've got to get going.
zh: 听着，先生，我下班了，得走了。

en: Look, that explosion in the lab was no accident.
zh: 听着，实验室那场爆炸不是意外。

en: Look, whatever you may think of me, those two are far worse.
zh: 听着，不管你怎么看我，那两个人比我坏得多。

en: Look, you don't know it, but you need me!
zh: 听着，你不知道，但你需要我！

en: Look, you might not know it yet, but I'm one of the good guys.
zh: 听着，你可能还不知道，但我是好人这边的。

en: Look...
Looking quite lissome today, Emma.
zh: 艾玛，今天看着真是身姿曼妙啊。

Looks like Ed left some of our stuff here.
zh: 看来埃德把我们的东西留了一些在这儿。

en: Looks like I'm last in the fantasy baseball league. As usual.
zh: 看来我在梦幻棒球联盟里垫底了。跟往常一样。

en: Looks like I'm still in the database.
Looks like I'm still in the fantasy baseball league.
zh: 看来我还在梦幻棒球联盟里。

en: Looks like Johnsen holidays in the Ardennes.
zh: 看来约翰森去阿登度假。

en: Looks like Officer Johnsen likes this job a lot - he's down for most of the shifts.
zh: 看来约翰森警官很喜欢这份工作——大部分班次都是他。

en: Looks like Todd's locker.
Looks like a bomb hit this place.
zh: 看起来像被炸弹炸过一样。

en: Looks like a cellphone shop.
Looks like a control panel for something complicated.
zh: 看起来像是某种复杂东西的控制面板。

en: Looks like a door to a storage room.
zh: 看起来是通往储藏室的门。

en: Looks like a door to the basement.
zh: 看起来是通往地下室的门。

en: Looks like a fair number of pages have already been used on this notepad.
zh: 这个便笺本看起来已经用了不少页了。

en: Looks like a fried egg with a blob of tomato sauce.
zh: 看起来像煎蛋配一团番茄酱。

en: Looks like a mainframe or a rack of servers.
zh: 看起来像主机或一排服务器。

en: Looks like a mark-12 Basilisk motion detector.
zh: 看起来像12型蛇怪运动探测器。

en: Looks like a medical supplies drawer, which is odd considering this is a server room.
zh: 看起来像是个医疗用品抽屉，考虑到这是服务器机房，这很奇怪。

en: Looks like a mutant Christmas tree.
zh: 看着像棵变异的圣诞树。

en: Looks like a photo of a steel pole.
zh: 看起来像一张钢柱的照片。

en: Looks like a pretty basic model. It probably doesn't even have wifi access.
zh: 看起来是个很基础的型号。可能连wifi都没有。

en: Looks like a security door.
Looks like a stolen hotel mini-bar.
zh: 看起来像是从酒店偷来的迷你吧。

en: Looks like an internal mail pigeonhole.
zh: 看起来像是内部邮件信件格。

en: Looks like basic paperwork and junk.
zh: 看起来是些基本文件和垃圾。

en: Looks like he's coming to...
Looks like he's going to be here a while.
zh: 看来他还要在这儿待上一阵子。

en: Looks like it fell from the ceiling.
zh: 看起来是从天花板上掉下来的。

en: Looks like it leads to some sort of underground parking lot.
zh: 看起来它通向某个地下停车场。

en: Looks like it leads to the building work.
Looks like it's all lit up again now.
zh: 现在看起来又全亮起来了。

en: Looks like my Great-Aunt Suzie's gravestone.
zh: 看起来像我姑婆苏西的墓碑。

en: Looks like some sort of device taped onto a cellphone.
zh: 看起来像是某种用胶带贴在手机上的装置。

en: Looks like some sort of electric meter.
Looks like that might open something.
zh: 看来那东西能打开什么。

en: Looks like that sign's had better days.
zh: 看来那块牌子风光不再了。

en: Looks like the car I drove in grad school.
zh: 看起来像我读研究生时开的那辆车。

en: Looks like this is for you.
Looks like your average fusebox to me.
zh: 在我看来就是个普通的保险丝盒。

en: Looks uninviting in there.
Loose bar
Loose paper
Loose wires
Lots of empty cubicles around here.
Lots of flashy lights and whirring noises.
zh: 一堆闪来闪去的灯和嗡嗡作响的声音。

en: Lovely to see you again, Miss Castellanos.
zh: 很高兴再次见到你，卡斯特利亚诺斯小姐。

en: Lower your weapon.
Lucky for us he's a neat freak.
zh: 算我们走运，他是个有洁癖的人。

en: Lyrics: Nikolas Sideris, Louiza Sofianopoulou
MAGNETLOCKERVICTORY!
MEMO
MY gun you mean. I will see you pay for this, Ed.
zh: 你是说我的枪。我会让你为此付出代价的，埃德。

en: Magnet
Magnet for gossip and idle chat.
Magnetic personality
Main Hallway and Entrance!
Mainframe
Maintenance
Maintenance door
Maintenance guy from yesterday?
Maintenance rooms, I think. Nothing too important.
zh: 我想是维修间吧。没什么重要的。

en: Maintenance uniform
Make small talk.
Make sure you keep an eye on them.
Makes me wanna take a look around police HQ, in case I never see it again.
zh: 让我想四处看看警察总部，以防再也见不到了。

en: Making high-tech security systems, alarms, and biometric scanners certainly pays the bills...
zh: 制造高科技安保系统、警报器和生物识别扫描仪确实能养家糊口……

en: Malformed FTTN
Malfunction in AC
Mama made it for me. It makes pretty colors when the light's on.
zh: 妈妈给我做的。灯亮的时候会有漂亮的颜色。

en: Mama said I should keep them in here.
zh: 妈妈说应该把它们放在这里。

en: Mama said it'd be safe.
Mama says I'm a good drawer.
Mama!
Man, I love USB slots.
Maneuver everyone through the super collider

en: Mark-13 if I'm lucky.
Masking tape
Masking tape, to mark out... something.
zh: 遮蔽胶带，用来标出……什么东西。

Mastering: Odeon Mastering
Math is actually very beautiful.
Max Kaye
Max Kaye - 6849X
Maybe I can help you with that.
zh: 也许我能帮你解决这个。

en: Maybe I could hack into the servers ... if I could find my way in.
zh: 也许我能黑进服务器……要是我能找到进去的路。

en: Maybe I could hide under here...
zh: 也许我可以藏在这下面……

en: Maybe I could...
Maybe I should cut down on the pizzas a little.
zh: 也许我该少吃点披萨了。

en: Maybe I should dispose of this bottle labelled "
zh: 也许我该处理掉这个标着“

en: Maybe I should give it to Ozzy.
Maybe I should just talk into the cell phone.
zh: 也许我该直接对着手机说话。

en: Maybe I'm just not cut out for particle physics.
zh: 也许我根本就不是搞粒子物理的料。

en: Maybe because I like to keep out of the office if I can.
zh: 也许是因为我只要能不进办公室就不进。

en: Maybe even prototypes of the technology.
zh: 甚至可能有这项技术的原型机。

en: Maybe even prototypes.
Maybe he can help me.
Maybe he wrote down the password somewhere.
zh: 也许他把密码写在什么地方了。

en: Maybe he'll have sobered up by the time help arrives.
zh: 也许等救援来的时候他就清醒了。

en: Maybe if I had some more leverage...
zh: 要是我有更多杠杆力就好了……

en: Maybe if I had super-powers I could climb that.
zh: 除非我有超能力，否则爬不上去。

en: Maybe if I let my fingernails grow out.
zh: 也许等我指甲长长了才行。

en: Maybe if I look closer I can find somewhere to plug it in.
zh: 也许我仔细看看，就能找到可以插进去的地方。

en: Maybe if you hadn't been acting so shady to me I wouldn't have-
zh: 要不是你对我鬼鬼祟祟的，我也不会——

en: Maybe it was planted!
Maybe it'll come to us later.
zh: 也许之后我们会想起来的。

en: Maybe one day they'll give the hospital a name other than just "Hospital."
zh: 也许有一天他们会给这家医院起个名字，而不只是叫“医院”。

en: Maybe one more try...
Maybe some duct tape can secure that pipe in there long enough to put out the fire.
zh: 也许用些管道胶带能把那根管子固定住，撑到把火扑灭。

en: Maybe someone can do it for us?
Maybe someone there can tell me how I can get the blueprints out of this thing.
zh: 也许那儿有人能告诉我怎么把蓝图从这玩意儿里弄出来。

en: Maybe something can be done about that.
zh: 也许这事能有办法解决。

en: Maybe something he's carrying might be useful.
zh: 也许他身上带的东西有用。

en: Maybe something in here can give us a clue.
zh: 也许这里有什么能给我们线索。

en: Maybe the Detective will have some way of tracking this guy down?
zh: 也许警探有办法追踪到这家伙？

en: Maybe there's another way in...
Maybe there's something about this book I found that can help us.
zh: 也许我找到的这本书里有什么能帮上我们。

en: Maybe there's something else he wants instead?
zh: 也许他想要点别的什么？

en: Maybe there's something in this room that can help us.
zh: 也许这房间里有什么能帮上我们。

en: Maybe they keep tools in there?
zh: 也许他们把工具放在里面？

en: Maybe try contacting your supervisor?
zh: 也许试试联系你的主管？

en: Maybe we can find a way past that security door in the hallway.
zh: 也许我们能在走廊里找到办法通过那扇安全门。

en: Maybe we can hot-wire it.
Maybe we can open that door using this panel.
zh: 也许我们可以用这块面板打开那扇门。

en: Maybe we should trust him, Ed.
zh: 也许我们该相信他，埃德。

en: Maybe you can come up with something, Ed.
zh: 也许你能想出点什么，埃德。

en: Maybe you didn't understand the moral of my story, Raymond.
zh: 也许你没听懂我故事里的寓意，雷蒙德。

en: Maybe you should ask Oink about it.
Maybe you're right, maybe it IS silly and superstitious.
zh: 也许你说得对，也许这确实很傻、很迷信。

en: Maybe, when this is over, you can tell me more about him?
zh: 也许，等这事结束，你能多跟我讲讲他？

en: Maybe. I've had a lot of clients.
Maybe. That's what they want us to think, anyway.
zh: 也许吧。反正他们想让我们这么以为。

en: Maybe. We'd have to get in closer to try.
zh: 也许吧。我们得靠近点才能试。

en: Me! The top security expert in Aventine City!
zh: 我！阿文廷市顶尖的安全专家！

en: Me?
Me? Why I never!
Meaning he didn't choose it because he liked the neighborhood. Let's look around.
zh: 意思是他选这里不是因为喜欢这个街区。我们四处看看。

en: Meaning you?
Meaning?
Means nothing. Until I see proof, it means nothing. You got that?
zh: 什么都说明不了。除非我看到证据，否则什么都说明不了。明白了吗？

Mechanism handle
Memory

Not yet.

Nothing useful here.
Nothing we need. We need to get to the tech room.

Now this explosion...

So dark... I remember...

So how 'bout some answers?

So how do we get in?

zh: 那你是怎么被卡在这个前台岗位上的？

So how've you been, Emma?

en: So is this a typical day for you, Ray?
zh: 雷，这对你来说是平常的一天吗？

en: So it's true?
So let's just get this over with.
So let's stay on topic.
So many criminals. Do you think you'll ever catch them all?
zh: 这么多罪犯。你觉得你能把他们全都抓住吗？

en: So many of my vaults are custom designed for special purposes.
zh: 我的许多保险库都是为特殊用途定制的。

en: So many things blocked the entrance to the lab's front doors.
zh: 好多东西堵住了实验室前门的入口。

en: So peaceful up here.
So send the FD.
So she really didn't mean anything to you.
zh: 所以她对你是真的毫无意义。

en: So that simulator. That's where Uncle Javi... got hurt?
zh: 那台模拟器。哈维叔叔就是在那儿……受伤的？

en: So that's their big plan.
zh: 原来这就是他们的大计划。

en: So the only option left is to go over them.
zh: 所以剩下的唯一选择就是从上面过去。

zh: 所以今天早上，在两院和国会的一致批准下，我签署了一项名为“Antevorta”的新反恐措施，使其成为法律。

en: So this other person could open the vault?

en: So this vault has to be destroyed.

So we flip the board! Destroy the mainframe!

zh: 所以我们可能得靠魅力过关。

en: So what are the cotton swabs for?

So what brings you to the archive?

zh: 那是什么让你改变了主意？

So what did you want with Tortoise's files on the vault?

zh: 那我得怎么做才能拿到那份蓝图？

zh: 那你对这个十一基金会了解多少？

en: So what do you think of the cop?
zh: 那你觉得那个警察怎么样？

en: So what does that simulator do? Anything that can help us?

en: So what is the plan, Detective?
So what would a Resonance weapon look like?
zh: 那共振武器会是什么样子？

en: So what you're saying now is that the explosion in Morales' lab was not an accident.
zh: 所以你现在是说，莫拉莱斯实验室的爆炸不是意外。

en: So what's Johnsen up to these days?
So what's Oink up to these days?

en: So what's in the basement?
So what's in the display cases?
So what's in the drawer?
So what's in this vault?
zh: 那这个保险库里有什么？

en: So what's new, Emma?
zh: 那么，有什么新消息吗，艾玛？

en: So when you get a chance...?
So where is this guy?
So why steal the vault files from Tortoise?
zh: 那为什么要从托托伊斯那里偷保险库文件？

zh: 既然你有我见过最大的计算机系统，为什么还要用文件柜？

zh: 那你为什么要这么做，埃德？

zh: 所以就是拿两个装置，把它们分开，然后你一关掉，中间的东西就炸了。

zh: 所以你是跟埃德一伙的？

en: So you're not useless afterall.
zh: 看来你也不是一无是处。

en: So you're saying he used your birthday as the combination?

So your argument is that someone went out of his way to set you up?

zh: 这么说，Antevorta是某种秘密DNA数据库，可能还跟政府有关联？

zh: 这么说，Antevorta是某种秘密DNA数据库。

zh: 那么，埃德。我打赌你宁愿待在家里捧着一本漂亮的方程式书之类的，嗯？

zh: 于是，我掏出我那把可靠的扳手，把它砸碎，然后爬了出去。

zh: 所以，如果我哪天需要，我知道去哪儿找。

So... tell me about yourself.
So... what do you do here?
So... you're the janitor here, huh?

zh: 挂在Antevorta主机房里的一幅抽象画。

Some light is filtering up from the opening below.

Some low-level cat burglar caught breaking into the computer chip factory uptown had named this post-office as the contact-point for his buyer.

Some of the pages have been ripped out.
Some papers on the desk of the ICU.

Somebody's office chair took quite the ride after the event.

Someone might be watching Anna's apartment.

Someone was following him?

Something's pinned under that slab of steel.

Son of a bitch...

Sorry I tried to brush you off there...

Sorry about that.
Sorry for ignoring you earlier, by the way.
zh: 顺便说一句，抱歉刚才没理你。

en: Sorry for the shabby digs, but we need to keep a low profile for now.
zh: 抱歉地方寒酸，但我们暂时得保持低调。

en: Sorry pal, I can't see it over the phone.
zh: 抱歉伙计，隔着电话我看不到。

zh: 抱歉，孩子，我觉得我的脚踝断了。我哪儿也去不了。

en: Sorry to bother you, ma'am.
Sorry wrong number.
Sorry, Bennet. Ed might be sleaze, but these Eleven Foundation guys are worse.
zh: 抱歉，贝内特。埃德也许是个混蛋，但十一基金会的这些家伙更糟。

zh: 抱歉，卡萨诺瓦，我不能随便把那种信息给人。

Sorry, I tend to ramble when I meet famous people.
zh: 抱歉，我见到名人就容易话多。

Sorry, I've got to run.
Sorry, Ray?

zh: 抱歉，铁皮人。那个档案室存的是原始纸质文件。就是，真正的纸质文件！

zh: 对不起，叔叔。我需要这个样本来查明是谁杀了你——以及为什么。

Sorry, but you're not authorized to go in there.
Sorry, did you say something? I was distracted by that purple horse.

Sorry, why are you here?
Sorry, you're in the wrong place.
Sorry.

Step ladder
Step up to the archive screen and scan your fingerprint.
zh: 走到档案屏幕前，扫描你的指纹。

en: Steve,[[Racecar driver?  That's impressive![[Nice to meet you, racecar Steve. ;) I'm Amy.[[I'm also a first-timer on these dating websites. I always laughed at people who turned to the internet to find love, but then found out that when you have my job it's the only place you have time to go looking for romance.[[I finally gave in and here I am chatting with a racecar driver![[
zh: 史蒂夫，[[赛车手？那可真厉害！[[很高兴认识你，赛车手史蒂夫。；）我是艾米。[[我也是第一次用这种约会网站。我以前总是嘲笑那些上网找爱情的人，后来才发现，干我这份工作，只有网上才有时间找浪漫。[[我终于妥协了，现在我就在跟一个赛车手聊天！[[

en: Steven LaRue
Steven LaRue - 7884A
Sticking my finger in it doesn't do much.
zh: 把手指伸进去没什么用。

en: Sticky note
Still connected, then?
Still gotta do something about the fire and the sparks, though.
zh: 不过还得处理那团火和那些火花。

en: Still, we don't exactly have proof, so we'd better keep quiet about this for now.
zh: 不过，我们并没有确凿证据，所以最好暂时对此保密。

en: Still. Good luck getting Mr. Tortoise to press charges. He'll never admit his place was robbed.
zh: 不过。祝你能让托托伊斯先生提出指控。他绝不会承认自己的地盘被抢了。

en: Stolen?
Stop it - my head hurts too much to laugh at your cat-piss detective work.
zh: 别说了——我头疼得厉害，笑不动你那猫尿一样的侦探把戏。

en: Stop knocking
Stop them from gaining control. I can do that, at the very least.
zh: 阻止他们获得控制权。至少这个我能做到。

en: Stop them? Stop them from what?
zh: 阻止他们？阻止他们什么？

en: Stop who?
Stop you? So you ARE planning something!
zh: 阻止你？所以你果然在谋划什么！

en: Straight through the bone, as well.
Stripped car
Stuck?
Subtle, but confident, with a hint of ennui.
zh: 含蓄，但自信，还带着一丝倦怠。

en: Subway doors
Subway map
Subway trains crashing, elevators dropping, intersections full of wrecked cars.
zh: 地铁列车相撞，电梯坠落，十字路口满是撞毁的汽车。

en: Such a pretty light.
Such piffling tools won't help you get into one of my safes, I assure you.
zh: 这种小玩意儿可帮不了你打开我的保险箱，我向你保证。

en: Suits?
Sunlight
Super Special Thanks
Super sleuths!!
Super weapon?
Sure did.
Sure thing!
Sure thing.
Sure thing. The room's yours.
Sure we can, but I'm not an active cop right now. Or had you forgotten?
zh: 当然能，但我现在不是在职警察。还是你忘了？

en: Sure you can, it's 898-GET-BENT.
Sure!
Sure, because that's worked out SO well up till now.
zh: 当然，毕竟到现在为止这招效果“好”得很。

en: Sure, he's a paranoid, delusional drug-addict, but we all have our faults.
zh: 没错，他是个偏执、妄想、吸毒成瘾的人，但谁没有缺点呢。

en: Sure, let me check.
Sure, or a cell phone...
Sure.
Sure. Haven't you ever wanted to put the holes in the bad guys instead of patching them up?
zh: 当然。你就从没想过在坏人身上打洞，而不是给他们补洞？

en: Sure. Whatever.
Surely he can't sit at that desk all day. That's horrible for the circulation.
zh: 他总不能整天坐在那张桌子前吧。那对血液循环太糟糕了。

en: Surely there's something in it for you more than just profit?
zh: 对你来说肯定有比赚钱更重要的东西吧？

en: Surely you've broken a few regulations in your time!
zh: 你肯定也违反过一些规定吧！

en: Surveillance gear, I think.
Surveillance gear... phone tracing equipment.
zh: 监控设备……电话追踪设备。

en: Suspicious...
Switch
Switching characters in mid-conversation
TV
TV Speech
TV rots the intellect.
Tails.
Take a look around
Take all
Take flipping a coin, for example.
Take it up with the chemistry department.
Take it.
Take me to him!
Take them!
Take your pick.
Taking lives, being betrayed, perverting Resonance...
zh: 夺人性命、遭人背叛、滥用共振……

en: Talk about stakeout.
Talk to her!
Talk to that nice girl on the subway
zh: 在地铁上和那位好姑娘交谈

en: Talk to you later.
Talking to the dead
Talking to yourself is a sign of madness!
zh: 自言自语是疯癫的征兆！

en: Tanks empty
Tch, naughty!
Te prometo.
Te prometo...
Team up to fix the lab's water system
zh: 合力修复实验室的供水系统

en: Teamwork
Tech Room
Technically, I can fill perscriptions at the hospital. But ethically?
zh: 严格来说，我可以在医院开处方。但道德上呢？

en: Technophile
Tell him about the device in Bennet's pocket.
zh: 告诉他贝内特口袋里的装置。

en: Tell him he betrayed you.
Tell him you're on his tail.
Tell me about Morales' vault.
zh: 跟我说说莫拉莱斯的保险库。

en: Tell me about the archive.
Tell me about the vault you built for him.
zh: 跟我说说你为他建的保险库。

en: Tell me about this "Antevorta Project."
Tell me about yourself.
Tell me again what it is you do here?
zh: 再说一遍你在这里是做什么的？

en: Tell me more about the Eleven Foundation.
zh: 再跟我说说十一基金会的事。

en: Tell me more about the technology behind that control panel?
zh: 跟我多讲讲那个控制面板背后的技术？

en: Tell me what do you do here again.
zh: 再说一遍你在这里做什么。

en: Tell me what you're thinking!
Tell me you haven't sold many of those.
zh: 别告诉我你卖出去很多。

en: Tell me you traced him...
Tell me, Mr. Eddings, what exactly happened in that lab?
zh: 告诉我，埃丁斯先生，那个实验室里到底发生了什么？

en: Tell me. How do I know that?
Ten thousand dollars!
Ten years ago, I wouldn't have needed that thing to climb up to that window.
zh: 十年前，我爬那扇窗户根本不需要那东西。

en: Terminal
Terminal keyboard
Terminal pin
Terminal screen
Terrorists?
Testing valve
Text Entry!!!
Thank God I won't be here much longer.
zh: 谢天谢地，我不用在这儿待太久了。

en: Thank God for emergency brakes and lights.
zh: 谢天谢地有紧急制动和照明。

en: Thank God for that ladder.
Thank you for coming here with me.
Thank you for playing!
Thank you so much!
Thank you!
Thank you.
Thankfully I won't have to climb in there again.
zh: 谢天谢地，我不用再爬进去了。

en: Thanks
Thanks again!
Thanks for coming with me to visit the cemetery.
Thanks for getting us that DNA sample. Let's get on with it.
zh: 谢谢你帮我们弄到DNA样本。我们继续吧。

en: Thanks for the coin.
Thanks for the information, though!
zh: 不过还是谢谢你提供的信息！

en: Thanks for the vote of confidence.
Thanks for trusting me enough to take me.
zh: 谢谢你这么信任我，带我一起去。

en: Thanks for your help.
Thanks for your keys.
Thanks, Johnsen.
Thanks, Nik!
Thanks.
Thanks. Do you have any favorites?
Thanks. I just wish I could have got to Doctor Morales earlier.
zh: 谢谢。我只希望能早点赶到莫拉莱斯博士那里。

en: Thanks. I'm pretty good at puzzles.
Thanks. You gotta go with what inspires ya.
That AutoPharm machine. You have access to it?
zh: 那台自动药房机。你能用吗？

en: That Ozzy guy won't talk to me. One of you mopes needs to do it.
zh: 那个奥兹不会跟我说话。你们哪个闷葫芦得去一趟。

en: That Resonance device is our ace-in-the-hole.
zh: 那个共振装置是我们的王牌。

en: That ain't going back there.
zh: 那玩意儿不会放回那儿去的。

en: That ain't gonna help me.
That ashtray is a hub of criminal activity.
zh: 那个烟灰缸是犯罪活动的中心。

en: That ashtray was in clear violation of several building and fire codes.
zh: 那个烟灰缸明显违反了好几条建筑和消防法规。

en: That bathroom is so filthy, I sometimes feel dirtier coming out of the shower than I did going in.
zh: 那浴室脏得我有时觉得洗完澡出来比进去时还脏。

en: That better not come out of my paycheck! I didn't-
zh: 那最好别从我的工资里扣！我没——

en: That big ass door slammed shut when that panel on the wall started shooting sparks.
zh: 墙上那块面板开始冒火花的时候，那扇大门就砰地关上了。

en: That big chunk of wall blocking the front door...
zh: 堵住前门的那一大块墙……

en: That big rock is blocking the doors.
That blouse looks very becoming on you.
zh: 那件衬衫穿在你身上真好看。

en: That book had better be worth it.
That broken window might be our only way in.
zh: 那扇破窗可能是我们唯一的入口。

en: That bulb burned out on me yesterday.
That came out wrong.
That can't be a coincidence.
That car has been hit pretty hard. Apparently the radio wasn't enough for the thieves.
zh: 那辆车被撞得挺惨。看来小偷光拿收音机还不够。

en: That car's not going anywhere.
That chair must have fallen from the floor above when the ceiling disappeared.
zh: 那把椅子一定是在天花板消失时从上面一层掉下来的。

en: That clock has stopped.
That clock's not running.
That coffee looks... ick.
That computer looks like a great place to start looking.
zh: 那台电脑看起来是个很好的入手点。

en: That computer looks like it could take over the world.
zh: 那台电脑看起来能接管世界。

en: That control panel has to be powered by something, but I'm not sure what.
zh: 那个控制面板肯定有电源，但我不确定是什么。

en: That control panel looks like it needs fuses to complete a circuit. Have you seen any around here?
zh: 那个控制面板看起来需要保险丝才能接通电路。你在这附近见过吗？

en: That cop's watching us.
That could be a safety hazard.
That could be useful.
That creep on the subway? That's you.
zh: 地铁上那个变态？就是你。

en: That darn bulb has burned out. Or maybe it's the socket.
zh: 那该死的灯泡烧坏了。也许插座也有问题。

en: That did it!
That doesn't fit in the slot.
That doesn't fit there.
That doesn't make very much sense does it?
That doesn't need any fine cleaning.
That doesn't work.
That door almost certainly leads to the basement.
zh: 那扇门几乎肯定是通往地下室的。

en: That door is the most secure thing here.
zh: 那扇门是这里最安全的东西。

en: That door isn't opened by a normal key. It's got an electronic lock.
zh: 那扇门不是用普通钥匙开的。它装的是电子锁。

en: That door isn't opening, even though I know the secret knock.
zh: 那扇门打不开，虽然我知道暗号。

en: That door leads to some other wards.
zh: 那扇门通往其他病房区。

en: That door leads to some places I don't need to go.
zh: 那扇门通往一些我不需要去的地方。

en: That door leads to the ambulance bay, but it's usually locked.
zh: 那扇门通向救护车停放区，但通常锁着。

en: That door looks heavy.
That door looks pretty solid.
That door looks secure.
That door seems to lead into a storage room, but it's full of boxes.
zh: 那扇门似乎通向一间储藏室，但里面堆满了箱子。

en: That drawer is for Antevorta users only, sir.
zh: 那个抽屉只供Antevorta用户使用，先生。

en: That drawer used to be full of cotton swabs.
zh: 那个抽屉以前装满了棉签。

en: That egghead Ed thinks he can use these blueprints to sneak into Morales' lab.
zh: 那个书呆子埃德觉得他可以用这些蓝图溜进莫拉莱斯的实验室。

en: That explains why this place feels a little damp.
zh: 这解释了为什么这地方感觉有点潮。

en: That fine gentleman goes by the unlikely name of Officer Oinkleberry.
zh: 那位好先生有个不太可能的名字，叫乌因克尔贝里警官。

en: That glass looks thick.
That guy came from the alley; we don't have visibility down there.
zh: 那家伙是从巷子里出来的；那边我们看不到。

en: That guy who chased you. He didn't hurt you, did he?
zh: 追你的那个人。他没伤到你吧？

en: That harpy has her laser-like eyes on me.
zh: 那个泼妇用她激光般的眼睛盯着我。

en: That hole at the lab. That was caused by one of these Resonance devices?
zh: 实验室那个洞。是这些共振装置之一造成的？

en: That hole... that's what killed Uncle Javi?
zh: 那个洞……就是它害死了哈维叔叔？

en: That information doesn't concern you. Sorry.
That is an order officer!
That is completely illegal and I would never ignore rules and regulations in such a manner.
zh: 那是完全违法的，我绝不会以那种方式无视规章制度。

en: That isn't grounds for arresting him.
That just leads to some other wards. I don't need to go there.
zh: 那只是通往其他病房区。我不需要去那里。

en: That just makes it easier to toss the place.
zh: 那反而更方便翻个底朝天。

en: That keypad looks like a good bet for getting those doors open.
zh: 那个键盘看起来是打开那些门的好办法。

en: That kind of "ends justify the means" philosophy never cut it in the military.
zh: 那种“为达目的不择手段”的理念在军队里从来行不通。

en: That lab computer. There must be something useful left on it.
zh: 那台实验室电脑。上面肯定还留着什么有用的东西。

en: That leads to the rest of the hospital.
zh: 那通往医院的其他区域。

en: That letter wasn't the only unexplained note we've come across.
zh: 那封信不是我们遇到的唯一一张无法解释的纸条。

en: That looks just like my office computer. In fact, it's probably the same model.
zh: 那台跟我办公室的电脑一模一样。说不定就是同款。

en: That mainframe houses a lot of secrets.
zh: 那台主机里藏着许多秘密。

en: That mainframe is pretty impressive looking.
zh: 那台主机看起来相当气派。

en: That may be, but there's no way that thing is legal.
zh: 也许吧，但那东西绝对不合法。

en: That metal door is too heavy to be opened conventionally. Dr. Morales must have had a system for opening it.
zh: 那扇金属门太重了，没法用常规方法打开。莫拉莱斯博士肯定有一套打开它的系统。

en: That metal slab at the end of the super collider? Be careful you're not standing under it when it falls. It's heavier than it looks.
zh: 超对撞机尽头那块金属板？小心它掉下来的时候别站在下面。它比看上去重得多。

en: That metal slab on the other side of the collider looks dangerous. Better not stand near it when it falls.
zh: 对撞机另一边的金属板看起来很危险。它掉下来时最好别站在附近。

en: That might have DNA on it, but it's far too big to fit in the narrow recession.
zh: 那上面可能有DNA，但它太大了，塞不进狭窄的凹槽。

en: That must be Mrs. Krauze's apartment. I've never seen it from out here.
zh: 那一定是克劳泽太太的公寓。我从外面从没见过它。

en: That must be it, over there.
That must be my uncle's vault.
zh: 那一定是我叔叔的保险库。

en: That nice young lady sure needs a lot of interrogating.
zh: 那位漂亮的年轻女士可真需要好好审讯一番。

en: That note you dropped last night? It all makes sense now.
zh: 你昨晚掉的那张纸条？现在一切都说得通了。

en: That old janitor outside keeps his stuff in here.
zh: 外面那个老清洁工把东西放在这里。

en: That old thing is drier than the Sahara.
zh: 那老东西比撒哈拉还干。

en: That only works by connecting it to a device's USB port.
zh: 那东西只有连到设备的USB端口才能用。

en: That other Resonance device must be here somewhere.
zh: 另一台共振装置肯定就在这里某个地方。

en: That panel controlled the security door that was blocking the hallway.
zh: 那块面板控制着堵住走廊的那扇安全门。

en: That panel controls the access to secure documents.
zh: 那个面板控制着机密文件的访问权限。

en: That panel opened the heavy door to the vault room.
zh: 那个面板打开了通往保险库房间的厚重门。

en: That panel opened the heavy door.
zh: 那个面板打开了厚重的门。

en: That panel opened the thick steel door to the next room.
zh: 那个面板打开了通往下一个房间的厚钢门。

en: That panel over there has wires leading to that big door over there.
zh: 那边那块面板的电线通向那边那扇大门。

en: That panel probably controls the door.
zh: 那个面板大概是控制门的。

en: That panel should control the door to the next room.
zh: 那个面板应该控制通往下一个房间的门。

en: That panel should open the door to the vault room.
zh: 那个面板应该能打开通往保险库房间的门。

en: That photographer clearly had a problem with the zoom function.
zh: 那摄影师显然跟变焦功能有仇。

en: That pipe's going to need replacing.
That post office must have closed down in the cutbacks.
zh: 那家邮局肯定是在削减开支时关掉的。

en: That reminds me of the time I visited New York.
zh: 这让我想起我去纽约的那次。

en: That reminds me, I haven't brushed my teeth today.
zh: 这倒提醒我了，我今天还没刷牙。

en: That reminds me, I need to file my paperwork.
zh: 这倒提醒我了，我得去归档我的文书。

en: That safe seems impossible to open.
zh: 那个保险箱好像打不开。

en: That seems like a waste of energy right now.
zh: 现在这似乎是在浪费精力。

en: That seems too much of a coincidence.
That shifty-eyed guy we saw on the stakeout was also after Resonance.
zh: 我们蹲守时看到的那个贼眉鼠眼的家伙，也在追查共振。

en: That should be it then.
That should hold him when he comes to.
zh: 等他醒过来，这应该能困住他。

en: That should take care of the fire.
That should work much better.
That sign has been thoroughly damaged by the falling piece of concrete.
zh: 那块掉落的混凝土把那块牌子彻底砸坏了。

en: That sign's a bit high, and I didn't bring my climbing shoes.
zh: 那块牌子有点高，而我没带攀岩鞋。

en: That sink hasn't worked since I got this apartment.
zh: 自从我搬进这间公寓，那个水槽就没用过。

en: That slab of stone is still blocking this door.
zh: 那块石板还堵着这扇门。

en: That smoking corner is a violation of building regulations.
zh: 那个吸烟角违反了建筑规定。

en: That smoking corner is disgusting.
That sound...
That sounded like...
That stakeout is somehow connected to this Resonance stuff.
zh: 那次监视和这个共振的事有某种联系。

en: That stuff might be useful.
That tech room at police HQ sure has a lot of sweet toys.
zh: 警局总部那间技术室里的好东西可真不少。

en: That terminal at the hospital. Do you know anything about it?
zh: 医院里那个终端。你知道些什么吗？

en: That terminal at the lab. What does it do?
zh: 实验室那台终端。它是干什么的？

en: That they were after his work.
zh: 他们在追他的研究成果。

en: That thing isn't budging with just my bare hands.
zh: 光靠两只手根本拧不动那东西。

en: That thing looks heavy. Way too heavy.
zh: 那东西看起来很重。太重了。

en: That thing's not going to be any more use to us.
That used to be the table Dr. Morales worked at.
zh: 那以前是莫拉莱斯博士工作的桌子。

en: That vault file was stolen from Tortoise security!
zh: 那个保险库文件是从托托伊斯安保公司偷来的！

en: That wall was just wiped clean from existence.
zh: 那面墙就这么被从存在中抹掉了。

en: That was a little embarrassing...
That was just odd
That was me.
That was pretty impressive, cracking that safe.
zh: 打开那个保险箱，真厉害。

en: That was the cheapest alarm clock on the shelf at the store.
zh: 那是店里货架上最便宜的闹钟。

en: That was the cheapest hamper I could find at the Shop'N'Save.
zh: 那是我在Shop'N'Save能找到的最便宜的洗衣篮。

en: That was...
That went well
That went well...
That window got broken by the janitor when the lab blew up.
zh: 实验室爆炸时，看门人打碎了那扇窗户。

en: That won't help me open the drawer.
That won't work.
That worked.
That would be telling.
That would have made things a lot easier.
zh: 那本可以让事情容易得多。

en: That would imply he did any work in the first place.
zh: 那得假设他一开始有在工作。

en: That would only make the situation stickier.
That wouldn't match my decor; It's not really my era.
zh: 那和我的装修不搭；不太符合我的年代。

en: That wouldn't prove anything.
That'll allow us to walk over the crates while the magnets are off.
zh: 这样磁铁关闭时我们就能从那些箱子上走过去了。

en: That'll teach me to touch things at random.
zh: 这能让我记住别乱碰东西。

en: That's 365 of them.
That's Candace. She's worked here for years.
zh: 那是坎迪斯。她在这儿工作好多年了。

en: That's Ed's phone.  That was him!
zh: 那是埃德的手机。那就是他！

en: That's IT. I can't take it anymore.
That's Morales' Lab.
zh: 那是莫拉莱斯的实验室。

en: That's Morales' will all right.
zh: 这确实是莫拉莱斯的遗嘱。

en: That's Todd's locker.

zh: 那是GrandMaster牌的锁。市面上最结实的挂锁。

en: That's a big if. The guy's a nutjob.
zh: 这可是个大前提。那家伙是个疯子。

That's a fun story, but how do I know you're telling the truth?

That's a patient's room. I'd rather not disturb them.

That's a pretty heavy-duty padlock there.

zh: 比起上次，这价格涨得可真够狠的。

zh: 那是一种安全措施，防止未经授权进入保险库。

en: That's a security system for this station.
zh: 那是这个警局的安全系统。

en: That's all for now.
That's all hot off the grapevine and totally off the record though.
zh: 不过这些都只是小道消息，完全不能公开。

en: That's almost deep, if I could figure it out.
zh: 要是我能看懂的话，这几乎挺深刻的。

en: That's as far as I can force it.
zh: 我只能撬到这种程度了。

zh: 这是因为子处理器和深度内存缓冲区会缓存查询和数据。

en: That's because you don't understand what's at stake!
zh: 那是因为你不明白其中的利害关系！

en: That's close enough!
That's everything.
That's exactly what I was going for!
That's how I fix my TV, but I don't think it's going to work here.
zh: 我修电视就是这么干的，但我觉得这里行不通。

en: That's impossible. I always keep it in the closet.
zh: 不可能。我一直把它放在壁橱里。

en: That's it!
That's it! I know how to open the vent!
zh: 有了！我知道怎么打开通风口了！

en: That's it.
That's it. That's the message.
zh: 就是这个。就是这条信息。

en: That's it?
That's just a red canvas with a rip in it. I don't get it.
zh: 那就是一块撕破的红画布。我看不懂。

en: That's just a regular desktop computer. It's not important.
zh: 那只是台普通的台式电脑。不重要。

en: That's just not going to work there.
zh: 那样在那里根本行不通。

en: That's just the reception computer. Hey, why's it newer than mine?
zh: 那只是前台的电脑。嘿，怎么比我的还新？

en: That's locked.
That's my apartment.
That's my job!
That's my story, and I'm sticking to it.
zh: 这就是我的故事，我坚持这个说法。

en: That's my uncle's death certificate!
zh: 那是我叔叔的死亡证明！

en: That's new too.
That's nice.
That's nice. Did he leave you anything?
zh: 不错嘛。他给你留了什么吗？

en: That's no coincidence.
That's none of your business.
That's not a good application for a phone.
That's not a good way to use it.
That's not a phone number.
That's not acceptable!
That's not getting me anywhere.
That's not going to help bring the phone back to life.
zh: 那没法让电话重新活过来。

en: That's not going to open the door.
That's not going to prove I didn't kill the doctor and Anna.
zh: 那也证明不了我没杀医生和安娜。

en: That's not going to work.
That's not how to use a cell phone.
That's not how you use one of these.
That's not important right now.
That's not important.
That's not in the will.
That's not relevant to the case.
That's not something I should hit.
zh: 那可不是我该砸的东西。

en: That's not the computer we need to hack.
zh: 那不是我们要黑的电脑。

en: That's not the door I'm interested in.
That's not the note I was going to question him about.
zh: 那可不是我打算质问他的那张便条。

en: That's not the proof I need.
That's not the sort of thing we can trace.
zh: 那不是我们能追踪的东西。

en: That's not the way to actualize my intentions.
zh: 那不是实现我意图的办法。

en: That's not the way to the records.
That's not tied to Antevorta...
That's not what I asked.
That's not what I was thinking of.
That's not what I'm talking about.
That's one big chunk of rock.
That's one of the building system terminals.
zh: 那是楼宇系统终端之一。

en: That's our ace in the hole.
That's probably one of them.
That's probably where internal mail gets stored.
zh: 那大概是存放内部邮件的地方。

en: That's right, but DNA is just the tip of the iceberg.
That's right. And you said that's where the two of you met?
zh: 对。你说你们俩就是在那儿认识的？

en: That's so sad.
That's stuck to the wall.
That's sweet, but please don't. I'm fine.
zh: 你真贴心，但请别去。我没事。

en: That's the Antevorta mainframe.
That's the Assistant Chief's room.
That's the AutoPharm - the automated pharmacy.
That's the computer terminal for accessing the Antevorta mainframe.
zh: 那是用来访问Antevorta主机的电脑终端。

en: That's the computer we are looking for.
zh: 那就是我们要找的电脑。

en: That's the computer we need to hack.
zh: 那就是我们需要入侵的电脑。

en: That's the heart of the Antevorta Project.
That's the lab door.
That's the network configuration.
That's the observation room.
That's the only way we can find out where the vault is.
zh: 这是我们查明保险库位置的唯一办法。

en: That's the room where they keep the network servers and other computer equipment.
zh: 那是他们放网络服务器和其他电脑设备的房间。

en: That's the second biggest monkey wrench I've ever seen.
zh: 那是我见过的第二大的活动扳手。

en: That's the switch to activate the magnet in the ceiling.
zh: 那是启动天花板磁铁的开关。

en: That's the terminal for the mainframe.
That's the way to the treatment rooms. If it wasn't my day off, I'd be there.
zh: 那是通往治疗室的路。要不是今天我休息，我本该在那儿。

en: That's too high for me to reach.
That's very interesting.
That's way out of my reach.
That's what I said- "Hey Anna."
zh: 我就是这么说的——“嘿，安娜。”

en: That's what they want. That's why they wanted the Resonance devices.
zh: 这就是他们想要的。这就是他们想要共振装置的原因。

en: That's what you get when you travel coach.
zh: 坐经济舱就是这个待遇。

en: That's when I start to feel this little tingly feeling in my head.
zh: 就在那时，我开始觉得脑袋里有点刺刺的感觉。

en: That's where Bennet thinks the Eleven Foundation hide out.
zh: 贝内特认为十一基金会就藏在那里。

en: That's where messages for the doctors get stored.
zh: 那是存放给医生留言的地方。

en: That's where the cops sit to watch the suspect go crazy and crack under the strain.
zh: 警察就在那里坐着，看嫌疑人发疯、在压力下崩溃。

en: That's where we keep bugs, GPS trackers, spy cams, and other fun police tech.
zh: 那是我们放窃听器、GPS追踪器、间谍摄像头和其他有趣警用装备的地方。

en: That's where you enter the security code for the door that used to be blocking this hallway.
zh: 那里是输入安全码的地方，用来开那扇曾经堵住这条走廊的门。

en: That's why it's funny!
That's why we have to find it first.
zh: 所以我们才必须先找到它。

en: That's your stop coming up, isn't it?
That's-
That's... umm...
Thats's ... where Doctor Morales fell from when ...
zh: 那就是……莫拉莱斯博士摔下来的地方，从……

en: The "big deal" isn't knowing that these particles exist, it's in what you can do with them.
zh: “大不了”的不是知道这些粒子存在，而是你能用它们做什么。

en: The 'Most Wanted' police mugshots.
The 'hospital' sign above the hospital entrance.
zh: 医院入口上方的“医院”标志。

en: The Antevorta Project database.
The Antevorta Project is not a database for business and administrative data.
zh: Antevorta项目不是用来存业务和行政数据的数据库。

en: The Antevorta Project receptionist.
The AutoPharm automated prescription dispenser is the latest breakthrough in pharmacy equipment.
zh: AutoPharm自动处方发药机是药房设备的最新突破。

en: The Aventine City Police Department.
The Aventine City Post Office. Only slightly more reliable than my air conditioner.
zh: 阿文廷市邮局。只比我的空调稍微可靠一点。

en: The Cellfish shop looks like it closed down several months ago.
zh: Cellfish商店看起来几个月前就关门了。

en: The Chief is either dirty, or acting on bad intel.
zh: 局长要么是腐败了，要么就是收到了假情报。

en: The Collatz Problem, the Twin Prime conjecture. That sort of thing.
zh: 考拉兹猜想、孪生素数猜想。那一类的东西。

en: The Console
The DNA of every man, woman and child in America.
zh: 美国每个男人、女人和孩子的DNA。

en: The Eleven Foundation has lobbyists and senators in their pockets... They've even got their hooks in the Vice President!
zh: 十一基金会的说客和参议员都收在他们口袋里……他们甚至把手伸进了副总统那里！

en: The Eleven Foundation!
The Eleven Foundation.
The Eleven foundation
The Great and Powerful Oz!
The ICU desk computer.
zh: 重症监护室的台式电脑。

en: The Police Station rules.
The Rapture Service Plan comes at a low $29.99 per month.
zh: 被提服务计划每月仅需29.99美元。

en: The Resonance Device.
The Tech Room has a pretty comfy chair.
zh: 技术室里有一把相当舒服的椅子。

en: The Tin Man? Him and me go back... well, forever.
zh: 铁皮人？他和我认识……嗯，很久了。

en: The Tortoise security plaque.
The Ultrasonograph acts as a harmonic resonance amplifer, displaying molecularly dense items as an electrostatic overlay.
zh: 超声波仪充当谐波共振放大器，将分子密集的物品显示为静电叠加层。

en: The Vice President?
The admin cop rota for the archives duty.
zh: 档案室值班的行政警察轮班表。

en: The alarm's not set.
The alleyway door
The archive access panel.
The archive is that big thing on the wall over there.
zh: 档案就是那边墙上那个大东西。

en: The archive machine is pretty secure.
zh: 档案机的安全措施相当严密。

en: The archive puzzle
The archive puzzle (AKA suffer)
The archive...
The art at the hospital is pretty neat. Very... clinical, I guess.
zh: 医院里的艺术品挺不错。非常……临床感，我想。

en: The auto-pharm requires a valid hospital ID card to dispense.
zh: 自动药机需要有效的医院ID卡才能发药。

en: The bars are too solid to move by hand.
zh: 栅栏太结实了，用手搬不动。

en: The baseball field
The basement! Thanks!
The bear's key
The bed looks like it hasn't been slept in. If Ed was here, it wasn't to take a nap.
zh: 床看起来没人睡过。如果埃德来过，也不是来打盹的。

en: The beeping isn't coming from the computer.
zh: 哔哔声不是从电脑传来的。

en: The beginning?
The big machine in the middle of Morales' room was quite literally cut in half by...
zh: 莫拉莱斯房间正中央的那台大机器，确确实实被切成了两半，被……

en: The blueprint is for finding our way to into Morales' vault.
zh: 这张蓝图是用来找到通往莫拉莱斯保险库的路的。

en: The blueprints are archived at Aventine Police Headquarters, right? We probably should start there.
zh: 蓝图归档在阿文廷警察总部，对吧？我们大概该从那里开始。

en: The blueprints are in the city archives. I know that.
zh: 蓝图在市档案馆里。这我知道。

en: The blueprints are only half of the equation. We have a map, but not a destination.
zh: 蓝图只是等式的一半。我们有地图，但没有目的地。

en: The blueprints for Uncle Javi's lab.
zh: 哈维叔叔实验室的蓝图。

en: The blueprints to Juno labs. Looks like they're all here.
zh: 朱诺实验室的蓝图。看起来都在这儿了。

en: The body of the mechanism doesn't seem to do anything.
zh: 装置的主体似乎没什么作用。

en: The bookcase is heavy with them.
zh: 书柜里塞满了这些书，很重。

en: The box has four sides.
The box is already open.
The box is for authorized users only.
zh: 这台机器只限授权用户使用。

en: The box?  Aren't YOU the maintenance guy?
zh: 那个箱子？你不就是维修工吗？

en: The brick works best when used on other things.
zh: 砖头用在别的东西上效果最好。

en: The bright side of being a wanted ex-cop is that I don't need to do paperwork any more.
zh: 作为一个被通缉的前警察，好处就是不用再做文书工作了。

en: The building is still smoldering, but at least the main fire's out.
zh: 大楼还在冒烟，但至少大火已经灭了。

en: The bulletin board behind the desk at the Police Station.
zh: 警察局柜台后面的公告板。

en: The cabinets in the lab's entryway used to contain interesting mementos of its successes.
zh: 实验室入口处的柜子里，曾经陈列着它辉煌成就的有趣纪念品。

The cage door is in the way.
The call log's empty.
The case is sealed.
The cellphone is marked 14A.
The cellphone is marked 14B.
The cemetery, your childhood, the last time you spoke to Dr. Morales.
zh: 墓地，你的童年，你最后一次和莫拉莱斯博士说话的时候。

en: The chair got caught in a cable hanging from the ceiling.
zh: 椅子被从天花板垂下来的电缆缠住了。

en: The chief gets a phone call and suddenly she's putting a bounty on your head.
zh: 局长接了个电话，突然就悬赏要你的人头。

en: The chief is keeping you at the top of everybody's list.
zh: 局长把你列为头号目标。

en: The chief's been acting kinda strange recently.
zh: 局长最近表现得有点奇怪。

en: The chief.
The choice is mine.
The choice is yours... to save Resonance, or to destroy it.
zh: 选择权在你……拯救共振，还是摧毁它。

en: The coffee mug says "Kiss me, I'm a physicist."
zh: 咖啡杯上写着“亲我，我是物理学家。”

en: The collwhooz theory?
The computer in the inner part of Morales' vault.
zh: 莫拉莱斯保险库内层的电脑。

en: The computer is busy crunching numbers. I shouldn't interrupt it.
zh: 电脑正忙着算数。我不该打断它。

en: The computer is even programmed to decide who should have access to what documents.
zh: 这台电脑甚至被编程来决定谁应该有权访问哪些文件。

en: The computer traced it to a plumbing supplies warehouse near Juno labs.
zh: 电脑追踪到朱诺实验室附近的一家水管供应仓库。

en: The control panel for the police document retrieval system.
zh: 警方文件检索系统的控制面板。

en: The control panel has no power.
The controls for the bars seem to be locked out.
zh: 栅栏的控制似乎被锁住了。

en: The controls to the inner vault door.
zh: 内层保险库门的控制装置。

en: The copier. My eternal enemy.
The county records archive is just down the hallway.
zh: 县记录档案馆就在走廊那头。

en: The crane for the roof repairs.
The curtain is already open.
The curtain is an... interesting choice of decor.
zh: 这窗帘……装饰品味挺有意思。

en: The curtains are a nice touch.
The cypher
The cypher!
The day I trust a muckraker like you-
zh: 等我哪天信任你这种揭丑记者——

en: The day the microwave was invented was the day gastronomy died.
zh: 微波炉发明的那天，就是美食学灭亡的那天。

en: The day we face today is a more challenging one than yesterday, but we'll meet this challenge as one nation - as one world.
zh: 我们今天面对的日子比昨天更具挑战性，但我们将作为一个国家——作为一个世界——迎接这一挑战。

en: The depiction of a father and child on a hilltop staring at the clouds gives us a further look at the troubled heart and family of this poor artistic soul.
zh: 这幅描绘父亲与孩子在山顶凝望云朵的画作，让我们进一步窥见这位可怜艺术灵魂饱受困扰的内心与家庭。

en: The desk in the corner managed to avoid the explosion.
zh: 角落里的桌子躲过了爆炸。

en: The desk nurse at the hospital.
The desk nurse.
The desk seems relatively untouched by the devastation.
zh: 这张桌子似乎没怎么被破坏波及。

en: The desk sergeant is distracted, but he'll still see me if I walk down these stairs.
zh: 值班警佐分神了，但我要是走下这些楼梯，他还是会看见我。

en: The desk sergeant is rambling on, but he'll see me if I walk down these stairs.
zh: 值班警佐在絮絮叨叨，但我要是走下这些楼梯，他会看见我。

en: The details of my dream are sketchy in my memory.
zh: 我梦里的细节在记忆中很模糊。

en: The detective dropped a note last night. In the park.
zh: 警探昨晚丢了一张纸条。在公园里。

en: The detritus of modern life.
The device is labeled 14B.
The devices would be pretty small.  Softball size, maybe.
zh: 装置会相当小。大概垒球那么大。

en: The doctors let me play with the X-ray machines.
The door ain't going to open with that rock in the way.
zh: 有那块石头挡着，门是开不了的。

en: The door at Tortoise Security.
The door back to the corridor.
The door from the basement to the ambulance bay.
zh: 从地下室通往救护车停放区的门。

en: The door is already open.
The door is already unlocked.
The door is clear now.
The door is locked.
The door is marked "Assistant Chief."
The door is marked "Tech Room."
The door to Dr. Morales' lab is just beyond the lab's entrance.
zh: 莫拉莱斯博士的实验室门就在实验室入口过去一点。

en: The door to my apartment. Modified for extra safety.
zh: 我公寓的门。为了额外安全做过改装。

en: The door to my bedroom doesn't have any locks.
zh: 我卧室的门没有任何锁。

en: The door to the basement. Or as we call it, the "smooching room."
zh: 通往地下室的门。或者按我们的叫法，“亲热室”。

en: The door to the copy room.
The door to the office of the Chief of Police.
zh: 通往警察局长办公室的门。

en: The door to the photocopier room next to Johnsen's desk.
zh: 约翰森桌旁通往复印室的门。

en: The door to the police server room.
zh: 通往警方服务器室的门。

en: The door to the security room.
The door's already unlocked.
The door's locked. I don't think it's important, anyway.
zh: 门锁着。反正我觉得不重要。

en: The door's open.
The doors down here lead to maintenance. I don't have the keys.
zh: 这下面的门通向维护区。我没有钥匙。

en: The doors to the simulator were designed to keep people out.
zh: 模拟器的门本来是用来把人挡在外面的。

en: The doors will now close.
The drawer is empty.
The drawer's locked.
The drawers are all locked.
The driver's side mirror seems to be the only thing about that car that isn't broken.
zh: 驾驶座侧的后视镜似乎是那辆车上唯一没坏的东西。

en: The duct tape doesn't work very well by itself.
The egress from this pestilent hovel.
zh: 从这个瘟疫般的破屋出去的路。

en: The egress to more hospitable environs.
zh: 通往更舒适环境的出口。

en: The electrical system in here is all screwed up.
zh: 这里的电力系统全乱套了。

en: The elevator door.
The elevator up.
The elevator's a quicker route
The elevator. Fortunately today is a working-elevator day, not a stairs day.
zh: 电梯。幸好今天是电梯能用日，不是爬楼梯日。

en: The engine's on.
The engine's running.
The entrance to Aventine General Hospital.
zh: 阿文廷综合医院的入口。

en: The entrance to a construction elevator.
The entrance to the hospital where I work.
The event has cut through the cockpit and all the machinery housed beneath it.
zh: 事件切穿了驾驶舱和它下面容纳的所有机械。

en: The event must have cracked a water pipe.
zh: 那事件肯定震裂了水管。

zh: 这次事件从现实中抹去了一个球形空间。

zh: 从重症监护室通往医院该楼层其他病房的出口。

en: The exit from the supercollider.
The exit to the rest of the hospital.
zh: 通往医院其他区域的出口。

en: The exit to the sweet embrace of elevator solitude.
zh: 走出这里，就能躲进电梯，享受片刻清静。

The explosion at the lab.
The feeling's mutual, believe me.
The fence is high but scalable. This alley is a good place to duck into if you wanted to avoid pursuit.
zh: 栅栏很高，但能爬过去。这条小巷是个躲藏的好地方，如果你想避开追踪的话。

zh: 保险库的文件被偷了？这故事越来越精彩了。
