zh: 偷偷摸摸的第一条规则就是别跟分心的警察说“嗨”。

en: The foundation of that shop is in bad condition. There are crumbling bricks everywhere.
zh: 那家店的地基状况很差。到处都是碎裂的砖块。

en: The fourth floor of our building has been under renovation for some time.
zh: 我们这栋楼的四楼已经翻修了一段时间了。

en: The fridge cools my microwave dinners and works as a lamp in a pinch.
zh: 冰箱给我的微波晚餐降温，必要时还能当灯用。

en: The front entrance to the supposed "Post Office."
The front entrance. Never a good idea without a SWAT team right behind you.
zh: 前门。身后没有特警队的话，走前门从来都不是好主意。

en: The further you pull the particles apart before disabling the devices, the larger the area-of-effect.
zh: 在关闭装置前把粒子拉得越开，作用范围就越大。

en: The further you pull the particles apart, the bigger the area-of-effect when they snap back together.
zh: 你把粒子拉得越开，它们弹回相撞时的作用范围就越大。

en: The giant squid to my sperm whale!
zh: 就像我的抹香鲸遇上巨型乌贼！

en: The glass on the door's window is shattered.
The gleam of neon sheds its light upon our problems.
zh: 霓虹的微光照亮了我们的难题。

en: The green one.
The greenery, combined with the striking colors of the art on the wall, provides a welcome reprieve from the sterility of the hospital.
zh: 这些绿植，配上墙上画作醒目的色彩，让人从医院的冰冷单调中得到一丝难得的舒缓。

en: The gut-rot that that guy was drinking really put him out.
zh: 那家伙喝的劣质酒可真把他放倒了。

en: The guy has no kitchen. I don't think he has dinner, period.
zh: 这家伙没有厨房。我觉得他根本不吃晚饭。

en: The guy in the security cam picture?
The guy who chased you. He didn't hurt you did he? You don't need to get checked out?
zh: 追你的那个人。他没伤到你吧？你不需要去检查一下吗？

en: The guy's a nerdy weakling, but a good asset in a crisis.
zh: 这家伙是个书呆子软蛋，但危急时刻还挺管用。

en: The guys don't like anyone touching their stuff.
zh: 伙计们不喜欢别人碰他们的东西。

en: The hall is on fire and there's a dangerous electric cable.
zh: 走廊着火了，还有一根危险的电缆。

en: The handle came off.
The hard part is always getting the owner out of the way first.
zh: 最难的部分永远都是先把主人支开。

en: The harridan of the Antevorta Project server room.
zh: Antevorta项目服务器机房的泼妇。

en: The hospital computers all come standard with a USB port.
zh: 医院电脑都标配一个USB端口。

en: The hospital elevator has a card reader on the control panel, to allow authorised people access to restricted floors.
zh: 医院电梯的控制面板上有一个读卡器，允许授权人员进入限制楼层。

en: The hospital elevator.
The hospital sign.
The hospital. A place of healing and balm.
zh: 医院。一个治疗和抚慰的地方。

en: The hospital. Home Sweet Home.
The internal power generator and battery give off a lot of heat!
zh: 内置发电机和电池会散发大量热量！

en: The interrogation room at the Police Station.
The interrogation room.
The janitor at the labs.
The janitor is just sitting on the grass, rubbing his ankle, and humming the theme from Rocky.
zh: 清洁工就坐在草地上，揉着脚踝，哼着《洛奇》的主题曲。

en: The janitor.
The journalist?
The key card does not fit in that.
The key goes in the forklift.
The key to that forklift must be around here somewhere. One of those lockers, maybe?
zh: 那辆叉车的钥匙肯定就在附近。也许在某个储物柜里？

en: The key to the forklift.
The keyboard attached to the Antevorta mainframe.
The keycard is for accessing the city archives.
zh: 这张门禁卡是用来进入城市档案馆的。

en: The keycard will allow you access to the city archives.
zh: 这张钥匙卡可以让你进入城市档案馆。

en: The keypad controlled the simulator's doors.
zh: 这个键盘控制着模拟器的门。

en: The keypad is connected by a large number of wires.
The keypad opens the simulator doors, but they are already open.
zh: 键盘能打开模拟舱的门，但门已经开了。

en: The keypad that opened the box thing that Morales was in when the resonance device hit.
zh: 共振装置击中时，莫拉莱斯待的那个箱子就是被这个键盘打开的。

en: The keypad would be helpful if I knew the combination.
zh: 要是我知道密码，这个键盘就能派上用场了。

en: The kind of access I had deserved, EARNED...
zh: 那种我本该拥有、我挣来的权限……

en: The kitchen?
The knees are almost worn out from all the work I was doing on the floor.
zh: 因为我一直在地板上干活，膝盖都快磨破了。

en: The lab is gone. Dr. Morales is dead. Non-disclosure agreements just don't seem to matter anymore.
zh: 实验室没了。莫拉莱斯博士死了。保密协议似乎已经不重要了。

en: The lab terminal
The lab's broken window will be one of the cheapest things to repair after this whole ordeal.
zh: 等这场劫难过去，实验室破掉的窗户会是修起来最便宜的东西之一。

en: The lab's right there!
The lab's ventilation system is a small air duct with just enough room for someone to fit inside.
zh: 实验室的通风系统是一条小风管，刚好够一个人钻进去。

en: The ladder is extended all the way to the roof now.
zh: 梯子现在已经完全伸到屋顶了。

en: The ladder leading to the ground is broken?!
The ladder leads up to a less-convenient entrance through the window.
zh: 梯子通向窗户，那是个不太方便的入口。

en: The largest in the world.
The last will and Testament of Doctor Javier Morales.
zh: 哈维尔·莫拉莱斯博士的遗嘱。

en: The level of destruction in this place... it's incredible.
zh: 这地方的破坏程度……真是难以置信。

en: The light switch is pretty useless without a functioning bulb.
zh: 没有能用的灯泡，电灯开关基本没用。

en: The lights are fine as they are.
The lights don't seem to do anything by themselves.
zh: 这些灯自己好像没什么用。

en: The limbs were removed with precise cuts.
zh: 四肢是被精准切割下来的。

en: The lock display cases from Tortoise Security.
zh: 托托伊斯安保公司陈列锁具的展示柜。

en: The lock looks pretty old. We should be able to break it and climb down.
zh: 锁看起来相当旧了。我们应该能砸开它爬下去。

en: The long arm of the law.
The magnet looks like it's held on by a couple screws.
zh: 磁铁看起来是用几颗螺丝固定的。

en: The mainframe computer holds the data of the Antevorta Project.
zh: 主机电脑存有Antevorta项目的数据。

en: The mainframe is off-limits.
The mainframe where the DNA of every man, woman and child in America is stored.
zh: 那台主机里存着美国每一个男人、女人和孩子的DNA。

en: The maintenance closet was locked incoveniently tight.
zh: 维修间锁得死紧，真碍事。

en: The major fire seems to be out, but there may be some smaller fires still burning.
zh: 大火似乎已经灭了，但可能还有些小火在烧。

en: The man you called your father, he knew... he always knew.
zh: 你称作父亲的那个男人，他知道……他一直都知道。

en: The measurements alone must have taken forever to calculate.
zh: 光是那些测量数据就得算上好久。

en: The mechanism is attached to a broken ladder.
zh: 装置连着一架断掉的梯子。

en: The mechanism is attached to a rope which is attached to a ladder.
zh: 装置连着一根绳子，绳子连着梯子。

en: The metal panel is screwed on tight.
The mold made my allergies play up.
zh: 霉菌让我的过敏发作了。

en: The monitor has a USB port built in.
zh: 显示器内置了一个USB接口。

en: The mope I followed was holed up in that alleyway. Let's go.
zh: 我跟踪的那个闷葫芦就躲在那条巷子里。走吧。

en: The new Crystal Fire architecture of its primary chip can balance the traffic between the trunks.
zh: 其主芯片采用的全新Crystal Fire架构可以平衡两条干线之间的流量。

en: The new world order
The note says "Todd, did you leave the forklift key in your locker again?"
zh: 便条上写着“托德，你是不是又把叉车钥匙落在储物柜里了？”

en: The note we saw...
The notice board above Officer Johnsen's desk.
zh: 约翰森警官桌上方的告示板。

en: The number for the phone that signalled device 14A.
zh: 给设备14A发信号的电话号码。

en: The office chair - throne of creativity for the modern worker.
zh: 办公椅——现代打工人的创意王座。

en: The officer on duty.
The on/off switch for an electromagnet.
The one in the hospital may just be the tip of the proverbial iceberg.
zh: 医院里那间可能只是冰山一角。

en: The one of us who isn't a wanted man.
zh: 我们当中那个不是通缉犯的人。

en: The ones you're looking for are the only ones he took!
zh: 你要找的那些是他唯一拿走的！

en: The only award I need is a Pulitzer.
zh: 我唯一需要的奖是普利策奖。

en: The only important thing is Dr. Morales.
zh: 唯一重要的是莫拉莱斯博士。

en: The only time for worrying is when you have no more options.
zh: 只有当你再无选择时才该担心。

en: The other night. I saw you enter this alley after leaving the post office.
zh: 那天晚上。我看见你离开邮局后走进了这条小巷。

en: The panel for opening the door.
The panel is hooked into the primary law-enforcement system.
zh: 这个面板接入了主要的执法系统。

en: The panel needs some kind of code. Uncle Javi might have written it down somewhere.
zh: 面板需要某种密码。哈维叔叔可能把它写在了什么地方。

en: The panel on the door says "Assistant Chief."
zh: 门上的牌子写着“助理局长”。

en: The paper doesn't actually do anything.
The paper itself doesn't help much, but the contents of it might.
zh: 纸本身帮不上什么忙，但上面的内容也许可以。

en: The particle always comes in pairs.  A positive and a negative.  Yin and yang.
zh: 这种粒子总是成对出现。一正一负。阴和阳。

en: The particles instantly snap back together, collide in the exact center, and release a large amount of energy.
zh: 粒子会瞬间弹回彼此身边，在正中央相撞，并释放出巨大的能量。

en: The particles instantly snap back together...
The particles must have been placed four kilometers from the lab on either side.
zh: 粒子一定被安放在实验室两侧四公里处。

en: The personal touch is vital in a human interest story like this.
zh: 在这种人情味的故事里，个人视角至关重要。

en: The phone is dead.
The phone number for Resonance Device 14A.
The phone number for Resonance Device 14B.
The pipe is broken here.
The pipe might be able to stick to something now.
zh: 管子现在也许能粘住什么东西了。

en: The pipe, miraculously, fits pretty well up there.
zh: 这根管子奇迹般地挺合适地装在上面。

en: The police?
The post office is a known front for dropping off contraband goods!
zh: 那家邮局是众所周知的走私货物投放点！

en: The potential for good far outweighs the possibility of misuse!
zh: 为善的潜力远远超过被滥用的可能！

en: The pounding stopped.
The power reset itself. It must be some safety mechanism.
zh: 电力自己复位了。这一定是某种安全机制。

en: The power switch for the electromagnets.
The power switch for the extendable walkway.
The power's all messed up.
The power's on.
The priorities are chosen through a complex neural network balancing system.
zh: 优先级是通过一套复杂的神经网络平衡系统来选定的。

en: The pulitzer is in the bag
zh: 普利策奖已是囊中之物

en: The puzzle box!
The receptionist at Antevorta.
The recession seems to grow narrow very quickly.
zh: 凹槽似乎很快就变窄了。

en: The results were right in line with his theories.
zh: 结果与他的理论完全吻合。

en: The rows of cubicles fill the floor of the building,
zh: 一排排格子间铺满了这栋楼的楼层，

en: The same year that's inscribed on the cover.
zh: 和封面上刻的年份一样。

en: The save directory is full. You must replace an existing game:
zh: 存档目录已满。你必须替换一个现有游戏：

en: The schedule for the archive officer duty.
The secretary's drawers.
The security cam pic is evidence, not something I can use right now.
zh: 监控摄像头照片是证据，不是我现在能用的东西。

en: The security door in the lab's hallway slammed shut after its control was shorted out.
zh: 实验室走廊的安全门在控制器短路后砰地关上了。

en: The security doors on the big machine were pretty well reinforced.
zh: 那台大机器上的安全门加固得相当结实。

en: The security room is located just off the lab's main hallway.
zh: 安保室就在实验室主走廊旁边。

en: The server room is located just off the lab's main hallway.
zh: 服务器机房就在实验室主走廊旁边。

en: The servers are all powering up and down at random.
zh: 服务器全都在随机地通电和断电。

en: The servers in Dr. Morales' journal stored terabytes of encoded experimental and simulated data.
zh: 莫拉莱斯博士日记里的服务器存储了数TB的编码实验和模拟数据。

en: The shelf is already blocking the door.
The shop near the post office is in really bad condition.
zh: 邮局附近的商店状况非常糟糕。

en: The short-term memory
The sight made me realize just how long I had been out here.
zh: 这景象让我意识到自己已经在这里待了多久。

en: The sign describes the various models of security systems on sale here.
zh: 标牌介绍了这里出售的各种型号的安防系统。

en: The sign in front of the Juno laboratory used to be an exciting sight for me.
zh: 朱诺实验室前的招牌，曾经让我一见就兴奋。

en: The sign over the Juno laboratory front doors was destroyed.
zh: 朱诺实验室前门上方的招牌被毁了。

en: The sign over the lab's door got seriously busted.
zh: 实验室门上的牌子被砸得稀烂。

en: The signal's too weak.  Could be the location he's in, or some kind of interference.
zh: 信号太弱了。可能是他所在的位置，或者某种干扰。

en: The sound doesn't seem to be coming from outside the door.
zh: 声音似乎不是从门外传来的。

en: The sound doesn't seem to be coming from the bathroom.
zh: 声音似乎不是从浴室传来的。

en: The sound is coming from upstairs.
The sound is definitely louder near my hamper.
zh: 在我洗衣篮附近声音肯定更响。

en: The sound is louder over here.
The sound isn't coming from my alarm clock.
zh: 声音不是从我闹钟传来的。

en: The sprinkler system is not working.
The sprinkler system needs serious maintenance.
zh: 喷淋系统需要好好维护一下了。

en: The sprinkler system valve in the lab doesn't have a handle...
zh: 实验室里喷淋系统的阀门没有手柄……

en: The stairs... something about the stairs...
The structure of the lab suffered a lot of damage in the event.
zh: 实验室的结构在那次事件中损毁严重。

en: The structure seems to have become unstable here.
zh: 这里的结构似乎变得不稳定了。

en: The style is very "student digs" with a touch of  "crackhouse."
zh: 这风格非常“学生宿舍”，还带点“毒窝”的味道。

en: The subway is supposed to be a no smoking area.
The subway map...
The sun is just coming up over Aventine City.
zh: 太阳刚从阿文廷市升起。

en: The sun is just peeking through the buildings.
zh: 太阳正从楼宇间探出头来。

en: The sun is pale and cold this afternoon.
zh: 今天下午的太阳苍白而冰冷。

en: The sun's beams glide between the buildings like a man's strong fingers through a dame's hair.
zh: 阳光的光束在楼宇间滑过，像男人有力的手指穿过女人的头发。

en: The sun.
The super collider passes underground.
zh: 超级对撞机从地下穿过。

en: The switch is labelled "magnet fuse control."
zh: 开关上标着“磁铁保险丝控制”。

en: The switch is out in the hall,
The switch reset itself. It must be some safety mechanism.
zh: 开关自己复位了。这一定是某种安全机制。

en: The switches at the far end don't turn on the magnets.
zh: 远端的开关打不开磁铁。

en: The system here is pretty straight-forward.
The tape must be something to do with the way the resonance device was set up.
zh: 这胶带肯定和共振装置的架设方式有关。

en: The tape wouldn't mean much out of context.
zh: 脱离上下文，这胶带说明不了什么。

en: The target may have come from the other side of this fence. I need to find a way to watch this alley when he leaves to find out for sure.
zh: 目标可能是从围栏另一边过来的。我得想办法在他离开时盯住这条巷子，才能确定。

en: The tech room is down the upstairs hallway.
zh: 技术室在楼上的走廊尽头。

en: The tech room is to the right of the copy room, but it's always locked.
zh: 技术室在复印室右边，但一直锁着。

en: The tech room used to be in the basement, until they moved it upstairs.
zh: 技术室以前在地下室，后来他们搬到了楼上。

en: The terminal provides access to the mainframe located in the Antevorta office.
zh: 通过这个终端，可以访问 Antevorta 办公室里的主机。

en: The tools of the janitorial trade.
The top seems to have an optimal power level of nineteen, which it's always at as long as the power's on.
zh: 顶部的最佳电平似乎是十九，只要通电就一直保持这个数值。

en: The tracing equipment's at Admin HQ.
The tracking system is pretty simple. Even tech-dopes like me can use it.
zh: 追踪系统挺简单的。连我这种技术白痴都会用。

en: The traditional office plant.
The trashcan is working pretty well. Why don't you get back to fixing the system?
zh: 垃圾桶运行得挺好的。你干吗不回去修系统？

en: The tripod is lined up with these pieces of masking tape on the floor.
zh: 三脚架和地板上的这些美纹纸胶带对齐了。

en: The trouble is, no one knows your FTTN except certain agencies with access.
zh: 麻烦的是，除了某些有权限的机构，没人知道你的FTTN。

en: The universe is controlled by laws.
The usual procedure for releasing a death certificate is to speak to the medical examiner.
zh: 领取死亡证明的常规程序是去找法医。

en: The vault is right there on the other side of that window.
zh: 保险库就在那扇窗户的另一边。

en: The vault is through the far door.
zh: 保险库就在最远的那扇门后面。

en: The vault must be right there on B8.
The vault room should be a hundred meters down this hallway.
zh: 保险库房间应该在这条走廊往前一百米处。

en: The vault's automated retrieval arm will select the correct file box the document is located in, retrieve the proper document from inside, and create a copy.
zh: 保险库的自动取件臂会选出文件所在的那个文件箱，从里面取出正确的文件，并制作一份副本。

en: The vault.
The ventilation duct runs up the wall and across the ceiling.
zh: 通风管道沿着墙壁向上，再横穿天花板。

en: The ventilation shaft is no place for me to boldly go.
zh: 通风管道可不是我该勇敢闯进去的地方。

en: The view from my window is mostly the brick wall of the next building.
zh: 我窗外的景色大多是隔壁楼的砖墙。

en: The water has electricity running through it.
The water in the lab is electrically charged and dangerous.
zh: 实验室里的水带电，很危险。

en: The water in the pipes near the event's epicenter must have vibrated so much they broke.
zh: 事件震中附近管道里的水一定震动得太厉害，把管子都震裂了。

en: The water is no longer electrified now that the power running through the cable has been disabled.
zh: 电缆断电后，水不再带电了。

en: The water is trickling out of the side of the building.
The water isn't coming down. We did it!
zh: 水不再往下流了。我们成功了！

en: The water's stopped. No need to make Ed jam his skinny ass up there again.
zh: 水已经停了。没必要再让埃德把他那瘦屁股塞上去了。

en: The watercooler.
The way out of the closet, heh.
The way out.
The way outta here.
The way that hole was cut out of the lab, it had to be a Resonance weapon.
zh: 从实验室被切出那个洞的方式来看，只能是共振武器。

en: The way that hole was cut out of the lab, it had to be caused by the new technology Dr. Morales was working on.
zh: 从实验室被切出那个洞的方式来看，只能是莫拉莱斯博士正在研究的新技术造成的。

en: The way to the rest of the hospital.
zh: 通往医院其他区域的路。

en: The whole building can be run through those terminals!
zh: 整栋楼都可以通过那些终端来运行！

en: The whole city's overrun with emergencies right now on account of the blackout.
zh: 因为停电，现在全城都是紧急情况。

en: The window is all boarded up!
The window is completely barred up.
zh: 窗户被铁栏杆完全封住了。

en: The window looking from the outer vault to the inner vault.
zh: 从外层保险库望向内层保险库的窗户。

en: The window will be one of the smallest worries of the Juno Laboratory's financial officers.
zh: 窗户会是朱诺实验室财务人员最不操心的问题之一。

en: The window!
The windows are securely fastened.
The windows don't open.
The wizard has spoken!
The wood seems pretty weathered. I'm not sure how long that bench would support my weight.
zh: 木头看起来风化得相当厉害。我不确定那张长椅能承受我的体重多久。

en: The work of a journeyman struggling to become a master.

en: These fuses look like custom made jobs. They aren't something you'd buy in a hardware store.
zh: 这些保险丝看起来是定制的。五金店可买不到。

en: These fuses seem to work with that panel.
zh: 这些保险丝似乎和那块面板配套。

en: These hips, they just don't shake themselves the way they used to.
zh: 这屁股，再也不像以前那样自己扭得起来了。

en: These must be Ed's calculations. I think he's figuring out exactly where to place the device.
zh: 这些一定是埃德的计算。我想他正在算出装置该放在哪里。

en: These people have no standards!
These pills Ozzy takes. They're prescription, right? You've got access to 'em?
zh: 奥兹吃的这些药。是处方药，对吧？你能拿到吗？

en: These pins draw power from the grid.
zh: 这些引脚从电网获取电力。

en: These safe designs could almost be abstract art.
zh: 这些保险柜设计几乎可以算是抽象艺术。

en: These screws are meant to hold the keypad to the circuit board.
zh: 这些螺丝是用来把键盘固定在电路板上的。

en: These two particles actually occupy the same space by vibrating through space-time.
zh: 这两个粒子通过穿越时空的振动，实际上占据了同一空间。

en: These windows don't open.
They USED me!
They are not MY criminal organization!
zh: 他们不是我的犯罪组织！

en: They are unlit.
They are up the stairs and to the left.
They are.
They don't do much by themselves though.
zh: 不过它们本身没什么用。

en: They had sprinkled breadcrumbs in the forest behind them as they walked.
zh: 他们走路时在身后的森林里撒了面包屑。

en: They have my entire DNA code in here?
zh: 他们这里有我完整的DNA编码？

en: They installed those things last year.
zh: 他们去年装的那些东西。

en: They know I can stop them, so they convince you to get in my way.
zh: 他们知道我能阻止他们，所以他们说动你来挡我的路。

en: They make me do paperwork whenever I show up.
zh: 我一露面，他们就让我做文书工作。

en: They make you think they want the same thing you do, and "nudge" you in the right direction!
zh: 他们让你以为他们和你目标一致，然后把你"推"向正确的方向！

en: They might be useful.
They must buy it in bulk.
They must have been using the crates to salvage pieces of this collider for the newer one.
zh: 他们一定是在用这些板条箱拆下这台对撞机的部件，用来造新的那台。

en: They must have changed the secret knock, but that makes no sense.
zh: 他们肯定换了暗号，但这说不通。

en: They must really want to catch us.
zh: 他们肯定很想抓到我们。

en: They must've shaken loose when the event happened that caused all this structural damage.
zh: 造成这些结构损坏的事件发生时，它们肯定被震松了。

en: They ordered the works!
They pay the bills.
They played all of us, alright!
zh: 他们把我们所有人都耍了，没错！

en: They said you killed the science guy's niece to keep her quiet about you blowing up the lab.
zh: 他们说，你杀了那个科学家的侄女，就因为她知道是你炸了实验室，你要让她闭嘴。

en: They said you're planning another attack.
zh: 他们说你正计划再发动一次袭击。

en: They seem to just be indicators.
They told me they would use it to help people! But they lied to me!
zh: 他们告诉我他们会用它来帮助人们！但他们骗了我！

en: They used Resonance to make this happen. Now I'm going to use it to stop them.
zh: 他们用共振做到了这一切。现在我要用它来阻止他们。

en: They used me to get this far. But they aren't getting any further.
zh: 他们利用我走到了这一步。但他们别想再往前走了。

en: They want to use it as a tool... A tool for their own selfish purposes!
zh: 他们想把它当作工具……用来满足他们自私目的的工具！

en: They want us to look for you.
They went through all my files.
zh: 他们翻遍了我所有的文件。

en: They were just using me!
They won't be looking for it.
They'll lose.
They're all still here, in those boxes.
zh: 它们都还在那儿，就在那些箱子里。

en: They're being watched.
They're calling in everybody they've got.
zh: 他们正在召集所有人手。

en: They're deployed all over the city right now.
zh: 他们现在全城都派出去了。

en: They're fire-proof, water-proof, and rapture ready!
They're my treasure 'cause they're from him.
zh: 它们是我的宝贝，因为是他给的。

en: They're opened only a few inches. It's not nearly enough to fit through yet.
zh: 它们只开了几英寸。还远远不够钻过去。

en: They're supposed to be a medical research group, but they've never asked me any questions.
zh: 他们名义上是医学研究机构，可从来没问过我任何问题。

en: They're supposed to keep people from climbing up and breaking into our apartments.
zh: 它们本该防止人们爬上来闯入我们的公寓。

en: They're the ones who asked me to come here in the first place.
zh: 一开始就是他们叫我来的。

en: They're trying to use you like they used me!
zh: 他们想利用你，就像利用我一样！

en: Think you can get that locker open?
zh: 你觉得你能打开那个储物柜吗？

en: Think. Where might we find a rope or something?
zh: 想想。哪里能找到绳子之类的东西？

en: Thinsagu Nu Hana
Third Drawer
This Dr. Morales... is he a coworker of yours?
zh: 这位莫拉莱斯博士……是你的同事吗？

en: This allows us to break into the master data retrieval system at the police station.
zh: 这能让我们闯入警局的主数据检索系统。

en: This ancient sink does not seem to be the source of the noise that woke me up.
zh: 这个老掉牙的水槽似乎不是我醒来时听到的噪音来源。

en: This angel on the cover... it must have something to do with me.
zh: 封面上的这个天使……一定跟我有关。

en: This apartment looks purely functional. Not a place to live at all.
zh: 这间公寓看起来纯粹是实用性的。根本不像住人的地方。

en: This bar might help with leverage on something weak like those subway doors...
zh: 这根铁棍也许能撬动像地铁门那种脆弱的东西……

en: This book was stuck under some debris in Dr. Morales' lab.
zh: 这本书是在莫拉莱斯博士实验室的废墟下压着的。

en: This book... it's all in some kind of code.
This branch is supposed to be a drop point for a criminal organization.
zh: 这家分店应该是某个犯罪组织的交接点。

en: This cabinet came with the apartment.
zh: 这个柜子是公寓自带的。

en: This card unlocks all the treasure trove of the police records to little old me.
zh: 这张卡为我这个小人物解锁了警方记录的全部宝库。

en: This cheek swab contains a sample of Anna's DNA.
zh: 这个口腔拭子含有安娜的DNA样本。

en: This cheek swab contains a sample of Detective Bennet's DNA.
zh: 这个口腔拭子含有贝内特警探的DNA样本。

en: This cheek swab contains a sample of Ed's DNA.
zh: 这个口腔拭子含有埃德的DNA样本。

en: This cheek swab contains a sample of my DNA.
zh: 这个口腔拭子含有我的DNA样本。

en: This contact of yours. Is he on the level?
This desk is a mess.
This device acts like a sonic x-ray.
zh: 这个设备就像声波X光机。

en: This doesn't change anything.
This doesn't help me.
This doesn't make any kind of sense to me.
zh: 这对我来说完全说不通。

en: This doesn't make any sense.
This doesn't seem like somewhere that an empty pop can is going to do much good.
zh: 这地方似乎不是空易拉罐能派上用场的地方。

en: This doohickey is some sort of measuring device.
zh: 这个小玩意儿是某种测量装置。

en: This door doesn't have a lock!
This door is locked, and I don't think anyone has been in that shop for a while.
zh: 这扇门锁着，我看那家店已经有一阵子没人进去了。

en: This drawer is full of cotton swabs.
This drawer is full of medical swabs.
zh: 这个抽屉里全是医用棉签。

en: This drawer is labeled 'AA001 - FR345'
This drawer is labeled 'FR346 - ME901'
This drawer is labeled 'ME902 - TB229'
This drawer is labeled 'TB230 - ZZ999'
This flimsy little thing is not going to do anything to that hunk of concrete.
zh: 这根脆弱的小东西对那块混凝土根本没用。

en: This fucking city...
This fuse won't fit here.
zh: 这个保险丝装不到这里。

en: This fuse won't fit.
This gets us into the police data retrieval system without a warrant.
zh: 这能让我们无需搜查令就进入警方数据检索系统。

en: This guy has a very strange taste in cubicle design.
zh: 这家伙对格子间设计的品味真奇怪。

en: This guy has been feeding me scoops like that one on the Vice President.
zh: 这家伙一直给我喂独家消息，比如副总统那条。

en: This guy is after my uncle's vault.
zh: 这家伙在打我叔叔保险库的主意。

en: This guy killed Anna in cold blood. He delivered dangerous weapons to criminals!
zh: 这家伙冷血地杀了安娜。他把危险武器交给了罪犯！

en: This had better all be worth it.
This information is important to an ongoing investigation.
zh: 这些信息对正在进行的调查很重要。

en: This is ... not stricly legal.
This is Bennet.
This is Interrogation 101 stuff, Jimmy Olsen. So listen close.
zh: 这是审讯入门课，吉米·奥尔森。仔细听好。

en: This is Morales' personal journal.
zh: 这是莫拉莱斯的私人日记。

en: This is a bit too important to go swinging it around.
zh: 这个太重要了，不能拿来乱挥。

en: This is a key card that gives you back-end access.
zh: 这是一张能让你获得后台访问权限的钥匙卡。

en: This is a pretty strong magnet. It might not come off again if I stick it to something.
zh: 这块磁铁吸力很强。要是把它粘到什么东西上，可能就再也取不下来了。

en: This is a test of the label.  Does it word wrap correctly?  Do I need to make it longer? [Does the line break work here?
zh: 这是标签的测试。它能正确换行吗？我需要把它弄长一点吗？[这里换行有效吗？

en: This is a vindication of-
This is against everything I believe in.
zh: 这违背我所信奉的一切。

en: This is against regulations.
This is all their fault!
This is as poisoned a legacy as any I have given you, Anna.
zh: 这是我留给你的又一份有毒的遗产，安娜。

en: This is bigger than me. Bigger than Anna or Morales or any of us.
zh: 这件事比我更重要。比安娜、莫拉莱斯或我们任何人都更重要。

en: This is evidence. I need to hold onto it.
This is fantastic!
This is going to be a great story. I can feel it!
zh: 这会是个绝佳的报道。我有预感！

en: This is gonna be fun
This is hardly the time.
This is it.
This is more a puzzle box than a safe.
zh: 这更像是个机关盒，而不是保险柜。

en: This is my only real link to my uncle. I need to keep it.
zh: 这是我与叔叔唯一的真正联系。我得留着它。

en: This is no time for sleeping.
zh: 现在可不是睡觉的时候。

en: This is no time to go shopping.
zh: 现在可不是逛街的时候。

en: This is no time to play in the water.
This is not an apartment; it's a staging area.
zh: 这不是公寓，这是个行动据点。

en: This is not the time for racing office chairs.
zh: 现在不是赛办公椅的时候。

en: This is one of the devices Ed used to kill Morales.
zh: 这是埃德用来杀死莫拉莱斯的装置之一。

en: This is our future.  We can't deny mankind this gift.
zh: 这是我们的未来。我们不能剥夺人类这份礼物。

en: This is so exciting!
This is some kind of document written in legalese.
zh: 这是一份用法律术语写的文件。

en: This is the Emerald City, where we oversee all the green!
zh: 这里是翡翠城，我们掌管所有的绿票子！

en: This is the key to the drawer where I keep my electronics.
zh: 这是我放电子设备的抽屉的钥匙。

en: This is the master keycard for the police data retrieval system.
zh: 这是警方数据检索系统的主钥匙卡。

en: This is the place. C'mon, Jimmy Olsen. Let's look around.
zh: 就是这里了。来吧，吉米·奥尔森。我们四处看看。

en: This is the start of a beautiful friendship!
zh: 这是一段美好友谊的开端！

en: This is the wrong door anyway.
This is where Saul keeps his tools.
zh: 索尔把他的工具放在这里。

en: This is where that mope hides out. And that Chinese lady.
zh: 那个闷闷不乐的家伙就藏在这里。还有那个中国女人。

en: This is your fault!
This isn't a scientific or a mathematical dilemma.
zh: 这不是科学或数学上的两难。

en: This isn't helping.
This isn't it.
This isn't me! I don't want to hurt anybody anymore.
zh: 这不是我！我不想再伤害任何人了。

en: This isn't the military, Reggie.
This isn't the only place in town that's got problems right now.
zh: 现在城里出问题的不止这一个地方。

en: This ladder allows access to the roof.
zh: 这架梯子可以通往屋顶。

en: This little gadget lets me see right into the mechanism.
zh: 这个小装置能让我直接看到机械结构内部。

en: This locker has the name Todd on it.
zh: 这个柜子上写着托德的名字。

en: This locker is labeled "Frank"
zh: 这个储物柜上标着“弗兰克”

en: This locker is labeled "Steve"
zh: 这个储物柜上标着“史蒂夫”

en: This locker is labeled "Todd"
zh: 这个储物柜上标着“托德”

en: This machine is like a crazy paranoid conspiracy theory come true.
zh: 这台机器就像疯狂偏执的阴谋论成真了一样。

en: This might come in handy.
This morning.
This must be what Ed was planning. We're too late.
zh: 这一定是埃德计划的事。我们太迟了。

en: This office handles the databases, reporting, maintenance, that sort of thing.
zh: 这间办公室负责数据库、报告、维护之类的事。

en: This one keeps people from climbing up to the roof.
zh: 这个能防止人们爬到屋顶。

en: This one more than any other.
zh: 这一份比任何一份都更甚。

en: This panel was short circuited by water leaking out of a broken pipe.
zh: 这块面板被破裂管道漏出的水短路了。

en: This particle accelerator used powerful magnetic fields to bend the trajectory of highly accelerated particles.
zh: 这台粒子加速器使用强大的磁场来弯曲高度加速粒子的轨迹。

en: This pin is slightly bent.
This pipe is just about the same length as the missing section...
zh: 这根管子长度差不多和缺失的那段一样……

en: This pipe is practically disintigrating in my hand. Who let it get this rusty?
zh: 这根管子在我手里几乎要碎掉了。谁让它锈成这样的？

en: This place doesn't even have wi-fi.
zh: 这地方连无线网都没有。

en: This place is a wreck.
This post office is supposedly being used as a drop-point for some shady organization.
zh: 据说这家邮局被某个见不得光的组织当成了接头点。

en: This power... Resonance... could save the world... or it could destroy it.
zh: 这种力量……共振……可以拯救世界……也可以毁灭它。

en: This prescription isn't made out to you. As a doctor, I can't condone-
zh: 这张处方不是开给你的。作为医生，我不能纵容——

en: This puzzle box is a work of art.
zh: 这个机关盒是件艺术品。

en: This rope raises and lowers the roof-access ladder.
zh: 这根绳子升降通往屋顶的梯子。

en: This second Resonance device has another phone attached. Probably worth a look.
zh: 这台第二台共振装置上还连着另一部电话。也许值得看看。

en: This seems to be the switch controlling power to the grid below.
zh: 这似乎是控制下方电网电源的开关。

en: This seems to keep him busy for a while.
zh: 这似乎能让他忙上一阵子。

en: This shard of glass is loose.
This should do it.
This should do the trick.
This should help lighten the load.
zh: 这应该能帮我减轻点负担。

en: This sketch was taped crudely to the wall.
zh: 这张草图被粗粗地贴在墙上。

en: This story keeps getting deeper.
This story will make or break my career... or both.
zh: 这篇报道会成就我的事业……或者毁掉它……或者两者兼有。

en: This thing could hurt someone.
This thing is belching sparks and smoke.
zh: 这东西正喷着火花和烟雾。

en: This thing must've fallen from the ceiling when whatever it was that happened here ate the wall that was supporting it.
zh: 这里发生的事吃掉了支撑它的墙壁，这东西肯定是从天花板上掉下来的。

en: This was no accident.
This was your uncle's dream. You can't let that die.
zh: 这是你叔叔的梦想。你不能让它破灭。

en: This whole city is full of litter.
zh: 整座城市到处都是垃圾。

en: This whole thing started at Juno Labs, right? Seems like the best place to sniff around.
zh: 整件事是从朱诺实验室开始的，对吧？看起来那是最适合打探的地方。

en: This won't be useful anymore.
This works best when plugged into a USB port.
zh: 这东西插进USB端口效果最好。

en: This year's "Most Wanted" list.
zh: 今年的“头号通缉犯”名单。

en: This... this is awkward, but...
Those are just decorative.
Those are the equations I was working on all last night for Doctor Morales.
zh: 那些是我昨晚通宵为莫拉莱斯博士做的方程。

en: Those are the pants I wore last night.
Those articles they had you write? You didn't actually think they were interested in your career, did you?
zh: 他们让你写的那些文章？你不会真以为他们对你的职业生涯感兴趣吧？

en: Those bars are on tight.
Those bastards...
Those blueprints are as good as ours. We just need to be persistent. And careful.
zh: 那些蓝图就是我们的了。我们只需要坚持。还有小心。

en: Those cables caused plenty of trouble 'round the lab.
zh: 那些电缆在实验室里惹了不少麻烦。

en: Those cans are too small to hide in.
zh: 那些罐子太小了，藏不进去。

en: Those crooks are old news. I don't need that.
zh: 那些罪犯都是旧闻了。我不需要那个。

en: Those designs are quite elegant.
Those designs on the wall are quite extraordinary.
zh: 墙上那些设计真不简单。

en: Those doors look extremely sturdy.
zh: 那些门看起来极其坚固。

en: Those doors look pretty thick.
Those doors were built to prevent people from breaking in.
zh: 那些门就是为了防止有人闯进去而造的。

en: Those electronic news vendors just aren't the same as real, live vendors.
zh: 那些电子新闻售卖机跟真人售卖机就是不一样。

en: Those magnets should lift up those crates. We just need to turn them on.
zh: 那些磁铁应该能抬起那些箱子。我们只需要打开它们。

en: Those people give me the creeps.
Those two things don't really work together.
zh: 这两样东西凑不到一块儿去。

en: Those two things don't work together.
zh: 这两样东西凑不到一块儿去。

en: Those were Resonance blasts.
Threaten his life.
Threaten to write about him.
Three days and nobody has taken that trash away.
zh: 三天了，没人把那堆垃圾拿走。

en: Three months ago, you built a vault for a Dr. Javier Morales.
zh: 三个月前，你为哈维尔·莫拉莱斯博士建造了一个保险库。

en: Three paradigms
Three slots, but two fuses. Where's the third?
zh: 三个插槽，但只有两根保险丝。第三根在哪？

en: Three twenty-five... such a ripoff.
Through that window is...
Through the doors, or over the fence.
zh: 要么穿过那些门，要么翻过围栏。

en: Thwarted by one cheap lock.
Time for that ambulance, Detective!
Time to make my exit before the next secretary arrives.
zh: 得趁接班的秘书还没到，赶紧走人。

en: Time's running out.
Time's up.
Tin man!
Tip: Type /help at any time to see
To Kumi, Emi, and Zen for understanding my obsession
To commit an object from the room to your short-term memory (STM) for use in a conversation, DRAG the object into the STM screen.
zh: 要把房间中的物体存入短期记忆（STM）以便在对话中使用，请把该物体拖入短期记忆界面。

en: To create a Short-Term memory of any item in the game, click and drag the item from the screen and drop it into a slot in your STM (Short-Term Memory.)
zh: 要创建游戏中任何物品的短期记忆，请点击并将物品从屏幕拖放到STM（短期记忆）槽位中。

en: To find and open Dr. Morales' vault, we need three things.
zh: 要找到并打开莫拉莱斯博士的保险库，我们需要三样东西。

en: To insinuate himself into the life of the only person who could open the vault other than Dr. Morales...
zh: 为了让自己融入那个唯一能打开保险库的人的生活，除了莫拉莱斯博士之外……

en: To me adjusting the operation's parameters based on changes in the field.
zh: 看我根据现场变化调整行动参数。

en: To switch characters, move your mouse to the top of the screen to reveal the Character Switching Interface.[[Take control of the desired character by left-clicking the corresponding portrait.[[Remember, each character has their own separate inventory.
zh: 要切换角色，将鼠标移到屏幕顶部，显示角色切换界面。[[左键点击对应头像即可控制该角色。[[记住，每个角色都有各自独立的物品栏。

en: To tell you the truth, I don't think that is important.

en: We store old files in this cabinet.
zh: 我们把旧文件存在这个柜子里。

en: We trusted you, you asshole.
zh: 我们那么信任你，你这个混蛋。

en: We used to have a fancy one, but only Oink could use it.
zh: 我们以前有台花哨的，但只有奥因克会用。

en: We used to use it to measure magnetic waves, particle movements and thermal energy, among other things.
zh: 我们以前用它来测量磁波、粒子运动和热能，还有其他东西。

en: We wait until Amul and Reno and all their associates are behind bars.
zh: 我们等到阿穆尔、雷诺和他们的所有同伙都被关进监狱。

en: We want to see it put to good use.
zh: 我们想看到它被善加利用。

en: We were hoping for some help regarding...
zh: 我们希望你能帮个忙，关于……

en: We were in the middle of a briefing, business as usual-
zh: 我们当时正在开简报会，一切照常——

en: We were on that stakeout all night shootin' the shit.
zh: 我们整晚都在蹲守，闲扯了一夜。

en: We weren't exactly close, but... he was still the only family I had left.
zh: 我们算不上亲近，但……他毕竟是我仅剩的亲人了。

en: We will find your vault together. Don't worry.
zh: 我们会一起找到你的保险库。别担心。

en: We will stand fast, and we will stand strong.
zh: 我们将坚定不移，我们将坚强不屈。

en: We worked well together clearing that boulder, didn't we?
zh: 我们清理那块巨石时配合得不错，对吧？

en: We'd better figure out a way to get that electric cable out of the way.
zh: 我们最好想办法把那根电缆弄开。

en: We'd better keep this to ourselves until the last moment.
zh: 我们最好在最后一刻之前都保密。

en: We'd better make sure the next one is the right one.
zh: 我们最好确保下一个就是正确的那个。

en: We'll find him.
We'll get him.
We'll have to do some reconnaissance.
We'll have to figure it out by the time we get to the vault.
zh: 我们得在到达保险库之前弄明白。

en: We'll have to find a way to move them.
zh: 我们得想办法把它们移开。

en: We'll have to get those doors open.
We'll have to open them using the keypad.
zh: 我们得用键盘打开它们。

en: We'll have to think of some other way to convince him.
zh: 我们得想别的办法说服他。

en: We'll let Saul handle it.
We'll point you in the right direction.
zh: 我们会给你们指对方向。

en: We'll support you however we can.
We'll tell the world what he did, and stop his sick little plan.
zh: 我们要把他干的事公之于众，阻止他那变态的小计划。

en: We're collectors.
We're done here.
We're going to find you and stop you.
We're going to stay here for a little while, figure out what to do.
zh: 我们要在这儿待一会儿，想想该怎么办。

en: We're gonna get you out of here!
We're gonna have to move that if we want to get in this way.
zh: 想从这边进去，就得把它挪开。

en: We're in a service tunnel underneath Juno's old super collider.
zh: 我们在朱诺旧超级对撞机下方的服务隧道里。

en: We're in way over our heads. We need to trust somebody.
zh: 我们陷得太深了。总得相信个人。

en: We're in. Let's trace that phone number and get out of here.
zh: 我们进来了。追踪那个电话号码，然后离开这里。

en: We're kindred spirits!
We're looking for another Resonance device. A round sphere with a cell phone attached. How can we find it?
zh: 我们在找另一个共振装置。一个连着手机的圆球。怎么才能找到它？

en: We're not done yet, sweetheart.
We're not there yet.
We're running out of time. We should kick these doors down.
zh: 我们没时间了。应该把这些门踹开。

en: We're trying to direct them where it's needed most.
zh: 我们正试着把他们调到最需要的地方。

en: We're wanted men, Ray. We can't just waltz into the tech room at HQ and use the tracking equipment.
zh: 我们是通缉犯，雷。我们不能大摇大摆走进总部的技术室用追踪设备。

en: We're way off the books on this one.
zh: 这件事我们完全不能走正规渠道。

en: We've all filed complaints about the noise, but nothing works.
zh: 我们都投诉过噪音，但没用。

en: We've all got our reasons for being here, Anna. This is mine.
zh: 我们来到这里都有自己的理由，安娜。这就是我的理由。

en: We've almost got those blueprints, I know it. It just comes down to math. It always does.
zh: 我们就快拿到那些蓝图了，我知道。归根结底就是数学问题。一直都是这样。

en: We've already shown him that.
zh: 我们已经给他看过那个了。

en: We've been through that closet, and there wasn't a wrench in there.
zh: 我们查过那个维修间，里面根本没有扳手。

en: We've got a friend in common - Tolstoy Eddings.
zh: 我们有个共同的朋友——托尔斯泰·埃丁斯。

en: We've got a new phone number. Seems like a good a lead as any.
zh: 我们拿到了一个新电话号码。看起来是个不错的线索。

en: We've got a whole evidence locker full of those cheap pre-paid Cellfish phones that we don't know what to do with.
zh: 我们有个证物柜，塞满了那种便宜的预付费Cellfish手机，都不知道拿它们怎么办。

en: We've got another Resonance device with another phone. We probably should check its call history.
zh: 我们又拿到一台共振装置，配着另一部手机。我们大概该查查它的通话记录。

en: We've got everything that panjandrum Tortoise wanted. Why aren't we talking to him right now?
zh: 托托伊斯那个自命不凡的家伙，要的东西我们都拿到了。还不赶紧去找他？

en: We've got little mini-emergencies all over Aventine.
zh: 阿文廷到处都有小规模紧急情况。

en: We've got one of these back at the Star.
zh: 我们在星报也有一台这样的。

en: We've got the chief's office, payroll, HR...
zh: 我们有局长的办公室、薪资部、人事部……

en: We've got the panel working, but it looks like it needs an access code.
zh: 面板已经能用了，但看起来还需要一个访问码。

en: We've got to do a bit of plumbing.
zh: 我们得干点管道工的活儿。

en: We've got to find Ed's friend.
zh: 我们得找到埃德的朋友。

en: We've got to find Ed, and we've got to do it fast.
zh: 我们得找到埃德，而且得快。

en: We've got to find a way to convince him.
We've got to find a way to get past that slab of rock.
zh: 我们得想办法绕过那块石板。

en: We've got to find a way to stop it before I'll be able to fix this.
zh: 我们得想办法把它停下来，我才能修好这个。

en: We've got to find out where Uncle Javi's vault is, and for that we need the blueprints to Juno Labs.
zh: 我们得找出哈维叔叔的保险库在哪，为此我们需要朱诺实验室的蓝图。

en: We've got to get into that archive somehow!
zh: 我们得想办法进入那个档案室！

en: We've got to get over to the Antevorta office before Ed leaves.
zh: 我们得在埃德离开前赶到Antevorta办公室。

en: We've got to get to Dr. Morales as soon as possible! He's hurt!
zh: 我们得尽快赶到莫拉莱斯博士那里！他受伤了！

en: We've got to help him.
We've got to recover the data. There's no other option.
zh: 我们必须找回那些数据。别无选择。

en: We've got to stop it before I'll be able to fix this.
zh: 我们得把它停下来，我才能修好这个。

en: We've got to wait until the right time to reveal our hand.
zh: 我们得等到合适的时机才能亮出底牌。

en: We've jumped through enough hoops. Let's go talk to Tortoise and see if he spills.
zh: 我们已经绕够了弯子。去找托托伊斯谈谈，看他会不会松口。

en: We've just got to get on his good side. Show some common ground.
zh: 我们得讨他欢心。找些共同点。

en: We've looked in the closet. The wrench wasn't there.
zh: 我们看过壁橱了。扳手不在那儿。

en: We've managed to displace the stone from the entryway.
zh: 我们成功把石头从入口处移开了。

en: We've seen so many strange coincidences in the last twenty-four hours.
zh: 过去二十四小时里我们见到了太多奇怪的巧合。

en: Welcome %s
Welcome Anna Angel[[Video file To_Anna.video is ready to play.[[Display Video?
zh: 欢迎你，天使安娜[[视频文件 To_Anna.video 已就绪。[[是否播放？

en: Welcome back, %s
Welcome to Tortoise Securities
zh: 欢迎来到托托伊斯安保

en: Welcome to Tortoise security!
zh: 欢迎来到托托伊斯安保！

en: Welcome to the Antevorta Project.
Welcome to the police force, Detective.
Welcome, Anna Castellanos Morales
zh: 欢迎，安娜·卡斯特利亚诺斯·莫拉莱斯

en: Welcome, Anna Morales Castellanos
zh: 欢迎，安娜·莫拉莱斯·卡斯特利亚诺斯

en: Well I won't abandon you, Javi.
Well as first dates go, I've had stranger.
zh: 作为第一次约会来说，我经历过更奇怪的。

en: Well hello there.
Well if I knew you were coming, I'd change the locks too.
zh: 好吧，要是我知道你要来，我也会换锁。

en: Well no, but he-
Well then you're going back there.
Well you left me too.
Well, Dr. Morales gave me two sets of fingerprints to encode into the locking software.
zh: 嗯，莫拉莱斯博士给了我两组指纹，让我编码进锁定软件里。

en: Well, I already told you about Resonance and how it pulls the particles together.
zh: 嗯，我已经跟你讲过共振，以及它如何把粒子拉在一起。

en: Well, I can't even get up.
Well, I guess if it was VERY small. But only then.
zh: 好吧，如果非常小的话。但仅限如此。

en: Well, I like to work on unsolved mathematical problems.
zh: 嗯，我喜欢研究未解的数学问题。

en: Well, I would have lost it today if you hadn't picked it up for me.
zh: 嗯，今天要不是你帮我捡起来，我就把它弄丢了。

en: Well, I'm generally there more than I am home.
zh: 嗯，我在那儿的时间比在家还多。

en: Well, I'm going to need to go inside and assess the situation.
zh: 嗯，我得进去评估一下情况。

en: Well, I'm happy to wait for an opening.
zh: 好吧，我很乐意等你有空。

en: Well, as long as you knew the key code.
zh: 嗯，只要你知道密钥代码。

en: Well, at least we're not on the front page.
zh: 好吧，至少我们没上头条。

en: Well, bust my buttons!
Well, except for the recently released FishFone 5G S.
zh: 嗯，除了最近发布的FishFone 5G S。

en: Well, have at it.
Well, he was pretty paranoid.
Well, how does one normally look for a lost cell phone?
zh: 嗯，一般人通常怎么找丢失的手机？

en: Well, it's all we've got.
Well, it's just... I've never actually seen you here before.
zh: 呃，只是……我以前真没见过你在这儿。

en: Well, it's not technically "vaporizing"-
zh: 呃，严格来说那不算“蒸发”——

en: Well, it's written right there. The vault gives off a heat signature of 185 degrees.
zh: 嗯，就写在那儿。保险库散发的热信号是185度。

en: Well, keep dreaming. That's not going to happen, and you know it.
zh: 那就继续做梦吧。那不会发生的，你自己也知道。

en: Well, last time, the agency didn't have the oppressive oversight and security that it has now.
zh: 嗯，上次机构还没有现在这种严苛的监管和安保。

en: Well, maybe I could use the giant 'H' as furniture.
zh: 嗯，也许我可以把那个巨大的“H”当家具用。

en: Well, once I came this close to solving the Collatz Conjecture.
zh: 嗯，有一次我差一点就解开了考拉兹猜想。

en: Well, see, the universe is pretty much governed by laws, right?
zh: 嗯，你看，宇宙基本上是由规律支配的，对吧？

en: Well, that little mystery got solved alright.
zh: 好吧，那个小谜团算是解开了。

en: Well, that's going to be a problem.
Well, that's something, at least.
Well, the odds of that happening are astronomical.
zh: 嗯，这种事发生的概率简直天文数字。

en: Well, this is the ACPD administrative offices.
zh: 嗯，这里是阿文廷市警局（ACPD）的行政办公室。

en: Well, to tell you the truth, it's kind of tiring.
zh: 嗯，说实话，这活儿挺累人的。

en: Well, try to remember where we might find one.
zh: 好吧，想想我们可能在哪里找到一把。

en: Well, um... my best guess is-
Well, unfortunately, I can't just give that information away.
zh: 唉，可惜我不能随便把那种信息给人。

en: Well, we didn't really talk about anything else aside from his work.
zh: 嗯，除了他的工作，我们其实没聊过别的。

en: Well, we were back when I was a kid.
zh: 嗯，我小时候我们很亲近。

en: Well, you know the drill.
Well, you see, Detective, it was a Sunday morning, just like any other-
zh: 呃，你看，警探，那是个星期天早上，和别的星期天没什么两样——

en: Well, you wouldn't buy a pie from a skinny baker, now would you?
zh: 嗯，你总不会从一个瘦骨嶙峋的面包师那儿买派吧？

en: Well. It just blows my mind, is all.
zh: 嗯。反正就是让我脑子炸了。

en: Well...
Well... yeah...
Well?
Were you here when the blackout hit?
zh: 停电的时候你在这儿吗？

en: Were you listening to our converstion?
zh: 你当时在偷听我们谈话吗？

en: Were you listening to us there, too?
zh: 你在那儿也在偷听我们吗？

en: Weren't you supposed to introduce us to somebody?
zh: 你不是说要介绍个人给我们认识吗？

en: Whad I tell you!?
What I saw was unnecessary, irresponsible, and hasty.
zh: 我所看到的，是不必要、不负责任又草率的。

en: What I wouldn't give to be a fly on the wall when that happens.
zh: 要是那时候能当只墙上的苍蝇，我什么都愿意给。

en: What I wouldn't give to be alone with that police archive for ten minutes.
zh: 要是能让我单独接触那个警方档案库十分钟，我什么都愿意。

en: What IS the Antevorta Project?
What Oink does in his spare time
zh: 奥因克业余时间做什么

en: What a crazy day.
What about Ray?
What about your patients? Are they being taken care of while you help us?
zh: 你的病人怎么办？你帮我们的时候，他们有人照顾吗？

en: What am I going to do with all these coins?
zh: 我该拿这些硬币怎么办？

en: What am I supposed to do?
What are the chances of you being able to access the police archive system?
zh: 你有没有可能访问警察档案系统？

en: What are the chances of you knowing who that thug on the fire escape was?
zh: 你有可能知道防火梯上那个暴徒是谁吗？

en: What are the odds of that happening? Thousands to one, at least.
zh: 这种事发生的几率有多大？至少千分之一吧。

en: What are they building above the hospital?
zh: 他们在医院上面建什么？

en: What are they building there?
What are those things, anyways?
What are we waiting for?  Let's go find Doctor Morales!
zh: 还等什么？我们去找莫拉莱斯博士！

en: What are you doing here?!
What are you doing now?
What are you looking at me for?
What are you working on, Emma?
What can I do for you officer?
What can I do for you, Detective?
zh: 有什么能为您效劳的，警探？

en: What can I do for you?
What can I do with an empty pill bottle?
zh: 一个空药瓶我能拿来干什么？

en: What can I say? I have an honest face.
zh: 怎么说呢？我长着一张诚实脸。

en: What can the wizard do for you?
What can we do?
What can you tell me about the archive?
zh: 关于档案馆，你能告诉我些什么？

en: What caused all this?
What could have been so important that he'd nearly bankrupt himself?
zh: 到底是什么那么重要，让他几乎破产？

en: What could it mean?
What d'ya want?
What did Morales create?
What did you do to her? Break her heart?
zh: 你对她做了什么？伤了她的心？

en: What do I need again?
What do I say to him?
What do I say?
What do have in there?
What do we need to do?
What do you do back here?
What do you do here?
What do you do when you aren't investigating murders?
zh: 你不查谋杀案的时候都做些什么？

en: What do you do? What's your job?
zh: 你做什么的？你的工作是什么？

en: What do you know about Officer Johnsen?
zh: 你对约翰森警官了解多少？

en: What do you mean?
What do you need my help with?
What do you need?
What do you say?
What do you suppose are behind the basement doors?
zh: 你觉得地下室那些门后面是什么？

en: What do you think about Ed?
What do you think about the detective?
zh: 你觉得这位警探怎么样？

en: What do you think about the paintings in the hospital?
zh: 你觉得医院里那些画怎么样？

en: What do you think about those guys?
What do you think of Emma in "Research Projects"?
zh: 你觉得“研究项目”里的艾玛怎么样？

en: What do you think of Johnsen?
What do you think of Officer Berry?
zh: 你觉得贝里警官怎么样？

en: What do you think of the kook in the safe shop?
zh: 你觉得保险库商店里那个怪人怎么样？

en: What do you think of the lady in the Antevorta mainframe room?
zh: 你觉得Antevorta主机房里的那位女士怎么样？

en: What do you think we should do next?
zh: 你觉得我们下一步该做什么？

en: What do you think, Anna?
What do you think?
What do you think? What's the next step?
zh: 你觉得呢？下一步怎么办？

en: What do you want with the Resonance devices?
What do you want with the Resonance research?
zh: 你想拿共振研究做什么？

en: What do you want?
What does he serve? Dinner? Tennis balls?
What does it say?
What does that control panel really do, anyway?
zh: 那个控制面板到底是干什么的？

en: What does that terminal at Juno Lab do?
zh: 朱诺实验室那台终端是干什么的？

en: What does that terminal at the lab do?
zh: 实验室那台终端是干什么的？

en: What does this do?
What does this panel do?
What exactly do I do with this card thing?
What exactly does that entail?
What exactly is going on here?
What goes on in this office?
zh: 这间办公室是做什么的？

en: What happened to the building?
What happens now?
What have I done?
What if we were wrong?
What is Ed after?
What is Ed planning?
What is it?
What is that thing?
What is this crap?
What is this office?
zh: 这间办公室是什么地方？

en: What is this place?
What is this?
What is your opinion of Anna?
What is your opinion of Ray?
What just happened?
What kind of cop looks to origami for clues?
zh: 什么样的警察会从折纸里找线索？

en: What makes a safe "Rapture Ready?"
zh: 是什么让一个保险箱“被提准备好了”？

en: What makes some computer worth... all this?
zh: 一台电脑凭什么值得……这一切？

en: What makes the safe "Rapture Ready?"
zh: 这保险箱怎么就“被提准备好了”？

en: What mistake?
What note?
What part of "not interested" don't you understand?
zh: “没兴趣”这几个字你哪部分听不懂？

en: What shall I trace?
What she said
What should I do with it? Strip off my suit and get a tan?
zh: 我该拿它怎么办？脱掉西装去晒个日光浴？

en: What sick bastard created this, and why?
zh: 是哪个变态混蛋搞出这种东西的，为什么？

en: What sort of weirdo turns up and starts digging through trash?
zh: 什么样的怪人才会跑来翻垃圾桶？

en: What sorts of personnel are authorized?
What the - ?
What the hell are we doing wandering around the hospital basement?
zh: 我们到底在医院地下室瞎转悠什么？

en: What the hell are you doing? Security get down here!
zh: 你到底在干什么？保安，快下来！

en: What the hell did this?
What the hell happened here?
What the hell was that?
What the hell?
What the-?
What the...
What the...?
What was he talking about?
What was it that tied yesterday's stakeout to this Resonance case?
zh: 昨天那场蹲守和这桩共振案子，到底有什么关联？

en: What was it...
What was my uncle trying to tell me?
What was that Hippocratic oath again?
zh: 希波克拉底誓言是怎么说的来着？

en: What was that he handed you on the way out?
zh: 他出去的时候递给你什么了？

en: What was that sound?
What was that thing again?
What was that?
What was the blackout like here?
zh: 这里的停电是什么情况？

en: What was the heat signature?
What was the second thing?
What will we find in there?
zh: 我们会在里面发现什么？

en: What would I do with that?
What're you doing?
What's "stepmother" mean?
What's a nice girl like you doing in a place like-
zh: 像你这么好的姑娘怎么会来这种——

en: What's a personal bubble alarm?
zh: 什么是个人空间警报器？

en: What's a self-sealing stembolt?
What's going on with the man-hunt?
What's going on, Ray?
What's going on?
What's his status?
What's in the basement?
What's in the tech room?
What's our next step?
What's that on the TV, there?
What's that supposed to mean?
What's that thing over there?
What's that you got there?
What's that?
What's the deal with the desk cop at the station?

en: What's the giant crane at the hospital for?

en: Yes, I see the contradiction.
zh: 是的，我看到了这个矛盾。

en: Yes, I sold my car for ten thousand dollars!
zh: 没错，我把车卖了一万美元！

en: Yes, I traced his phone to the hospital!
zh: 是的，我追踪到他的手机信号在医院！

en: Yes, I'm off at the next stop.
Yes, Mom.
Yes, Ray! They are hiding in plain sight. And in a hospital, no less.
zh: 没错，雷！他们就藏在眼皮底下。而且还是在医院里。

en: Yes, ma'am.
Yes, of course.
Yes, press back.
Yes, sir.
Yes, that must be the vault.
Yes, the mountain.
Yes, we are aware of it. We are aware of a great many things.
zh: 是的，我们知道。我们知道的事情多着呢。

en: Yes.
Yes. And if there is corruption in the police force, we could use his blog to help expose it.
zh: 确定。如果警队里真有腐败，我们可以用他的博客来帮忙曝光。

en: Yes. I know. I'll get over there soon.
zh: 是的。我知道。我很快会过去的。

en: Yes. I'm sorry. I've had a lot on my mind.
zh: 是的。抱歉。我心里装的事太多了。

en: Yes. It will be worth it.
Yes. Someone broke into my office two months ago.
zh: 是的。两个月前有人闯进了我的办公室。

en: Yes. That's what we're up against.
zh: 是的。这就是我们要面对的。

en: Yes. We got there too late. Maybe if we got there earlier...
zh: 是的。我们到得太晚了。要是我们早点到……

en: Yes. When I clear my name, I still want a job.
zh: 对。等我洗清罪名，我还想要份工作。

en: Yes?
Yesterday I saw our mope enter the post office, and then enter that alleyway.
zh: 昨天我看见我们那个闷葫芦进了邮局，然后进了那条小巷。

en: Yesterday morning I was staking out this known criminal dead-drop with my partner.
zh: 昨天早上我和搭档在监视一个已知罪犯的接头点。

en: Yet.
Yo!
Yo, Detective.
You again?
You and I both know how much disregard my uncle had for rules... even if they were set up for his own safety.
zh: 你我都清楚我叔叔有多无视规矩……哪怕那些规矩是为了他自己的安全。

en: You and your "Eleven Foundation" are behind that DNA database - Antevorta.
zh: 你和你的“十一基金会”就是那个DNA数据库——Antevorta——的幕后黑手。

en: You and your journalist pal.
You and your uncle weren't close?
You angling for a promotion?
You are carrying nothing.
You are pointing a gun at a superior officer.
zh: 你正拿枪指着一名片长。

en: You are the finest up-and-coming detective I've ever had the privilege to work with.
zh: 你是我有幸共事过的最出色的新晋警探。

en: You are the one holding my gun.
You backstabbing son of a bitch!
zh: 你这背后捅刀子的狗娘养的！

en: You believe that?
You better be!
You better let me check it out first darlin'.
zh: 你最好让我先检查一下，亲爱的。

en: You came back into my life just in time to abandon me again.
zh: 你回到我的生活里，刚好来得及再次抛弃我。

en: You came. I wasn't sure if you would.
zh: 你来了。我还不确定你会不会来。

en: You can also drag and drop INV items onto other INV items to try combining them.
zh: 在物品栏（INV）中，把一件物品拖到另一件上，就能尝试组合。

en: You can be annoying. You know that?
zh: 你有时候真烦人。你知道吗？

en: You can check for yourself.
You can combine inventory items by dragging one item and dropping it on another item within the INV screen.
zh: 在物品栏（INV）里，将一件物品拖到另一件上，即可尝试组合。

en: You can do that, right?
You can drag an item straight from a room object or from the STM screen onto a character to initiate a conversation about that item.
zh: 将房间中的物体或 STM 界面中的记忆直接拖到角色身上，就能和对方谈论它。

en: You can feel the static electricity just getting close to that water. I'd better stay away.
zh: 光是靠近那片水就能感觉到静电。我最好离远点。

en: You can find the distance between two Resonance devices by the size of the blast made when the particles snapped back together.
zh: 你可以通过粒子重新结合时产生的爆炸规模，推算出两个共振装置之间的距离。

en: You can get a good lead on stories in the hospital, if security doesn't find you first.
zh: 在医院里你能挖到好线索，只要保安没先找到你。

en: You can get a wealth of information from the lower pages of a half-used legal pad.
zh: 从一本用了一半的便笺本后半部分，你能挖出大量信息。

en: You can interact with an inventory item by left clicking it in the INV screen.
zh: 在物品栏（INV）里左键点击物品，即可操作它。

en: You can justify your actions all night long, but you're still murdering scum to me.
zh: 你可以整晚为自己的行为辩解，但对我来说，你仍然是杀人渣滓。

en: You can never be too careful in Aventine City.
zh: 在阿文廷市，再怎么小心也不为过。

en: You can place these devices some distance apart and then release the particles trapped inside.
zh: 你可以把这些装置隔开一段距离放置，然后释放困在里面的粒子。

en: You can see into the interrogation room through some one-way glass.
zh: 你可以透过单向玻璃看到审讯室里。

en: You can thank me later.
You can then place these devices some distance apart and then release the particles trapped inside.
zh: 然后你可以把这些装置分开放置，再释放困在里面的粒子。

en: You can use an inventory item on a room object by dragging the item out of the INV screen and dropping it onto the target object.
zh: 从物品栏（INV）拖出物品，放到房间中的目标上，即可对它使用物品。

en: You can use an inventory item on an object or character in the room, or on another item in your INV.
zh: 你可以对房间里的物体或角色使用物品栏物品，也可以对物品栏（INV）中的另一件物品使用。

en: You can wait here.
You can't deprive the world of such-
zh: 你不能剥夺世界这样的——

en: You can't order me to do that!
zh: 你不能命令我做这种事！

en: You can't post that article.
You can't trust a guy like that.
You could say that.
You could take out anything you wanted to.
zh: 你想除掉什么就能除掉什么。

en: You could use this to re-calibrate the arm that retrieves documents.
zh: 你可以用它来重新校准抓取文件的机械臂。

en: You coulda just said that.
You cracked the safe. I'm impressed.
zh: 你打开了保险箱。我服了。

en: You did what?!
You didn't have anything to do with it.
You didn't hurt your back lifting that heavy beam did you?
zh: 你抬那根重梁的时候没伤到背吧？

en: You didn't read all of it.
You don't actually have a car, do you?
You don't care about all that.
You don't get to talk about Resonance!
You don't have a mama any more!
You don't have to do it alone!
You don't know anything about the code in Uncle Javi's journal?
zh: 哈维叔叔日记里的密码，你完全不知道吗？

en: You don't know who that guy on the fire escape was, do you?
zh: 你不知道防火梯上那个人是谁，对吧？

en: You don't need anything over here.
zh: 这边你不需要任何东西。

en: You don't think these are the guys?
zh: 你觉得不是这些人干的？

en: You don't want a cup of coffee, or anything?
zh: 你不想来杯咖啡什么的？

en: You don't want to be up here...
You don't?
You find a way to get me through that window and we'll find a way through that hallway together.
zh: 你想法子让我穿过那扇窗，我们就一起想办法穿过那条走廊。

en: You finished?
You fired the gun. The device was in your apartment.
zh: 是你开的枪。装置就在你的公寓里。

en: You got a note, too? My uncle wrote a note, saying the police were after him.
zh: 你也拿到纸条了？我叔叔写了一张纸条，说警察在追他。

en: You got any better ideas?
You got any ideas?
You got in there before, didn't you? Why can't you get in there now?
zh: 你之前进去过，对吧？为什么现在进不去了？

en: You got it!?
You got that warrant yet?
You got those blueprints yet? I dunno how much longer I can keep Johnsen yapping.
zh: 你拿到那些蓝图了吗？我不知道还能让约翰森唠叨多久。

en: You guys should keep away from all these falling objects. That metal slab on the far end? Dangerous.
zh: 你们最好离这些掉下来的东西远点。最那头那块金属板？很危险。

en: You had to, huh?
You have goldfish?
You have no authority to order me to do something illegal!
zh: 你无权命令我做违法的事！

en: You have no idea. He used to lock up his pens after using them.
zh: 你根本想象不到。他用完笔之后都会锁起来。

en: You have no proof that a crime even took place.
zh: 你连犯罪是否发生过都证明不了。

en: You have requested a password reset from the Antevorta System.[[Your password is:
zh: 您已请求从 Antevorta 系统重置密码。[[您的密码是：

en: You have to open it, and then we'll make the decision together.
zh: 你得打开它，然后我们一起做决定。

en: You have to wonder who he used to be before he became nobody.
zh: 你不禁会想，在他变成无名之辈以前，他曾经是谁。

en: You heard Bruckman's speech. Peace treaties are being signed around the world.
zh: 你听到了布鲁克曼的演讲。世界各地都在签署和平条约。

en: You hit me, you asshole!
You in there, Ozzy?
You jumped from up there?
You just can't get that kind of craftsmanship from a factory made job. Trust me on this.
zh: 工厂流水线做出来的东西，可没有这种手艺。相信我。

en: You just have to find it...
You kept a coin for that long?
zh: 你留着那枚硬币那么久？

en: You killed Morales, no one else.
zh: 是你杀了莫拉莱斯，没有别人。

en: You killed them in cold blood.
You knew the Doc. I didn't. I wouldn't know where to begin.
zh: 你认识博士。我不认识。我都不知道从哪儿查起。

en: You knocked me out! Tied me up!
zh: 你把我打晕了！还把我绑起来！

en: You know I couldn't have had anything to do with it.
zh: 你知道我不可能跟这事有关。

en: You know I didn't do those things
zh: 你知道那些事不是我干的

en: You know I wouldn't.
You know NOTHING about Resonance!
You know a little bit about hacking, right?
zh: 你懂一点黑客技术，对吧？

en: You know about that too?  I swear, the guy thinks nobody notices.
zh: 你也知道这事？我发誓，那家伙还以为没人注意到。

en: You know anything about cracking combination locks?
zh: 你知道怎么破解密码锁吗？

en: You know how this ends.
You know if you're going to shoot us or not.
zh: 你知道自己会不会开枪打我们。

en: You know the way things are these days - no-one wanted him on their squad.
zh: 你知道现在这世道——没人愿意让他进自己的小队。

en: You know this mope?
You know what I have to do to keep food on our table!?
zh: 你知道为了让我们有饭吃我得做什么吗！？

en: You know what they say. When you hit rock bottom, there's no place to go but up.
zh: 你知道他们怎么说的。跌到谷底时，除了往上走别无去处。

en: You know what? Forget it. The less I know about this, the better.
zh: 算了。这事我知道得越少越好。

en: You know what? Hold that thought.
You know what? Jimmy Olsen is fine.
zh: 你知道吗？吉米·奥尔森挺好的。

en: You know, I don't want to disrepect the dead or anything, but do you get the feeling that Dr. Morales liked to overcomplicate things?
zh: 你知道，我不想对死者不敬，但你不觉得莫拉莱斯博士喜欢把事情搞得太复杂吗？

en: You know, Ray. I've been thinking.
zh: 你知道吗，雷。我一直在想。

en: You know, government guys.
You know, stories like this are often circular.
zh: 你知道，这样的故事往往是循环的。

en: You know. Poking your nose where it doesn't belong.
zh: 你知道的。到处打探不该你管的事。

en: You look familiar.
You look like you're in the middle of something important.
zh: 你看起来正忙着什么重要的事。

en: You mean my gun?
You meet any hot... chicks recently?
zh: 你最近有没有遇到什么辣……妹子？

en: You mentioned Amul and Reno...
zh: 你提到了阿穆尔和雷诺……

en: You mentioned something about going to the cemetery...
You might be able to find its heat signature.
zh: 你也许能找到它的热信号。

en: You might be right, Ed.
You murderer!
You must really love your work.
zh: 你一定很热爱你的工作。

en: You need information, right? Well, that's my bread and butter.
zh: 你需要情报，对吧？那正是我的拿手好戏。

en: You need to flush out your system.
zh: 你需要把体内毒素排出去。

en: You need to focus on stopping it.
zh: 你们得集中精力阻止它。

en: You need to stop whatever you're doing, and you need to stop now.
zh: 你必须停止你正在做的一切，而且必须马上停止。

en: You need to swipe an authorised hospital ID card to go to the morgue.
zh: 你需要刷一张授权的医院ID卡才能去太平间。

en: You need to think back.
You needed a nudge, we gave it to you.
zh: 你需要有人推一把，我们就推了你一把。

en: You never know when a nice heavy chunk of brick is going to come in handy.
zh: 你永远不知道一块好用的沉砖头什么时候会派上用场。

en: You notice that city-wide blackout we just had?
zh: 你注意到刚才全城停电了吗？

en: You opened it?
You people all look the same.
zh: 你们这些人长得都一样。

en: You put all of this in motion.
You really believe that? Didn't you see the news?
zh: 你真信这个？你没看新闻吗？

en: You really have no idea what Antevorta is, do you?
zh: 你根本不知道Antevorta是什么，对吧？

en: You really want to turn back now?
You rub your hands up and down your clothes.
zh: 你用双手上下搓了搓衣服。

en: You said something about going to a cemetery earlier...
zh: 你之前说过要去墓地的事……

en: You said you needed two things.
You see some ugly things on the force, but that was one of the ugliest.
zh: 当警察见过不少丑恶的东西，但那是其中最丑恶的之一。

en: You set up that device in your apartment.
zh: 是你在自己公寓里装的那个装置。

en: You shot her!
You sided with an enemy to stop a greater foe
zh: 你与敌人联手阻止更大的威胁

en: You solved it!
You son of a bitch!
You son of a bitch.
You stay out of this, asshole!
You still there?
You stopped a killer, but let the big fish go free
zh: 你阻止了杀手，却放走了大鱼

en: You sure?
You sure? Because there's a place just down the road. I could just pop over...
zh: 你确定？因为路那头就有一家。我可以跑一趟……

en: You take a look around for your friend.
You take me to the nicest places
zh: 你带我来的地方可真不错。

en: You tell me.
You think Ed was using the Antevorta terminal?
You think I wanted this to happen?
zh: 你以为我想让这一切发生吗？

en: You think I wear this uniform 'cause it brings out the color of my eyes?
zh: 你以为我穿这身制服是因为它衬我眼睛的颜色？

en: You think he's up there.
You think so? I was scared out of my mind.
zh: 你这么觉得？我当时吓得魂都没了。

en: You think that's gonna happen?
You think they're adding levels to the hospital?.
zh: 你觉得他们在给医院加楼层？

en: You think you get used to death, but you can't get used to seeing someone you love laid out on a slab.
zh: 你以为你会习惯死亡，但你没法习惯看到你爱的人躺在停尸台上。

en: You think your birthday's the combination?
zh: 你觉得你的生日就是密码？

en: You three will have to clear a path for me.
zh: 你们三个得为我清出一条路。

en: You tried to kill me!
You two get over to Edgetown.
You two need to finish what we came here to do.
zh: 你们两个得完成我们来这里要做的事。

en: You walked by us in the hospital.
zh: 你在医院从我们旁边走过。

en: You wanna check out Ed's bathroom?
zh: 你想看看埃德的浴室吗？

en: You want to change places?
You want to get us caught? If we have to kick down a door, let's make sure it's the right one.
zh: 你想让我们被抓吗？如果非得踹门，那就确保踹对那扇。

en: You watch your back when you go to the cemetery with Anna.
zh: 你跟安娜去墓地的时候，小心点。

en: You were right all along!
You were using us the whole time.
You were working for them?
You weren't close?
You wouldn't be able to unlock the maintenance closet for me, would you?
zh: 你能不能帮我打开维修间？

en: You wouldn't be able to unlock the server room for me, would you?
zh: 你能不能帮我打开服务器机房？

en: You wouldn't believe it!
You wouldn't have a car mirror handy, would you?
zh: 你手边没有汽车后视镜吧？

en: You wouldn't know how to access the police archive system, would you?
zh: 你该不会正好知道怎么进入警方档案系统吧？

en: You wouldn't know sense if it punched you in your damn nose!
zh: 就算道理一拳打在你那该死的鼻子上，你也认不出来！

en: You wouldn't want all the left-behind heathens going through your personal effects, now would you?
zh: 你总不希望那些被留下的异教徒翻看你的私人物品吧？

en: You! I can't believe you've got the nerve to come back here, after what you did!
zh: 你！我真不敢相信你干了那种事之后还有胆量回到这里！

en: You'd be surprised what people say when they like you.
zh: 人们喜欢你的时候会说什么，你会大吃一惊的。

en: You'd be surprised...
You'd better find a way to get me inside.
zh: 你最好想办法让我进去。

en: You'd better tell us what all the hubbub is about.
zh: 你最好告诉我们这一切到底是怎么回事。

en: You'd think in an expensive lab like this they could afford to put the ventilation inside the walls.
zh: 你会以为在这么贵的实验室里，他们总该出得起钱把通风管装在墙里。

en: You'll be a cryptologist in no time!
zh: 你很快就能成为密码学家了！

en: You'll have to ask Officer Johnsen about that. Sorry.
zh: 那事你得问约翰森警官。抱歉。

en: You'll have to justify your actions some other way.
zh: 你得用别的办法来证明你的行为正当。

en: You'll help me because of this badge.
zh: 你会帮我的，就凭这个警徽。

en: You'll never convince me that killing Anna and Dr. Morales was necessary.
zh: 你永远别想说服我，杀死安娜和莫拉莱斯博士是必要的。

en: You're "A. Batra.". The guy who's been emailing me!
zh: 你就是“A. Batra”。那个一直给我发邮件的人！

en: You're a sociopath.
You're a terrible liar, Ed.
zh: 你撒谎的水平真差，埃德。

en: You're both here because I'M trusting YOU!
zh: 你们俩能在这儿，是因为我相信你们！

en: You're delusional.
You're dreaming, Ed.
You're dreaming, Eddings.
You're going to love it!
You're here because the universe is a self-correcting machine.
zh: 你们在这里，是因为宇宙是一台自我修正的机器。

en: You're like the Moriarty to my Holmes!
zh: 你就像我的莫里亚蒂，而我是福尔摩斯！

en: You're looking rather pulchritudinous today.
zh: 你今天看起来真是明艳动人。

en: You're more the eat hot dogs from the bleachers type these days, huh?
zh: 你现在更像是坐在看台上吃热狗的那种人，是吧？

en: You're not smart enough to have planned this all out on your own.
zh: 你还没聪明到能独自策划这一切。

en: You're only wanted for crimes against fashion these days.
zh: 如今你只因为时尚罪被通缉了。

en: You're out of the military now, Reg. This is police work.
zh: 你已经退伍了，雷吉。这是警察的活儿。

en: You're pretty tech-savvy. Do you know anything about that phone attached to the Resonance device?
zh: 你挺懂技术的。你知道连在共振装置上的那部电话是怎么回事吗？

en: You're right, though, I do fiddle with it, don't I?
zh: 不过你说得对，我确实老摆弄它，是吧？

en: You're safe with me, Anna.
zh: 你跟我在一起很安全，安娜。

en: You're seriously telling me they let you have access to that Antevorta terminal?
zh: 你是认真的？他们让你用那个Antevorta终端？

en: You're siding with this guy? You know what he's done.
zh: 你站到这家伙一边？你知道他做过什么。

en: You're sorry!?
You're such a stickler.
You're the guy who wrote that story about the Vice President.
zh: 你就是写那篇关于副总统的报道的人。

en: You're the janitor, here?
You're under arrest.
You're welcome.
You're wrong. It IS math. Everything is.
zh: 你错了。这就是数学。一切都是。

en: You've already done the calculations.
You've certainly got a lot of security here.
zh: 你这儿的安保措施可真不少。

en: You've got no evidence to back that up.
zh: 你没有证据证明这一点。

en: You've got to help me push it out of the way!
You've got to turn it the other way..
You've just received an item in your inventory.[[Move your mouse to the top of the screen to view the console.[[Point to the INV button to view your inventory.
zh: 你刚刚在物品栏中收到了一件物品。[[将鼠标移到屏幕顶部查看控制台。[[指向INV按钮查看你的物品栏。

en: You've seen him?
You, Ed!
You... solved it?
Your assistant? Ed? He's a good man.
zh: 你的助手？埃德？他是个好人。

en: Your father?
Your friend,[Steve
Your mother, I ... loved her very much
Your name, sir?
